info.description: AbCellera Biologics, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutic antibodies. It offers antibody discovery platform that searches, decodes and analyzes natural immune systems to find antibodies that can be developed to prevent and treat disease. The company was founded by Carl Lars G. Hensen, Kathleen Lisaingo, Kevin Heyries, Veronique Lecault and Daniel Da Costa on November 8, 2012 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: AbCellera Biologics, Inc. 從事治療性抗體的開發。它提供抗體發現平台，可以搜尋、解碼和分析自然免疫系統，以尋找可開發用於預防和治療疾病的抗體。該公司由 Carl Lars G. Hensen、Kathleen Lisaingo、Kevin Heyries、Veronique Lecault 和 Daniel Da Costa 於 2012 年 11 月 8 日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. engages in the acquisition, ownership, and lease of parking facilities and related infrastructure, including parking lots, parking garages, and other parking structures. The company was founded on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. 從事停車設施及相關基礎設施的收購、所有權和租賃業務，包括停車場、停車庫和其他停車設施。該公司成立於2015年5月4日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: CBAK Energy Technology Ltd. engages in the manufacture of new energy high power lithium and sodium batteries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dalian, China.
info.description_zh: 中比能源科技有限公司從事新能源高功率鋰、鈉電池的製造。公司成立於2001年，總部位於中國大連。

info.description: Aurora Cannabis, Inc. engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis and cannabis-derivative products. It operates through the following business segments: Cannabis and Plant Propagation. The company was founded by Terry Booth and Steve Dobler on December 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aurora Cannabis, Inc. 從事大麻及大麻衍生產品的生產、分銷和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：大麻和植物繁殖。該公司由 Terry Booth 和 Steve Dobler 於 2006 年 12 月 21 日創立，總部位於加拿大埃德蒙頓。

info.description: FibroBiologics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of cell therapies. It focuses on treatments and potential cures for chronic diseases using fibroblast cells and fibroblast-derived materials. The firm's product pipeline includes CybroCell, CYMS101, CYWC628, TCB190, and CYTER915. The company was founded by Peter O'Heeron on April 8, 2021 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: FibroBiologics, Inc. 從事細胞療法的開發和商業化。它專注於使用成纖維細胞和成纖維細胞衍生材料來治療和潛在治癒慢性疾病。該公司的產品線包括 CybroCell、CYMS101、CYWC628、TCB190 和 CYTER915。該公司由 Peter O'Heeron 於 2021 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Nem Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NEM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NEM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍長期 Nem 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NEM 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 NEM 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Satellogic, Inc. operates as a vertically integrated geospatial company. It is creating and continuously enhancing the first scalable, fully automated EO platform with the ability to remap the entire planet at both high-frequency and high-resolution, providing accessible and affordable solutions for customers. The company was founded by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte in July 2010 and is headquartered in Davidson, NC.
info.description_zh: Satellogic, Inc. 是一家垂直整合的地理空間公司。它正在創建並不斷增強第一個可擴展、全自動的 EO 平台，能夠以高頻和高解析度重新繪製整個地球，為客戶提供易於使用且價格合理的解決方案。該公司由 Emiliano Kargieman 和 Gerardo Richarte 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州戴維森。

info.description: PepGen Inc. develops oligonucleotide therapies. It is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing the next generation of oligonucleotide therapeutics with the goal of transforming the treatment of severe neuromuscular and neurologic diseases. The company was founded on November 9, 2020 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: PepGen Inc. 開發寡核苷酸療法。它是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於推進下一代寡核苷酸療法，目標是改變嚴重神經肌肉和神經系統疾病的治療方法。該公司成立於2020年11月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Newegg Commerce, Inc. is an e-commerce company. It offers direct sales and an online marketplace platform for IT computer components, consumer electronics, entertainment, smart home and gaming products. The firm also provides third-party logistics services globally. The company was founded on July 22, 2003 and is headquartered in City of Industry, CA.
info.description_zh: Newegg Commerce, Inc. 是一家電子商務公司。它為 IT 電腦組件、消費性電子產品、娛樂、智慧家庭和遊戲產品提供直接銷售和線上市場平台。該公司在全球也提供第三方物流服務。該公司成立於2003年7月22日，總部位於加州工業城。

info.description: Sight Sciences, Inc. is an ophthalmic medical device company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of surgical and nonsurgical technologies for the treatment of prevalent eye diseases. It operates through the Surgical Glaucoma and Dry Eye segments. The Surgical Glaucoma segment includes OMNI Surgical System for use in minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. The Dry Eye segment offers TearCare System and related components. The company was founded by Paul Badawi and David Y. Badawi in 2011 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Sight Sciences, Inc. 是一家眼科醫療器材公司，專注於用於治療常見眼疾的手術和非手術技術的開發和商業化。它透過手術青光眼和乾眼症部門進行運作。青光眼手術部分包括用於微創青光眼手術的 OMNI 手術系統。乾眼部門提供淚液護理系統和相關組件。該公司由 Paul Badawi 和 David Y. Badawi 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of mission critical products, services and solutions for United States national security priorities. It operates through the Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) and Unmanned Systems (US) segments. The KGS segment consists of an aggregation of KGS operating segments, including microwave electronic products, space, satellite and cyber, training solutions. The US segment refers to the unmanned aerial, unmanned ground, unmanned seaborne and related command, control and communications system businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 1994, and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
info.description_zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 致力於為美國國家安全優先事項提供關鍵任務產品、服務和解決方案。它透過 Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) 和 Unmanned Systems (US) 部門運作。 KGS 部門由 KGS 營運部門組成，包括微波電子產品、太空、衛星和網路、培訓解決方案。美國業務涉及無人機、無人地面、無人海上及相關指揮、控制和通訊系統業務。該公司成立於1994年12月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州朗德羅克。

info.description: Elemental Royalty Corp. engages in the acquisition and management of royalty interests in mineral properties. Its portfolio includes Karlawinda, Laverton, Leeville, Timok, Bonikro, Korali-Sud, Gediktepe, Viscaria, Diablillos, Dugbe, Cactus & Parks/Salye, Mactung, and Pickle Crow. The company was founded on March 11, 2004 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: Elemental Royal Corp. 從事礦產特許權使用費權益的收購和管理。其產品組合包括 Karlawinda、Laverton、Leeville、Timok、Bonikro、Korali-Sud、Gediktepe、Viscaria、Diablillos、Dugbe、Cactus & Parks/Salye、Mactung 和 Pickle Crow。該公司成立於2004年3月11日，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ONDS Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying wireless communication and automated drone technology firm.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ONDS 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標為 Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對基礎無線通訊和自動無人機技術公司的日常曝險。

info.description: Amplitude, Inc. provides a digital analytics platform that helps companies analyze their customer behavior within digital products. It delivers its application over the Internet as a subscription service using a software as a service (SaaS) model. The company was founded by Spenser Skates, Jeffrey Wang, and Curtis Liu in November 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Amplitude, Inc. 提供數位分析平台，幫助公司分析數位產品中的客戶行為。它使用軟體即服務 (SaaS) 模型透過互聯網將其應用程式作為訂閱服務提供。該公司由 Spenser Skates、Jeffrey Wang 和 Curtis Liu 於 2011 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Astronics Corp. engages in the provision of electrical power generation and distribution systems. The firm includes motion systems, lighting and safety systems, avionics products, aircraft structures, systems certification, and automated test systems. It operates through the Aerospace and Test Systems segments. The Aerospace segment designs and manufactures products for the global aerospace industry. The Test Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and maintains communications and weapons test systems and training and simulation devices for military applications. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in East Aurora, NY.
info.description_zh: Astronics Corp. 從事提供發電和配電系統。該公司包括運動系統、照明和安全系統、航空電子產品、飛機結構、系統認證和自動化測試系統。它透過航空航天和測試系統部門運作。航空航天部門為全球航空航天工業設計和製造產品。測試系統部門設計、開發、製造和維護通訊和武器測試系統以及軍事應用的訓練和模擬設備。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於紐約州東奧羅拉。

info.description: Ultralife Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of products for power solutions. It operates through the following segments: Battery and Energy Products and Communications System. The Battery and Energy Products segment includes Lithium 9-volt, cylindrical, thin cell and various other non-rechargeable batteries, in addition to rechargeable batteries, uninterruptable power supplies, charging systems, and accessories such as cables. The Communications System segment consists of radio frequency amplifiers, power supplies, cable and connector assemblies, amplified speakers, equipment mounts, case equipment, integrated communication systems for fixed or vehicle applications, and communications and electronics systems design. The company was founded by Arthur M. Liberman in December 1990 and is headquartered in Newark, NY.
info.description_zh: Ultralife Corp. 從事電源解決方案產品的製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：電池和能源產品以及通訊系統。電池和能源產品部門包括 9 伏特鋰電池、圓柱形薄電池和各種其他不可充電電池，以及可充電電池、不間斷電源、充電系統和電纜等配件。通訊系統部門包括射頻放大器、電源、電纜和連接器組件、放大揚聲器、設備支架、機箱設備、固定或車輛應用的整合式通訊系統以及通訊和電子系統設計。該公司由 Arthur M. Liberman 於 1990 年 12 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐瓦克。

info.description: Runway Growth Finance Corp. is a closed-end investment company, which engages in the provision of senior secured loans to high growth-potential companies in technology, life sciences, healthcare information and services, business services, select consumer services and products, and other high-growth industries. The company was founded on August 31, 2015 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Runway Growth Finance Corp.是一家封閉式投資公司，致力於向科技、生命科學、醫療保健資訊和服務、商業服務、精選消費服務和產品以及其他高成長產業的高成長潛力公司提供優先擔保貸款。該公司成立於2015年8月31日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Senseonics Holdings, Inc. is a medical technology company, which engages in the development and manufacture of glucose monitoring products. Its primary product is the brand Eversense CGM (continuous glucose monitoring) including sensors, smart transmitters, and mobile applications. The company was founded on June 26, 2014 and is headquartered in Germantown, MD.
info.description_zh: Senseonics Holdings, Inc.是一家醫療科技公司，從事血糖​​監測產品的開發和製造。其主要產品是 Eversense CGM（連續血糖監測）品牌，包括感測器、智慧發射器和行動應用程式。該公司成立於2014年6月26日，總部位於馬裡蘭州日耳曼敦。

info.description: Hycroft Mining Holding Corp. engages in the exploration, mining, and development of gold and silver properties. The company was founded on August 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Winnemucca, NV.
info.description_zh: Hycroft Mining Holding Corp. 從事金銀礦產的勘探、開採和開發。該公司成立於2017年8月28日，總部位於內華達州溫尼馬卡。

info.description: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. provides products, services and solutions to the drone industry. It also engages in the provision of distributed data storage, analytics and services for the drone industry.The firm product include Dronebox, which is a blockchain technology that records, stores and analyzes flight data and information from a drone. It operates through the Enterprise Segment. The Enterprise Segment will focus on developing a hardware enabled software platform of services and solutions to government and commercial enterprises and the military. The company was founded by Jeffrey M. Thompson in February 1984 and is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
info.description_zh: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. 為無人機產業提供產品、服務和解決方案。它還致力於為無人機行業提供分散式資料儲存、分析和服務。該公司的產品包括 Dronebox，這是一種記錄、儲存和分析無人機飛行數據和資訊的區塊鏈技術。它透過企業部門運作。企業部門將專注於為政府、商業企業和軍隊開發硬體支援的服務和解決方案軟體平台。該公司由 Jeffrey M. Thompson 於 1984 年 2 月創立，總部位於波多黎各聖胡安。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long MP Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of MP. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of MP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 MP 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MP 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 MP 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Caris Life Sciences, Inc. provides diagnostics and anatomic pathology services. It develops an unbiased profiling platform for novel target identification, drug development and delivery, diagnostic and disease monitoring, and precision medicine enabling aspects. It offers services throughout the U.S., Europe, Australia and other international markets. The company was founded by David D. Halbert in 2008 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Caris Life Sciences, Inc. 提供診斷和解剖病理學服務。它為新標靶識別、藥物開發和交付、診斷和疾病監測以及精準醫療支援方面開發了一個公正的分析平台。它在美國、歐洲、澳洲和其他國際市場提供服務。該公司由 David D. Halbert 於 2008 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: OmniAb, Inc. operates as a drug discovery company. The firm focuses on developing human monoclonal and bispecific therapeutic antibodies. Its platform includes the biological intelligence of its transgenic animals, including OmniRat, OmniChicken and OmniMouse. The company was founded on December 14, 2015 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: OmniAb, Inc. 是一家藥物發現公司。該公司專注於開發人類單株和雙特異性治療抗體。其平台包括基因改造動物的生物智能，包括 OmniRat、OmniChicken 和 OmniMouse。該公司成立於2015年12月14日，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Delcath Systems, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in the treatment of primary and metastatic liver cancers. Its products include CHEMOSAT and HEPZATO. The company was founded on August 5, 1988 and is headquartered in Queensbury, NY.
info.description_zh: Delcath Systems, Inc.是一家腫瘤學公司，從事原發性和轉移性肝癌的治療。其產品包括CHEMOSAT和HEPZATO。該公司成立於1988年8月5日，總部位於紐約州昆斯伯里。

info.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. engages in the development of therapeutic products for the treatment of rare and orphan diseases. Its product pipeline includes QRX003, QRX004, QRX007, and QRX008. The company was founded by Michael Myers and Denise Carter on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 從事治療罕見疾病和孤兒疾病的治療產品的開發。其產品線包括QRX003、QRX004、QRX007和QRX008。該公司由 Michael Myers 和 Denise Carter 於 2018 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing novel antiviral therapeutics that target the replication process of influenza viruses, coronaviruses (including SARS-CoV-2), noroviruses and hepatitis C viruses. Cocrystal employs unique structure-based technologies to create first- and best-in-class antiviral drugs. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Bothell, WA.
info.description_zh: Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發針對流感病毒、冠狀病毒（包括 SARS-CoV-2）、諾羅病毒和丙型肝炎病毒複製過程的新型抗病毒療法。 Cocrystal 採用獨特的結構為基礎的技術來創造一流的抗病毒藥物。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於華盛頓州博塞爾。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI Select Gold Miners Investable Market Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index has been developed by MSCI Inc. (the "index provider" or "MSCI") to target a minimum of 30 companies in developed and emerging markets that are involved in the business of gold mining. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球黃金礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 選擇黃金礦業可投資市場指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由 MSCI Inc.（「指數提供者」或「MSCI」）開發，目標是已開發市場和新興市場中至少 30 家從事金礦開採業務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Foghorn Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a development stage biopharmaceutical company. It is discovering and developing a novel class of precision medicine therapeutics targeting the chromatin regulatory system in oncology. Through its scalable Gene Traffic Control product platform, the firm is systematically interrogating and drugging the chromatin regulatory system. The company was founded by Cigall Kadoch, Gerald W. Crabtree and Douglas G. Cole in October 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Foghorn Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的生物製藥公司。它正在發現和開發一類針對腫瘤學染色質調節系統的新型精準醫學療法。透過其可擴展的基因流量控制產品平台，該公司正在系統性地詢問和麻醉染色質調控系統。該公司由 Cigall Kadoch、Gerald W. Crabtree 和 Douglas G. Cole 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Aptera Motors Corp. is an automotive technology company focused on the development, production, and distribution of energy-efficient, solar-powered, battery-electric vehicles. Its flagship product, the Aptera, is a three-wheeled, two-seat solar vehicle designed to reduce reliance on traditional charging by utilizing integrated solar panels. The company was founded by Steve Fambro and Chris Anthony and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Aptera Motors Corp. 是一家汽車技術公司，專注於開發、生產和分銷節能型太陽能電池電動車。其旗艦產品 Aptera 是一款三輪兩座太陽能車，旨在透過利用整合式太陽能板來減少對傳統充電的依賴。該公司由 Steve Fambro 和 Chris Anthony 創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Sprott Silver Miners & Physical Silver ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, that track the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Silver Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of the value of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, production, development, or exploration of silver; and publicly traded closed-end trusts that invest 50% or more of their assets in physical silver. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Silver Miners & Physical Silver ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，追蹤納斯達克 Sprott Silver Miners Index 的總回報表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少將其總資產價值的80%投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自白銀開採、生產、開發或勘探的公司的表現；以及將 50% 或更多資產投資於實體白銀的公開交易封閉式信託。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Real Brokerage, Inc. engages in the provision of real estate brokerage services. It operates through the following segments: North American Brokerage, One Real Title, One Real Mortgage, and Real Wallet. The North American Brokerage segment generates revenue by processing real estate transactions which entitles the company to commissions. The One Real Title segment manages title insurance and closing services for residential and commercial transactions. The One Real Mortgage segment deals with mortgage transactions between borrowers and lenders. The Real Wallet segment offers interchange fees on company branded debit cards, interest income on certain deposit accounts, and interest income and various fees associated with credit lines. The company was founded by Tamir Poleg, Yuval Niv, and Gal Weiss on June 26, 2014 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: The Real Brokerage, Inc. 從事提供房地產經紀服務。它透過以下部門運作：北美經紀部門、One Real Title、One Real Mortgage 和 Real Wallet。北美經紀部門透過處理房地產交易產生收入，該交易使公司有權獲得佣金。 One Real Title 部門管理住宅和商業交易的產權保險和結算服務。 One Real Mortgage 部門處理借款人和貸方之間的抵押交易。 Real Wallet 部門提供公司品牌金融卡的交換費、某些存款帳戶的利息收入以及利息收入和與信用額度相關的各種費用。該公司由 Tamir Poleg、Yuval Niv 和 Gal Weiss 於 2014 年 6 月 26 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of cell therapies as novel cancer immunotherapy products. Its lead product candidate, LN-144 for metastatic melanoma, is an autologous adoptive cell therapy utilizing tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL), which are T cells derived from patients' tumors. The company was founded by Robert T. Brooke on September 17, 2007 and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於細胞療法作為新型癌症免疫療法產品的開發和商業化。其主要候選產品 LN-144 用於治療轉移性黑色素瘤，是一種利用腫瘤浸潤淋巴細胞 (TIL) 的自體過繼細胞療法，TIL 是源自患者腫瘤的 T 細胞。該公司由 Robert T. Brooke 於 2007 年 9 月 17 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: Diodes Inc. engages in the manufacturing and supply of application-specific standard products within the broad discrete, logic, analog, and mixed-signal semiconductor markets. The firm offers diodes, rectifiers, transistors, MOSFETs, protection devices, functional specific arrays, single gate, dual gate and standard logic, amplifiers and comparators, Hall-effect, and temperature sensors. It operates through the following geographical segments: Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company was founded on June 15, 1959 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Diodes Inc. 致力於在廣泛的分立、邏輯、類比和混合訊號半導體市場中製造和供應特定應用的標準產品。該公司提供二極體、整流器、電晶體、MOSFET、保護元件、功能特定陣列、單閘極、雙閘極和標準邏輯、放大器和比較器、霍爾效應和溫度感測器。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：亞洲、美洲和歐洲。該公司成立於 1959 年 6 月 15 日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Royal Gold, Inc. engages in the business of acquiring and managing precious metal streams, royalties, and similar interests. It operates under the Acquisition and Management of Stream Interests, and Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests segments. The Acquisition and Management of Stream Interests segment focuses on metal streams, which are purchase agreements that provide, in exchange for an upfront deposit payment, the right to purchase all or a portion of one or more metals produced, at a price determined for the life of the transaction. The Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests segment is involved in non-operating interests in mining projects that provide the right to revenue or metals produced from the project. The company was founded by Stanley Dempsey in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Royal Gold, Inc. 從事收購和管理貴金屬流、特許權使用費和類似權益的業務。它在流權益的收購和管理以及特許權權益的收購和管理部門下運作。流權益的收購和管理部門專注於金屬流，這是一種購買協議，提供以交易期間確定的價格購買全部或部分所生產的一種或多種金屬的權利，以換取預付定金。特許權權益的收購和管理部門涉及採礦項目的非經營權益，這些權益提供了從該項目生產的收入或金屬的權利。該公司由 Stanley Dempsey 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: Trupanion, Inc. engages in the provision of medical insurance for cats and dogs. It operates through the Subscription Business and Other Business segments. The Subscription Business segment is involved in the monthly subscriptions of pet medical insurance. The Others Business segment includes companies or organizations that choose to provide medical insurance for cats and dogs as a benefit to their employees or members. The company was founded by Darryl Rawlings in 2000 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Trupanion, Inc. 從事為貓和狗提供醫療保險的業務。它透過訂閱業務和其他業務部門運作。訂閱業務部門從事寵物醫療保險的每月訂閱業務。其他業務部門包括選擇為貓和狗提供醫療保險作為員工或會員福利的公司或組織。該公司由 Darryl Rawlings 於 2000 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: InspireMD, Inc. is medical device company, which engages in the development and commercialization of its proprietary MicroNet stent platform technology for the treatment of complex vascular and coronary disease. Its products are marketed for use mainly in patients with acute coronary syndromes, notably acute myocardial infarction and saphenous vein graft coronary interventions. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: InspireMD, Inc.是一家醫療器材公司，致力於其專有的MicroNet支架平台技術的開發和商業化，用於治療複雜的血管和冠狀動脈疾病。其產品主要用於急性冠狀動脈綜合症患者，特別是急性心肌梗塞和大隱靜脈移植冠狀動脈介入治療。該公司成立於 2005 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Latham Group, Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of in-ground residential swimming pools in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers a portfolio of pools and related products, including in-ground swimming pools, pool liners, and pool covers. The company was founded on December 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Latham, NY.
info.description_zh: Latham Group, Inc. 在北美、澳洲和紐西蘭從事地下住宅游泳池的設計、製造和行銷。它提供一系列泳池及相關產品，包括地下游泳池、泳池襯墊和泳池蓋。該公司成立於2018年12月6日，總部位於紐約州萊瑟姆。

info.description: Ferroglobe PLC is a holding company, which engages in the production of silicon and specialty metals. The firm's products include silicon metal, manganese alloys, ferrosilicon, calcium silicon, and electrodes. It operates through the following segments: North America Silicon Metals, North America Silicon Alloys, Europe Manganese, Europe Silicon Metals, Europe Silicon Alloys, South Africa Silicon Metals, South Africa Silicon Alloys, and Other. The company was founded on February 5, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Ferroglobe PLC 是一家控股公司，從事矽和特種金屬的生產。該公司的產品包括金屬矽、錳合金、矽鐵、矽鈣和電極。它透過以下部門運作：北美金屬矽部門、北美矽合金部門、歐洲錳部門、歐洲金屬矽部門、歐洲矽合金部門、南非金屬矽部門、南非矽合金部門等。該公司成立於2015年2月5日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Aerovironment Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAV). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of its assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Aerovironment Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVAV）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Liberty Capital Corp. engages in the provision of data, mobile, voice, and managed services to consumer and business customers. The company was founded by Bridget L. Baker and Ronald A. Duncan in 1979 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Liberty Capital Corp. 致力於向消費者和企業客戶提供資料、行動、語音和託管服務。該公司由 Bridget L. Baker 和 Ronald A. Duncan 於 1979 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, corresponding to 200% of the daily performance of Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) common stock. The fund employs a leveraged single-stock strategy designed for sophisticated investors to express short-term bullish views on the underlying issuer's performance through the use of swap agreements and other derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在提供扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該基金採用槓桿單一股票策略，專為經驗豐富的投資者而設計，透過互換協議和其他衍生性工具表達對基礎發行人績效的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: Jabil, Inc. engages in the provision of manufacturing services and solutions. It operates through the Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) and Diversified Manufacturing Services (DMS) segments. The EMS segment focuses on leveraging information technology, supply chain design and engineering, technologies largely centered on core electronics, utilizing a large-scale manufacturing infrastructure, and the ability to serve a broad range of end markets. The DMS segment offers engineering solutions with an emphasis on material sciences, machining, tooling, and molding of engineered plastic and metal parts. The company was founded by William E. Morean and James Golden in 1966 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Jabil, Inc. 從事提供製造服務和解決方案。它透過電子製造服務（EMS）和多元化製造服務（DMS）部門運作。 EMS部門專注於利用資訊技術、供應鏈設計和工程、主要集中於核心電子產品的技術、利用大規模製造基礎設施以及服務廣泛終端市場的能力。 DMS 部門提供工程解決方案，重點關注工程塑膠和金屬零件的材料科學、加工、模具和成型。該公司由 William E. Morean 和 James Golden 於 1966 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: J&J Snack Foods Corp. engages in the manufacturing of nutritional snack foods and distribution of frozen beverages to the food service and retail supermarket industries. It operates through the following segments: Food Service, Retail Supermarkets, and Frozen Beverages. The Food Service segment includes soft pretzels, frozen novelties, churros, handheld products, and baked goods. The Retail Supermarkets segment offers soft pretzel products including Superpretzel, frozen juice treats and desserts, including Luigi's real Italian ice, Minute Maid juice bars and soft frozen lemonade, Whole Fruit frozen fruit bars and sorbet, Philly Swirl cups and sticks, ICEE Squeeze-Up Tubes and dough enrobed handheld products including Patio burritos. The Frozen Beverages segment provides frozen beverages to the food service industry primarily under the names ICEE, SLUSH PUPPIE, and PARROT ICE in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, as well as repair and maintenance services. The company was founded by Gerald B. Shreiber in 1971 and is headquartered in Mount Laurel, NJ.
info.description_zh: J&J Snack Foods Corp. 從事營養休閒食品的製造以及向食品服務和零售超市行業分銷冷凍飲料。它透過以下部門運作：食品服務、零售超市和冷凍飲料。食品服務部門包括軟椒鹽捲餅、冷凍新奇食品、油條、手持產品和烘焙食品。零售超市部門提供軟椒鹽捲餅產品，包括 Superpretzel、冷凍果汁和甜點，包括 Luigi's 真正的意大利冰、Minute Maid 果汁棒和軟冷凍檸檬水、Whole Fruit 冷凍水果棒和果汁冰糕、Philly Swirl 杯子和棒、ICEE Squeeze-Up Tubes 和裹著麵團的手持產品，包括 Patio 捲餅。冷凍飲料部門主要在美國、墨西哥和加拿大以 ICEE、SLUSH PUPPIE 和 PARROT ICE 的名稱向食品服務業提供冷凍飲料，以及維修和保養服務。該公司由 Gerald B. Shreiber 於 1971 年創立，總部位於新澤西州勞雷爾山。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., doing business as SpaceX, operates as an aerospace manufacturer, launch service provider, and satellite communications company. It is building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future across space, connectivity, and AI. The firm designs, manufactures, launches, and operates products and services built on cutting-edge technologies, including the rockets and spacecraft. The company was founded by Elon Reeve Musk in 2002 and is headquartered in Starbase, TX.
info.description_zh: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（以 SpaceX 名義開展業務）是一家航空航太製造商、發射服務供應商和衛星通訊公司。它正在建立未來跨空間、連接和人工智慧的整合硬體和軟體基礎設施。該公司設計、製造、發射和營運基於尖端技術（包括火箭和太空船）的產品和服務。該公司由 Elon Reeve Musk 於 2002 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州 Starbase。

info.description: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of engineered products and services that facilitate the optimization of oil and natural gas well completions and field development strategies. It offers fracturing systems, repeat precision, tracer diagnostics, and well construction. The company was founded by Robert Nipper and Marty Stromquist in 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. 從事提供工程產品和服務，以促進石油和天然氣完井和油田開發策略的最佳化。它提供壓裂系統、重複精度、示踪劑診斷和建井。該公司由 Robert Nipper 和 Marty Stromquist 於 2006 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UUUU Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Energy Fuels Inc. (UUUU). The strategy serves as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying uranium and rare earth elements producer.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UUUU 每日 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，目標是 Energy Fuels Inc. (UUUU) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟投資者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對潛在鈾和稀土元素生產商的每日曝險。

info.description: Paramount Skydance Corp. is a next-generation global media and entertainment company that engages in providing content creation and distribution services. It operates through the following business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Its portfolio unites brands including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Television, CBS, CBS News, Nickelodeon, MTV, BET, Comedy Central, Showtime, Paramount Plus, Pluto TV, and Skydance's Animation, Film, Television, Interactive/Games, and Sports divisions. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Paramount Skydance Corp. 是一家下一代全球媒體和娛樂公司，致力於提供內容創作和發行服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：工作室、直接面向消費者和電視媒體。其旗下品牌包括派拉蒙影業、派拉蒙電視、CBS、CBS News、Nickelodeon、MTV、BET、Comedy Central、Showtime、Paramount Plus、Pluto TV 以及 Skydance 的動畫、電影、電視、互動/遊戲和體育部門。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: TSS, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive services for the planning, design, development and maintenance of mission-critical facilities and information infrastructure as well as integration services. It operates through the Facilities and Systems Integration Services business segments. The Facilities segment consists of the design, project management, and maintenance of data center and mission-critical business operations. The Systems Integration segment integrates information technology equipment for original equipment manufacturer vendors and customers to be used inside data center environments, including modular data centers. The company was founded by Gerard J. Gallagher on December 20, 2004 and is headquartered in Georgetown, TX.
info.description_zh: TSS, Inc. 致力於為關鍵任務設施和資訊基礎設施的規劃、設計、開發和維護以及整合服務提供綜合服務。它透過設施和系統整合服務業務部門運作。設施部門包括資料中心和關鍵任務業務運作的設計、專案管理和維護。系統整合部門為原始設備製造商供應商和客戶整合資訊科技設備，以便在資料中心環境（包括模組化資料中心）內使用。該公司由 Gerard J. Gallagher 於 2004 年 12 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州喬治敦。

info.description: Repligen Corp. is a global life sciences company, which engages in providing bioprocessing technologies and solutions used in the process of manufacturing biological drugs. It operates through the North America. Europe, and Asia Pacific Region or Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Alexander G. Rich and Paul R. Schimmel in May 1981 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Repligen Corp.是一家全球生命科學公司，致力於提供生物藥物製造過程中使用的生物加工技術和解決方案。它的業務遍及北美。歐洲、亞太地區或其他地理區域。該公司由 Alexander G. Rich 和 Paul R. Schimmel 於 1981 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.5 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。基金將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NVDA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to NVDA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intuitive Surgical, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. The fund will aim to primarily obtain its notional exposure against the Underlying Stock through swap agreements.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF 在尋求扣除費用和開支之前，Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金的目標主要是透過掉期協議獲得其標的股票的名義曝險。

info.description: Telix Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of several clinical-stage oncology assets. The firm operates through the following segments: Therapeutics (Tx), Precision Medicine (Px), and Telix Manufacturing Solutions (TMS). The Tx segment focuses on development of targeted radionuclide therapies for urologic and neurologic oncology, and other solid tumors. The Px segment includes provision of diagnostic imaging solutions to market and expanding into new geographies and indications. The TMS segment comprises of costs to operate the firm's facilities and assets. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia Pacific, and Europe, Middle East and Africa. The company was founded by Andreas Kluge and Christian P. Behrenbruch in November 2015 and is headquartered in North Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Telix Pharmaceuticals Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，從事多種臨床階段腫瘤資產的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門運作：治療部門 (Tx)、精準醫療部門 (Px) 和 Telix 製造解決方案部門 (TMS)。 Tx 部門專注於泌尿科和神經腫瘤以及其他實體腫瘤的靶向放射性核素療法的開發。 Px 部門包括向市場提供診斷影像解決方案以及擴展到新的地區和適應症。 TMS 部門包括營運公司設施和資產的成本。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞太地區、歐洲、中東和非洲。該公司由 Andreas Kluge 和 Christian P. Behrenbruch 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於澳洲北墨爾本。

info.description: VanEck Space ETF is a thematic, passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the performance of publicly traded companies globally within the expanding space industry. The strategy uses a rules-based, modified float-adjusted market capitalization weighting framework to capture pure-play commercial space exposure by emphasizing firms involved in space exploration, rockets, propulsion systems, and satellite infrastructure while avoiding standard defense conglomerate dominance.
info.description_zh: VanEck Space ETF 是一款主題型、被動式管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤不斷擴張的航太產業中全球上市公司的表現。該戰略採用基於規則、經過修改的浮動調整市值加權框架，透過強調參與太空探索、火箭、推進系統和衛星基礎設施的公司，同時避免標準國防集團的主導地位，來捕捉純粹的商業太空風險。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intuitive Machines, Inc. is a space exploration, infrastructure, and services company, which engages in contributing to the establishment of cislunar infrastructure and helping to develop cislunar and deep space commerce. It offers space products and services. The company was founded by Stephen J. Altemus, Kam Ghaffarian, and Timothy P. Crain in 2013 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Intuitive Machines, Inc.是一家太空探索、基礎設施和服務公司，致力於促進地月基礎設施的建設並幫助發展地月和深空商業。它提供太空產品和服務。該公司由 Stephen J. Altemus、Kam Ghaffarian 和 Timothy P. Crain 於 2013 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NVDA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to NVDA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求 NVDA 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Space Tech ETF invests in companies positioned to benefit from the commercialization of the global space economy, including developers of rocket launch systems, satellite-enabled telecommunications, and mission-critical space technology. The strategy utilizes a thematic approach to provide exposure to the space value chain, tracking an index of companies involved in space exploration, infrastructure, and next-generation space technologies.
info.description_zh: Global X Space Tech ETF 投資於能夠從全球太空經濟商業化中受益的公司，包括火箭發射系統、衛星電信和關鍵任務太空技術的開發人員。該策略採用主題方法來提供太空價值鏈的曝光，追蹤涉及太空探索、基礎設施和下一代太空技術的公司指數。

info.description: Strata Critical Medical, Inc. is a time-critical logistics and medical services provider to the United States healthcare industry. It operates through the following segments: Logistics and Clinical. The Logistics segment includes Organ Placement, Air, and Ground Logistics. The Clinical segment focuses on Organ Recovery, Normothermic Regional Perfusion, Preservation, and Cardiac Care. The company was founded by Robert S. Wiesenthal and Steven Martocci on December 22, 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Strata Critical Medical, Inc. 是美國醫療保健產業時間緊迫的物流和醫療服務提供者。它透過以下部門運作：物流和臨床。物流部門包括器官放置、空中和地面物流。臨床部分重點在於器官恢復、常溫區域灌注、保存和心臟護理。該公司由 Robert S. Wiesenthal 和 Steven Martocci 於 2014 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Abeona Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of gene therapy for severe and life-threatening rare diseases. It programs include EB-101 (gene-corrected skin grafts) for recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB), ABO-102 (AAV-SGSH), an adeno-associated virus (AAV) based gene therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome type A (MPS IIIA), and ABO-101 (AAV NAGLU), an AAV based gene therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome type B (MPS IIIB). The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: Abeona Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對嚴重和危及生命的罕見疾病的基因療法。此計畫包括用於治療隱性營養不良性大皰性表皮鬆解症 (RDEB) 的 EB-101（基因校正皮膚移植）、ABO-102 (AAV-SGSH)、一種基於腺相關病毒 (AAV) 的 A 型聖菲利波綜合徵 (MPS IIIA) 基因治療，以及 ABO-101 (AAV NAGS3) 是一種基於 AMPB 型治療菲利 (BMPS B) 的基因治療-101 (AAVS33) 是一種基於 AMPB 型治療 (BMPS A該公司成立於 1974 年，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Mobilicom Ltd. is an end-to-end provider of cyber security and smart solutions for drones, robotics and autonomous platforms. It designs, develops and delivers solutions targeting global drone, robotics and autonomous system manufacturers. The firm holds patented technology and know-how for Mobile Mesh networking. Its customers include corporates, governments and military departments. The company was founded by Oren Elkayam and Yossi Segal in 2006 and is headquartered in Shoham, Israel.
info.description_zh: Mobilicom Ltd. 是一家為無人機、機器人和自主平台提供網路安全和智慧解決方案的端到端供應商。它為全球無人機、機器人和自主系統製造商設計、開發和提供解決方案。該公司擁有行動網狀網路的專利技術和專有技術。其客戶包括企業、政府和軍事部門。該公司由 Oren Elkayam 和 Yossi Segal 於 2006 年創立，總部位於以色列 Shoham。

info.description: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. is a redefining drug discovery company, which identifies and optimizes allosteric binding sites that never targeted before. Its See-Tx target identification platform uses the published 3D structure of enzymes and a proprietary computational technology to discover new allosteric binding sites and predict their druggability. The firm is also unlocking new treatment options to treat disorders characterized by protein misfolding. The company was founded by Khalid Islam in 2017 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家重新定義的藥物發現公司，該公司識別並優化以前從未靶向的變構結合位點。其 See-Tx 標靶識別平台使用已發布的酶 3D 結構和專有計算技術來發現新的變構結合位點並預測其成藥性。該公司還正在開發新的治療方案來治療以蛋白質錯誤折疊為特徵的疾病。該公司由 Khalid Islam 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Sprott Lithium Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Lithium Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, or production of lithium. The index generally consists of from 40 to 50 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Lithium Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Lithium Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自鋰開採、勘探、開發或生產的公司的表現。該指數一般由 40 至 50 檔成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology 寻求相当于纳斯达克生物技术指数每日表现两倍 (2x) 的每日投资结果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。该指数是修改后的资本加权指数，包括纳斯达克上市公司的证券，这些公司被分类为生物技术或制药。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. provides outpatient mental health services. It offers patients a suite of mental health services, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological, and neuropsychological testing, as well as individual, family, and group therapy. The firm operates outpatient mental health platform as well as offers patients care virtually through its online delivery platform or in-person at its centers in 32 states. The company was founded by Michael K. Lester, Gwen H. Booth and Danish J. Qureshi in 2017 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. 提供門診心理健康服務。它為患者提供一套心理健康服務，包括精神病學評估和治療、心理和神經心理學測試以及個人、家庭和團體治療。該公司經營門診心理健康平台，並透過其線上交付平台或在 32 個州的中心親自為患者提供虛擬護理。該公司由 Michael K. Lester、Gwen H. Booth 和Danish J. Qureshi 於 2017 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that engages in the designing, manufacturing and sale of precision and specialty-controlled motion components and systems used in a broad range of industries, including industrial, vehicle, medical, and aerospace and defense. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球性工程和製造企業，從事設計、製造和銷售精密和專業控制運動部件和系統，這些部件和系統廣泛應用於工業、車輛、醫療、航空航太和國防等行業。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a diversified portfolio of convertible securities and high yield corporate bonds rated Ba or lower by Moody's or BB or lower by Standard & Poor's. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a focus on such factors as financial soundness, ability to make interest and dividend payments, earnings and cash-flow forecast, and quality of management to create its portfolio. Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund was formed on April 17, 2002 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封闭式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於穆迪Ba級或以下評級或標準普爾評級BB級或以下的可轉換證券和高收益公司債券的多元化投資組合。該基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點關注財務穩健性、支付利息和股息的能力、收益和現金流量預測以及創建投資組合的管理品質等因素。 Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund 成立于 2002 年 4 月 17 日，注册地为美国。

info.description: Rigetti Computing, Inc. provides full-stack quantum computing services. It serves global enterprise, government, and research clients through its Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services platform. The company was founded by Chad Rigetti in 2013 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: RigettiComputing,Inc.提供全端量子運算服務。它透過 Rigetti Quantum 雲端服務平台為全球企業、政府和研究客戶提供服務。該公司由 Chad Rigetti 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州柏克萊。

info.description: Palladyne AI Corp. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of industrial robotic systems that augment human performance by combining human intelligence, instinct, and judgment with the strength, endurance, and precision of machines to enhance employee safety and productivity. Its products include Palldyne IQ and Palladyne Pilot. The company was founded by Fraser M. Smith and Benjamin G. Wolff in 2015 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Palladyne AI Corp. 從事工業機器人系統的設計、開發和製造，透過將人類智慧、本能和判斷力與機器的力量、耐力和精度相結合來增強人類績效，從而提高員工的安全和生產力。其產品包括 Palldyne IQ 和 Palladyne Pilot。該公司由 Fraser M. Smith 和 Benjamin G. Wolff 於 2015 年創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Kaiser Aluminum Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of semi-fabricated specialty aluminum products. The firm caters to the aerospace, general engineering, automotive, and custom industrial applications industries. Its products include plate, sheet, coil, hard alloy shapes, soft alloy extrusions, seamless and structural extruded, drawn tube, hard alloy rod, bar, wire and forge stock. The company was founded by Henry J. Kaiser in 1946 and is headquartered in Franklin, TN.
info.description_zh: Kaiser Aluminium Corp. 從事半成品特殊鋁產品的製造和銷售。該公司服務於航空航天、通用工程、汽車和客製化工業應用產業。其產品包括板材、薄板、捲材、硬質合金型材、軟合金擠壓件、無縫和結構擠壓件、拉製管材、硬質合金棒材、棒材、線材和鍛造件。該公司由 Henry J. Kaiser 於 1946 年創立，總部位於田納西州富蘭克林。

info.description: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. operates as a late-stage clinical mRNA medicines and vaccine company, which engages in the development of infectious disease vaccines and significant opportunities within liver and respiratory rare diseases. Its products include LUNAR-COV19, LUNAR-FLU, LUNAR-OTC, and LUNAR-CF. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. 是一家後期臨床 mRNA 藥物和疫苗公司，致力於傳染病疫苗的開發以及肝臟和呼吸道罕見疾病領域的重大機會。其產品包括LUNAR-COV19、LUNAR-FLU、LUNAR-OTC和LUNAR-CF。該公司成立於 2013 年，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of CSCO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of CSCO and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to CSCO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 CSCO 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 CSCO 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 CSCO 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company. It engages in the provision of structure-guided drug design with the goal of developing oral small-molecule and protein therapeutics to target difficult-to-treat rare diseases. The company was founded by William M. Spencer III, Charles E. Bugg, and John A. Montgomery in 1986 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它致力於提供結構指導的藥物設計，目標是開發口服小分子和蛋白質療法來治療難以治療的罕見疾病。該公司由 William M. Spencer III、Charles E. Bugg 和 John A. Montgomery 於 1986 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Genomics Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of genomic science and biotechnology, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Genomics & Biotechnology Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Genomics 指數（「基礎指數」）未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於基因組科學和生物技術及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「基因組學和生物技術公司」），正如基礎指數提供商 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NVIDIA Corp. engages in the design and manufacture of computer graphics processors, chipsets, and related multimedia software. It operates through the following segments: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and Compute & Networking. The Graphics segment includes GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service and related infrastructure, Quadro and NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics, virtual GPU, or vGPU, software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing, automotive platforms for infotainment systems, and Omniverse Enterprise software for building and operating metaverse and 3D internet applications. The Compute & Networking segment consists of Data Center accelerated computing platforms and end-to-end networking platforms including Quantum for InfiniBand and Spectrum for Ethernet, NVIDIA DRIVE automated-driving platform and automotive development agreements, Jetson robotics and other embedded platforms, NVIDIA AI Enterprise and other software, and DGX Cloud software and services. The company was founded by Jen Hsun Huang, Chris A. Malachowsky, and Curtis R. Priem in April 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: NVIDIA Corp. 從事電腦圖形處理器、晶片組和相關多媒體軟體的設計和製造。它透過以下部分運作：圖形處理單元（GPU）和運算與網路。圖形部分包括用於遊戲和 PC 的 GeForce GPU、GeForce NOW 遊戲串流服務和相關基礎設施、用於企業工作站圖形的 Quadro 和 NVIDIA RTX GPU、虛擬 GPU 或 vGPU、用於基於雲端的視覺和虛擬計算的軟體、用於資訊娛樂系統的汽車平台以及用於構建和操作 Metaverse 和 3D 互聯網應用程式設計的公司。運算和網路部門包括資料中心加速運算平台和端對端網路平台，包括InfiniBand的Quantum和乙太網路的Spectrum、NVIDIA DRIVE自動駕駛平台和汽車開發協定、Jetson機器人和其他嵌入式平台、NVIDIA AI Enterprise和其他軟體以及DGX Cloud軟體和服務。該公司由 Jen Hsun Huang、Chris A. Malachowsky 和 ​​Curtis R. Priem 於 1993 年 4 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Qualys, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud security and compliance solutions. Its products enable organizations to identify security risks to information technology infrastructures, help protect information technology systems and applications from cyber attacks, and achieve compliance with internal policies and external regulations. The firm also offers solutions through a software-as-a-service model, primarily with renewable annual subscriptions. The company was founded on December 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Qualys, Inc. 致力於提供雲端安全性和合規性解決方案。其產品使組織能夠識別資訊技術基礎設施的安全風險，幫助保護資訊科技系統和應用程式免受網路攻擊，並實現內部政策和外部法規的合規性。該公司還透過軟體即服務模式提供解決方案，主要採用可更新的年度訂閱。該公司成立於1999年12月30日，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: The E.W. Scripps Co. engages in television and newspaper publishing. It operates through the following business segments: Local Media, Scripps Networks, and Other. The Local Media segment consists of local broadcast television stations and their related digital operations. The Scripps Networks segment consists of national television networks. The company was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: E.W. Scripps Co. 從事電視和報紙出版。它透過以下業務部門運作：本地媒體、史克里普斯網路和其他。本地媒體部門由本地廣播電視台及其相關數位業務組成。史克里普斯網路部門由全國電視網組成。該公司成立於 1878 年，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. engages in the provision of robotic-assisted surgical solutions and invasive care through a comprehensive ecosystem of products and services. Its products include Da Vinci Surgical and Ion Endoluminal systems. The company was founded by Frederic H. Moll, John Gordon Freund, and Robert G. Younge in November 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 透過全面的產品和服務生態系統提供機器人輔助手術解決方案和侵入性護理。其產品包括達文西手術系統和離子腔內系統。該公司由 Frederic H. Moll、John Gordon Freund 和 Robert G. Younge 於 1995 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: CXApp, Inc. engages in the provision of workplace experience solutions. Its solutions are used in workplace experience, employee engagement, desk and meeting room reservations, workplace analytics, occupancy management, content delivery, corporate communications and notifications, event management, live indoor mapping, and wayfinding and navigation. The company was founded on September 19, 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: CXApp, Inc. 致力於提供工作場所體驗解決方案。其解決方案用於工作場所體驗、員工敬業度、辦公桌和會議室預訂、工作場所分析、佔用管理、內容交付、企業通訊和通知、活動管理、即時室內測繪以及尋路和導航。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 19 日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a diversified portfolio of convertible securities and high yield corporate bonds rated Ba or lower by Moody's or BB or lower by Standard & Poor's. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund was formed on March 12, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。其主要投資於穆迪評級為Ba或更低、標準普爾評級為BB或更低的可轉換證券和高收益公司債券的多元化投資組合。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund 成立於 2003 年 3 月 12 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: High Tide, Inc. is a retail-focused cannabis company, which engages in the manufacturing and distribution of consumption accessories. It operates through the following segments: Bricks-and-Mortar, E-Commerce, and Medical Cannabis Distribution. The Bricks-and-Mortar segment refers to Canadian warehouse which supports the distribution of accessories. The E-Commerce segment includes U.S and international subsidiaries. The company was founded by Harkirat Grover in 2009 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: High Tide, Inc. 是一家專注於零售的大麻公司，從事消費配件的製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：實體部門、電子商務部門和醫用大麻分銷部門。實體部分是指支援配件分銷的加拿大倉庫。電子商務部門包括美國和國際子公司。該公司由 Harkirat Grover 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLE Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the energy sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLE 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大型股票市場能源產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics for patients with rare diseases. The firm offers IMCIVREE (setmelanotide), a precision medicine designed to treat hyperphagia and severe obesity caused by rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) diseases. It is also involved in the clinical development program for setmelanotide in other rare MC4R pathway diseases, as well as a preclinical suite of investigational candidates for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism. The company was founded by Bart Henderson in November 2008 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者治療藥物的開發和商業化。該公司提供 IMCIVREE（setmelanotide），這是一種精準藥物，旨在治療由罕見的黑皮質素 4 受體（MC4R）疾病引起的食慾過盛和嚴重肥胖。它還參與了 setmelanotide 在其他罕見 MC4R 通路疾病中的臨床開發計劃，以及用於治療先天性高胰島素血症的臨床前研究候選藥物套件。該公司由 Bart Henderson 於 2008 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: iShares Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Biotechnology Index composed of U.S.-listed equities in the biotechnology sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Biotechnology ETF 旨在追蹤由美國上市生技產業股票組成的 ICE 生技指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Nasdaq Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market capitalization weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical companies. The index may include securities of large-, mid- and small-capitalization companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順納斯達克生物技術 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克生物技術指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。納斯達克嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制基礎指數，這是一種修改後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量在納斯達克股票市場上市的生物技術或製藥公司證券的業績。該指數可能包括大、中、小型公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and market of instruments and disposable products utilized in healthcare, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, medical device, and petrochemical industries. It operates through the following segments: Sterilization and Disinfection Control, Clinical Genomics, Biopharmaceutical Development, and Calibration Solutions. The Sterilization and Disinfection Control segment manufactures and sells biological, cleaning, and chemical indicators. The Clinical Genomics segment division develops, manufactures and sells highly sensitive, low-cost, high-throughput genetic analysis tools and related consumables and services that enable clinical research labs and contract research organizations. The Biopharmaceutical Development segment caters and sells automated systems for protein analysis and peptide synthesis solutions. The Calibration Solutions segment focuses on the quality control products using principles of advanced metrology to enable customers to measure and calibrate critical parameters in applications such as renal care, environmental and process monitoring, gas flow, air quality and torque testing, primarily in medical device manufacturing, pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory and hospital environments. The company was founded by Luke R. Schmieder on March 26, 1982 and is headquartered in Lakewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. 從事醫療保健、製藥、食品和飲料、醫療器材和石化行業所用儀器和一次性產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：滅菌和消毒控制、臨床基因組學、生物製藥開發和校準解決方案。滅菌和消毒控制部門生產和銷售生物、清潔和化學指示器。臨床基因組學部門開發、製造和銷售高靈敏度、低成本、高通量的基因分析工具以及相關耗材和服務，為臨床研究實驗室和合約研究組織提供支援。生物製藥開發部門提供和銷售用於蛋白質分析和勝肽合成解決方案的自動化系統。校準解決方案部門專注於使用先進計量原理的品質控制產品，使客戶能夠測量和校準腎臟護理、環境和過程監測、氣流、空氣品質和扭矩測試等應用中的關鍵參數，主要在醫療器械製造、藥品製造、實驗室和醫院環境中。該公司由 Luke R. Schmieder 於 1982 年 3 月 26 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州萊克伍德。

info.description: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, depositary receipts such as American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") and European Depositary Receipts ("EDRs"), Real Estate Investment Trusts ("REITs"), and interests in other investment companies, including other exchange-traded funds that invest in equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於非美國公司的股本證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證（「GDR」）和歐洲存託憑證（「EDR」）等存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）以及其他投資公司的權益，包括其他投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金。

info.description: Turn Therapeutics, Inc. is a pharmaceutical and medical device development company. Its primary development programs focus on dermatological diseases. The company was founded by Bradley Burnam on January 6, 2015 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Turn Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家製藥和醫療設備開發公司。其主要開發計劃側重於皮膚病。該公司由 Bradley Burnam 於 2015 年 1 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: iShares Transition-Enabling Metals ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Clean Energy Transition Metals Index. The index measures the performance of a basket of exchange-traded metals futures contracts representing the underlying metals that are extensively used in a wide range of clean energy technologies, as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets, plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the same or similar metals futures contracts as the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Transition-Eabling Metals ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 清潔能源過渡金屬指數的投資結果。該指數衡量一籃子交易所交易的金屬期貨合約的表現，這些合約代表了由 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的廣泛用於各種清潔能源技術的基礎金屬。該基金將至少 80% 的資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於與標的指數相同或相似的金屬期貨合約。

info.description: Global X Telemedicine & Digital Health ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Telemedicine & Digital Health Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of telemedicine and digital health, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Telemedicine & Digital Health Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the index. The Adviser uses a "passive" or indexing approach to try to achieve the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 遠距醫療和數位健康 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 遠距醫療和數位健康指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於遠距醫療和數位健康及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「遠距醫療和數位健康公司」），正如指數提供者 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。顧問使用「被動」或指數化方法來嘗試實現基金的投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Simplify Tax Aware Alternatives ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation by employing an unconstrained alternatives investment approach targeting asset classes with low correlation to traditional domestic equities and fixed income. The fund utilizes a flexible, opportunistic tactical allocation strategy to deploy its portfolio across global commodities, currencies, real estate related securities, specialized alternative ETFs, and privately offered debt, primarily executing these exposures via total return swaps and derivative instruments backed by U.S. Government short-term collateral.
info.description_zh: Simplify Tax Aware Alternatives ETF 尋求透過採用不受約束的另類投資方法來實現長期資本增值，目標是與傳統國內股票和固定收益相關性較低的資產類別。該基金採用靈活、機會主義的戰術配置策略，將其投資組合部署在全球大宗商品、貨幣、房地產相關證券、專門另類 ETF 和私募債務中，主要透過總回報掉期和由美國政府短期抵押品支持的衍生工具來執行這些風險敞口。

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ex U.S. ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index composed of large- and mid-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: Cisco Systems, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of Internet Protocol-based networking products and services related to the communications and information technology industry. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: the Americas, EMEA, and APJC. Its products include the following categories: Secure, Agile Networks, Internet for the Future, Collaboration, End-to-End Security, Optimized Application Experiences, and Other Products. The company was founded by Sandra Lerner and Leonard Bosack in 1984 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Cisco Systems, Inc. 從事與通訊和資訊科技產業相關的基於互聯網協定的網路產品和服務的設計、製造和銷售。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太及日本地區。其產品包括以下類別：安全性、敏捷網路、未來網路、協作、端到端安全、優化應用體驗和其他產品。該公司由 Sandra Lerner 和 Leonard Bosack 於 1984 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Small Cap AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Small Cap Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 新興市場小型股 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場小型股指數的股票指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Universal Display Corp. engages in the business of researching, developing, and commercializing organic light emitting diode technologies and materials for use in display and solid-state lighting applications. The company was founded by Sherwin I. Seligsohn on April 24, 1985 and is headquartered in Ewing, NJ.
info.description_zh: Universal Display Corp. 從事用於顯示器和固態照明應用的有機發光二極體技術和材料的研究、開發和商業化業務。該公司由 Sherwin I. Seligsohn 於 1985 年 4 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州尤因。

info.description: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Japan Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 日本指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克日本指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases. The company was founded on July 22, 1980 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療罕見疾病的療法。該公司成立於1980年7月22日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Bionano Genomics, Inc. is a life sciences instrumentation company, which focuses on the genome analysis space. The firm engages in the development and marketing of the Saphyr system, a platform for ultra-sensitive and ultra-specific structural variation detection that enables researchers and clinicians to accelerate the search for new diagnostics and therapeutic targets and to streamline cytogenetics. Its products include Saphyr, Bionano Chips, Bionano Prep Kits, and Bionano Data Solutions. The company was founded by Han Cao in January 2003 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Bionano Genomics, Inc. 是一家生命科學儀器公司，專注於基因組分析領域。該公司從事 Saphyr 系統的開發和行銷，該系統是一個超靈敏和超特異性結構變異檢測平台，使研究人員和臨床醫生能夠加速尋找新的診斷和治療標靶並簡化細胞遺傳學。其產品包括 Saphyr、Bionano 晶片、Bionano 製備套件和 Bionano 數據解決方案。該公司由曹韓於2003年1月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Netskope, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud based security solutions. It offers business developing analytics for visibility, policy enforcement and other cloud solutions. Its products include Netskope one SASE, Netskope one SSE, cloud access security broker, next generation secure web gateway, private access, cloud firewall, SD-WAN and skopeAI.
