The company was founded by Sanjay Beri, Lebin Cheng, Ravishankar Ithal, and Krishna Narayanaswamy in October 2012 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Netskope, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的安全解決方案。它為業務開發分析提供可見性、策略執行和其他雲端解決方案。其產品包括Netskope one SASE、Netskope one SSE、雲端存取安全代理、新一代安全Web網關、私有存取、雲端防火牆、SD-WAN和skopeAI。該公司由 Sanjay Beri、Lebin Cheng、Ravishankar Ithal 和 Krishna Narayanaswamy 於 2012 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。

info.description: Korro Bio, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of a new class of genetic medicines based on editing RNA. The company was founded by Nessan Bermingham, Jean-Francois B. Formela, Joshua Rosenthal, and Andrew Fraley in 2018 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Korro Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於基於 RNA 編輯的新型基因藥物的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Nessan Bermingham、Jean-Francois B. Formela、Joshua Rosenthal 和 Andrew Fraley 於 2018 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a semiconductor solution provider dedicated to display imaging processing technologies. It operates through the Driver Integrated Circuit and Non-Driver Products segments. The company's products include display drivers, timing controllers, wafer level optics, video and display technology solutions, liquid crystal over silicon silicon, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor image sensor, and power integrated circuit. Its products used in TVs, laptops, monitors, mobile phones, tablets, digital cameras, car navigation, virtual reality (VR) devices and many other consumer electronics devices. Himax Technologies was founded by Biing Seng Wu and Jordan Wu on June 12, 2001 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 奇景光電 (Himax Technologies, Inc.) 是一家致力於顯示影像處理技術的半導體解決方案供應商。它透過驅動器積體電路和非驅動器產品部門運作。該公司的產品包括顯示驅動器、時序控制器、晶圓級光學元件、視訊和顯示技術解決方案、矽基液晶、互補金屬氧化物半導體影像感測器和功率集成電路。其產品應用於電視、筆記型電腦、顯示器、手機、平板電腦、數位相機、汽車導航、虛擬實境（VR）設備和許多其他消費性電子設備。奇景科技由 Bing Seng Wu 和 Jordan Wu 於 2001 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於台灣台南。

info.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of a class of RNA-targeting therapeutics for upregulating gene expression and restoration of healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases. Its lead product candidate is CMP-002. The company was founded by Richard A. Young and Leonard Zon in 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發一類 RNA 標靶療法，用於上調基因表現和恢復健康蛋白質水平，以治療多種遺傳疾病。其主要候選產品為 CMP-002。該公司由 Richard A. Young 和 Leonard Zon 於 2015 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: DraftKings, Inc. is a digital sports entertainment and gaming company, which engages in the provision of online sports betting, online casino, daily fantasy sports product offerings, DraftKings Marketplace, retail sportsbook, media, and other consumer product offerings. The company was founded by Jason D. Robins, Matthew Kalish, and Paul Liberman on December 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: DraftKings, Inc.是一家數位運動娛樂和遊戲公司，從事提供線上體育博彩、線上賭場、每日夢幻體育產品、DraftKings Marketplace、零售體育博彩、媒體和其他消費性產品。該公司由 Jason D. Robins、Matthew Kalish 和 Paul Liberman 於 2011 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests in securities to provide dynamic exposure to developed and emerging markets countries. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of issuers economically tied to countries other than the United States and derivatives that provide investment exposure to such securities or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金投資於證券，為已開發和新興市場國家提供動態投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於與美國以外國家有經濟聯繫的發行人的證券以及提供此類證券或與此類證券相關的一項或多項市場風險因素投資的衍生品。

info.description: Mesoblast Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and market of mesenchymal lineage adult stem cell technology platform. Its medicines target cardiovascular diseases, spine orthopedic disorders, oncology and hematology, immune-mediated, and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Silviu Itescu on June 8, 2004 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Mesoblast Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，從事間質成體幹細胞技術平台的研發和銷售。其藥物針對心血管疾病、脊椎骨科疾病、腫瘤學和血液學、免疫介導疾病和發炎性疾病。該公司由Silviu Itescu於2004年6月8日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Rigel Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biotechnology company. It discovers and develops novel, targeted drugs in the therapeutic areas of immunology, oncology and immune oncology. The firm focuses on intracellular signalling pathways and related targets that are critical to disease mechanisms. The company's products include Tavalisse, Fostamatinib and R835. Rigel Pharmaceuticals was founded by Donald G. Payan, James M. Gower, Thomas A. Raffin, Garry P. Nolan and Ronald B. Garren on June 14, 1996 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Rigel Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。它在免疫學、腫瘤學和免疫腫瘤學治療領域發現和開發新型標靶藥物。該公司專注於對疾病機制至關重要的細胞內訊號通路和相關標靶。該公司的產品包括Tavalisse、Fostamatinib和R835。 Rigel Pharmaceuticals 由 Donald G. Payan、James M. Gower、Thomas A. Raffin、Garry P. Nolan 和 Ronald B. Garren 於 1996 年 6 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company developing MasterKey therapies that target families of oncogenic mutations in patients with cancer. The company's MasterKey therapies are designed to address a broad spectrum of genetically defined tumors, overcome resistance, minimize wild-type-mediated toxicities, and be brain-penetrant to treat central nervous system diseases. It is currently focused on advancing a Phase 2 NSCLC trial of BDTX-1535, a brain-penetrant, fourth-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) MasterKey inhibitor targeting EGFR-mutant NSCLC and glioblastoma. The company was founded by David M. Epstein and Elizabeth Buck in 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤學公司，開發針對癌症患者致癌突變家族的 MasterKey 療法。該公司的 MasterKey 療法旨在解決廣泛的基因定義的腫瘤，克服抗藥性，最大限度地減少野生型介導的毒性，並具有腦滲透性以治療中樞神經系統疾病。該公司目前專注於推進 BDTX-1535 的 2 期 NSCLC 試驗，BDTX-1535 是一種針對 EGFR 突變 NSCLC 和膠質母細胞瘤的腦滲透性第四代表皮生長因子受體 (EGFR) MasterKey 抑制劑。該公司由 David M. Epstein 和 Elizabeth Buck 於 2014 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Nationwide Nasdaq-100 Risk-Managed Income ETF seeks current income with downside protection. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective principally by investing in a portfolio of the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index and an options collar (i.e., a mix of written (sold) call options and long (bought) put options) on the Nasdaq-100. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the fund's reference index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 全國 Nasdaq-100 風險管理收益 ETF 尋求具有下行保護的當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過投資於納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票組合和納斯達克 100 指數的選擇權項圈（即書面（賣出）買權和多頭（買入）看跌選擇權的組合）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於基金參考指數中包含的公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Uber Technologies, Inc. is a technology platform, which engages in the development and operation of technology applications, networks, and product to power movement from point A to point B. The firm offers ride services and merchants delivery service providers for meal preparation, grocery, and other delivery services. It operates through the following segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment refers to products that connect consumers with mobility drivers who provide rides in a variety of vehicles, such as cars, auto rickshaws, motorbikes, minibuses, and taxis. The Delivery segment offers consumers the chance to search for and discover local restaurants, order a meal, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have the meal delivered. The Freight segment focuses on connecting carriers with shippers on its platform, and gives carriers upfront, transparent pricing, and the ability to book a shipment. The company was founded by Oscar Salazar Gaitan, Travis Kalanick, and Garrett Camp in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Uber Technologies, Inc.是一家技術平台，從事技術應用程式、網路和產品的開發和運營，以推動從A點到B點的移動。該公司提供乘車服務和商家送貨服務提供商，提供膳食準備、雜貨和其他送貨服務。它透過以下部門運作：移動、交付和貨運。移動出行領域是指將消費者與移動司機聯繫起來的產品，這些司機提供各種車輛的乘車服務，例如汽車、人力車、摩托車、小巴和計程車。外帶部分為消費者提供了搜尋和發現當地餐廳、訂餐以及在餐廳取餐或送貨上門的機會。貨運部門專注於在其平台上連接承運商與托運人，並為承運商提供預付款、透明的定價以及預訂貨運的能力。該公司由 Oscar Salazar Gaitan、Travis Kalanick 和 Garrett Camp 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Agora, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of real-time engagement through online platforms. It operates through the following geographical segments: People's Republic of China, United States, and Others. The company was founded by Tony Zhao and Tony Wang in November 2013 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Agora, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於透過線上平台提供即時互動。它透過以下地理區域運作：中華人民共和國、美國和其他地區。該公司由托尼·趙和托尼·王於2013年11月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: First Trust Global Tactical Commodity Strategy Fund seeks to provide total return by providing investors with commodity exposure while seeking a relatively stable risk profile. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve attractive risk adjusted returns by investing in commodity futures contracts, exchange-traded commodity linked instruments, and commodity linked total return swaps (collectively, "Commodities Instruments") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). The advisor expects to gain exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary.
info.description_zh: First Trust全球戰術商品策略基金旨在透過為投資者提供商品曝險來提供總回報，同時尋求相對穩定的風險狀況。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過根據開曼群島法律組成的基金全資子公司（「子公司」）投資於商品期貨合約、交易所交易商品掛鉤工具和商品掛鉤總收益互換（統稱「商品工具」），從而獲得有吸引力的風險調整回報。顧問希望僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。

info.description: Alico, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operations of agriculture, land management, and natural resources. It operates through the Alico Citrus, and Land Management and Other Operations segments. The Alico Citrus segment cultivates citrus trees to produce citrus for delivery to the processed and fresh citrus markets. The Land Management and Other Operations segment offers land leasing for recreational and grazing purposes, conservation, and mining activities. The company was founded on February 29, 1960 and is headquartered in Fort Myers, FL.
info.description_zh: Alico, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事農業、土地管理和自然資源業務。它透過 Alico Citrus 以及土地管理和其他營運部門進行運作。 Alico Citrus 部門種植柑橘樹來生產柑橘，然後運送到加工和新鮮柑橘市場。土地管理和其他營運部門提供娛樂和放牧、保護和採礦活動的土地租賃。該公司成立於 1960 年 2 月 29 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁爾斯堡。

info.description: Wynn Resorts Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, and operation of destination casino resorts. It operates through the following segments: Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau, Las Vegas Operations, Encore Boston Harbor, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded by Stephen Alan Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn, and Kazuo Okada in 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 永利度假村有限公司是一家控股公司，從事目的地賭場度假村的設計、開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：永利皇宮部門、永利澳門部門、拉斯維加斯業務部門、安可波士頓港部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由 Stephen Alan Wynn、Elaine P. Wynn 和 Kazuo Okada 於 2002 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: The Elmet Group Co. engages in the provision of precision-engineered components. The firm offers its products and solutions to aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, semiconductor, electronics, energy industry and also the government. It operates through the Critical Materials Components and Engineered Microwave Products business divisions. The company was founded on September 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Portland, ME.
info.description_zh: Elmet Group Co. 從事提供精密設計的零件。該公司為航空航太、國防、工業、醫療、半導體、電子、能源產業以及政府提供產品和解決方案。它透過關鍵材料組件和工程微波產品業務部門運作。該公司成立於2024年9月13日，總部位於緬因州波特蘭。

info.description: SMI 3Fourteen REAL Asset Allocation ETF seeks total return. The fund is actively managed and allocates its portfolio assets among three asset categories - stocks, bonds, and alternatives. Portfolio assets are chosen using the REAL Asset Allocation ("RAA") strategy developed by an affiliate of the Adviser, 3Fourteen Research, LLC. The RAA strategy is based on a proprietary model that dynamically allocates the portfolio into three broad categories of asset classes: Stocks, Bonds, and Alternatives. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SMI 3Fourteen REAL 資產配置 ETF 追求總報酬。該基金採用主動管理方式，將其投資組合資產分配到股票、債券和另類資產三個類別。投資組合資產是使用顧問附屬公司 3Fourteen Research, LLC 開發的真實資產分配（「RAA」）策略來選擇的。 RAA 策略基於專有模型，該模型將投資組合動態分配為三大類資產類別：股票、債券和另類投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of stocks issued by companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the FTSE Global All Cap ex US Index, a float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted index designed to measure equity market performance of companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The fund invests all, or substantially all, of its assets in the common stocks included in its target index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤基準指數的表現，該指數衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司發行的股票的投資回報。該管理公司採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤富時全球全盤指數（美國除外）的表現，該指數是一種流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司的股票市場表現。該基金將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於其目標指數中包含的普通股。

info.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a global biotechnology company, which engages in the business of discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing small molecule drugs for patients with serious diseases. The firm focuses on development and commercializing therapies for the treatment of cystic fibrosis, infectious diseases including viral infections such as influenza and bacterial infections, autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, cancer, inflammatory bowel disease and neurological disorders including pain and multiple sclerosis. The company was founded by Joshua S. Boger in 1989 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Vertex Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家全球生技公司，從事為嚴重疾病患者發現、開發、製造和商業化小分子藥物的業務。該公司專注於開發和商業化用於治療囊性纖維化、傳染病（包括流感和細菌感染等病毒感染）、自體免疫疾病（如類風濕性關節炎、癌症、發炎性腸道疾病和神經系統疾病（包括疼痛和多發性硬化症））的療法。該公司由 Joshua S. Boger 於 1989 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Communications ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive communications companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性通訊 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性通訊公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Optimum Yield Diversified Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the world's most heavily traded commodities. Commodities are assets that have tangible properties, such as oil, agricultural produce or raw metals.
info.description_zh: 景順最佳收益多元化商品策略No K-1 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資與全球交易最頻繁的商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。商品是具有有形財產的資產，例如石油、農產品或原料金屬。

info.description: Pono Capital Four, Inc. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 2, 2026 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, KY.
info.description_zh: Pono Capital Four, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。該公司成立於2026年1月2日，總部位於肯塔基州大開曼島。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified strategy designed to deliver consistent monthly income and total return by combining a long equity portfolio of Nasdaq-listed stocks with a proprietary options overlay. The fund utilizes a data science-driven investment approach to construct its equity holdings while selling call option spreads to generate premiums, aiming to provide a significant portion of the Nasdaq 100 Index's returns with lower overall volatility.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收益 ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化策略，旨在透過將納斯達克上市股票的長期股票投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供穩定的每月收入和總回報。該基金利用數據科學驅動的投資方法來建立其股票持有量，同時出售看漲期權價差以產生溢價，旨在以較低的整體波動性提供納斯達克100指數回報的很大一部分。

info.description: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax (but may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax). It normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the Fidelity Systematic U.S. Municipal Bond IndexSM, which aims to increase exposure to municipal bonds with higher risk-adjusted performance and liquidity characteristics relative to traditional market-capitalization weighted U.S. investment grade municipal bond indices.
info.description_zh: 富達系統市政債券指數 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅（但可能需繳納聯邦替代性最低稅）。它通常將至少80%的資產投資於富達系統美國市政債券指數SM中包含的證券，該指數旨在增加對相對於傳統市值加權美國投資級市政債券指數具有更高風險調整表現和流動性特徵的市政債券的投資。

info.description: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops precision therapies for genetically-defined cancer patients with mTOR pathway driver alterations such as alterations in TSC1 or TSC2 genes. The company was founded by Neil Desai in November 2007 and is headquartered in Morristown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它為具有 mTOR 路徑驅動改變（例如 TSC1 或 TSC2 基因改變）的基因定義癌症患者開發精準療法。該公司由 Neil Desai 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯敦。

info.description: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月24日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. Its business objective is purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 01, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。其業務目標是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組。該公司成立於2025年8月1日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBoost PLTR ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Palantir Technologies Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: PLTR) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBoost PLTR ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收入是透過出售 Palantir Technologies Inc. 普通股（NASDAQ:PLTR）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現基礎股票每日表現的 2 倍（200%），並獲得基礎槓桿的表現上限。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM"), the investment adviser to the fund, seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing the fund's assets based on a model portfolio provided by Bridgewater Associates, LP (the "Sub-Adviser" or "Bridgewater"), the investment sub-adviser to the fund.
info.description_zh: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。 SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（下稱「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）是該基金的投資顧問，旨在透過根據該基金的投資副顧問 Bridgewater Associates, LP（下稱「副顧問」或「Bridgewater」）提供的模型投資組合來投資基金資產，從而實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: T.Rowe Price Short Municipal Income ETF seeks high current income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 短期市政收入 ETF 尋求免除聯邦所得稅的高額當前收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Invesco KBW High Dividend Yield Financial ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Financial Sector Dividend Yield IndexTM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-dividend yield-weighted index of companies principally engaged in the business of providing financial services and products, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of financial companies with competitive dividend yields that are publicly-traded in the U.S.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW 高股息殖利率金融 ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克金融部門股息殖利率指數™（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事提供金融服務和產品業務的公司的修正股息殖利率加權指數。該指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易、股息殖利率具有競爭力的金融公司的表現。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2029 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2029. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2029 and December 15, 2029, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2029 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2029 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2029 年 1 月 1 日至 2029 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Nebius Group NV is a technology company that provides infrastructure and services to AI builders worldwide. It offers Nebius AI, an AI-centric cloud platform provides full-stack infrastructure, including large-scale GPU clusters, cloud services, and developer tools. The company also operates through specialized brands: Toloka AI, which partners in data for generative AI development; TripleTen, an edtech platform focused on re-skilling individuals for tech careers; and Avride, which develops autonomous driving technology. Nebius Group was founded by Elena Kolmanovskaya, Ilya Segalovich, Mikhail Fadeev, and Arkady Volozh in 1989 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Nebius Group NV 是一家為全球人工智慧建構者提供基礎設施和服務的科技公司。 Nebius AI是一個以AI為中心的雲端平台，提供全端基礎設施，包括大規模GPU叢集、雲端服務和開發者工具。該公司還透過專業品牌運營：Toloka AI，與生成人工智慧開發的數據合作； TripleTen，一個教育技術平台，專注於為個人提供技術職業再培訓；以及開發自動駕駛技術的 Avride。 Nebius 集團由 Elena Kolmanovskaya、Ilya Segalovich、Mikhail Fadeev 和 Arkady Volozh 於 1989 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Walmart, Inc. engages in the retail and wholesale business. The company offers an assortment of merchandise and services at everyday low prices. It operates through the following business segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International, and Sam's Club. The Walmart U.S. segment operates as a mass merchandiser of consumer products, operating under the Walmart and Walmart Neighborhood Market brands, including walmart.com. The Walmart International segment includes operations of wholly-owned subsidiaries in Canada, Chile, China, and Africa, and majority-owned subsidiaries in India, as well as Mexico and Central America. The Sam's Club segment manages membership-only warehouse clubs and operates samsclub.com. The company was founded by Samuel Moore Walton and James Lawrence Walton on July 2, 1962 and is headquartered in Bentonville, AR.
info.description_zh: 沃爾瑪公司從事零售和批發業務。該公司以每日低價提供各種商品和服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：沃爾瑪美國公司、沃爾瑪國際公司和山姆會員店。沃爾瑪美國部門是一家消費性產品批發商，以沃爾瑪和沃爾瑪鄰里市場品牌經營，包括 walmart.com。沃爾瑪國際部門包括在加拿大、智利、中國和非洲的全資子公司以及在印度、墨西哥和中美洲的控股子公司。山姆會員店部門管理會員制倉儲俱樂部並經營 samsclub.com。該公司由 Samuel Moore Walton 和 James Lawrence Walton 於 1962 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於阿肯色州本頓維爾。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Addex Therapeutics Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drugs for human health. It develops novel, orally available, and small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders. Its pipeline includes Dipraglurant, ADX71149, GABAB PAM, mGlu7 NAM, mGlu2 NAM, mGlu4 PAM, and mGlu3 PAM. The company was founded by Vincent Mutel, Timothy Dyer, and Mark Epping-Jordan in 2002 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Addex Therapeutics Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於人類健康藥物的開發。它開發用於神經系統疾病的新型口服小分子變構調節劑。其管道包括 Dipraglurant、ADX71149、GABAB PAM、mGlu7 NAM、mGlu2 NAM、mGlu4 PAM 和 mGlu3 PAM。該公司由 Vincent Mutel、Timothy Dyer 和 Mark Epping-Jordan 於 2002 年創立，總部位於瑞士日內瓦。

info.description: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. engages in building a broadband cellular network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on an intellectual property and patent portfolio. It focuses on providing mobile broadband services with global coverage to all end-users, without the need to purchase special equipment. The company was founded by Abel Avellan on May 31, 2017 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.description_zh: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. 致力於在太空中建立寬頻蜂窩網絡，以便直接使用基於智慧財產權和專利組合的標準、未經修改的行動裝置進行操作。它專注於向所有最終用戶提供覆蓋全球的行動寬頻服務，而無需購買特殊設備。該公司由 Abel Avellan 於 2017 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp. is a technology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of retail smart cart solutions for large grocery stores and supermarkets. It operates through the Smart Carts and Precision Metal Parts segments. The Smart Carts segment offers retail automation solutions. Its platform enables seamless in-cart scanning and payment, allowing shoppers to bypass checkout lines while receiving real-time customized offers and product recommendations. The Precision Metal Parts segment includes the manufacturing and sale of precision metal parts. The company was founded by Joseph Bentsur on January 15, 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp.是一家科技公司，致力於大型雜貨店和超市的零售智慧購物車解決方案的開發和商業化。它通过智能推车和精密金属零件部门运营。智能手推车部门提供零售自动化解决方案。其平台支持无缝购物车扫描和支付，让购物者绕过结账队伍，同时接收实时定制优惠和产品推荐。精密金属零件部门包括精密金属零件的制造和销售。该公司由Joseph Bentsur于2018年1月15日创立，总部位于加拿大温哥华。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部门包括与勇敢者棒球特许经营权和Truist Park相关的业务，包括门票销售、特许权、当地广播权、广告赞助、套房和高级座位费、零售和许可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括国家广播权和许可）以及其他来源产生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亚特兰大炮台的收入主要来自办公室和零售租金收入，包括超额租金和租户报销，以及较小程度的停车和广告赞助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Broadwind, Inc. engages in the manufacture of structures, equipment, and components for power generation, critical infrastructure, and other specialized applications. It operates through the following business segments: Heavy Fabrications, Gearing, Industrial Solutions, and Corporate and Other. The Heavy Fabrications segment provides fabrications to customers in industrial markets. The Gearing segment provides gearing, gearboxes, and precision machined components to customers in onshore and offshore oil and gas (O&G) fracking and drilling, surface and underground mining, wind energy, steel, material handling and other industrial markets. The Industrial Solutions segment provides supply chain solutions, light fabrication, inventory management, and kitting and assembly services, primarily serving the combined cycle natural gas turbine market. The Corporate and Other segment includes the assets and SG&A expenses of the Company's corporate office. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Cicero, IL.

info.description_zh: Broadwind, Inc. 從事發電、關鍵基礎設施和其他專業應用的結構、設備和零件的製造。它透過以下業務部門運作：重型製造、齒輪、工業解決方案以及企業和其他。重型製造部門為工業市場的客戶提供製造服務。齒輪部門為陸上和海上石油和天然氣（O&G）壓裂和鑽井、露天和地下採礦、風能、鋼鐵、物料搬運和其他工業市場的客戶提供齒輪、變速箱和精密加工零件。工業解決方案部門提供供應鏈解決方案、輕型製造、庫存管理以及配套和組裝服務，主要服務於聯合循環天然氣渦輪機市場。公司及其他部門包括公司公司辦公室的資產和銷售、一般管理費用。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州西塞羅。

info.description: Camtek Ltd. engages in the business of developing and manufacturing high-end inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. The firm is also involved in inspecting integrated circuits and measuring its features on wafers throughout the production process of semiconductor devices, covering the front and mid-end and up to the beginning of assembly. The company was founded on October 21, 1987 and is headquartered in Migdal HaEmek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Camtek Ltd.從事半導體行業高端檢測和計量設備的開發和製造業務。該公司還參與在整個半導體裝置生產過程中檢查積體電路並測量其在晶圓上的特徵，涵蓋前端和中端直至組裝開始。該公司成立於1987年10月21日，總部位於以色列Migdal HaEmek。

info.description: Chaince Digital Holdings, Inc. engages in provision of financial advisory, capital markets advisory, brokerage-related services, and corporate consulting services to corporate clients and institutional investors globally. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Hong Kong, and People's Republic of China. The company was founded by Mao Dong Xu in 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 暢思數位控股有限公司致力於為全球企業客戶和機構投資者提供財務諮詢、資本市場諮詢、經紀相關服務和企業諮詢服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、香港和中華人民共和國。該公司由毛東徐於2011年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Canopy Growth Corp. engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis and cannabinoid-based products for both adult-use and medical purposes. It operates through the following segments: Cannabis, Storz and Bickel. The Cannabis segment includes the global production, distribution and sale of a diverse range of cannabis and cannabis-related products. The Storz and Bickel segment produces and sells vaporizers. The company was founded by Bruce Linton on August 5, 2009 and is headquartered in Smith Falls, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Canopy Growth Corp. 從事成人使用和醫療用途的大麻和大麻素產品的生產、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：Cannabis、Storz 和 Bickel。大麻部門包括全球生產、分銷和銷售各種大麻和大麻相關產品。 Storz 和 Bickel 部門生產和銷售蒸發器。該公司由 Bruce Linton 於 2009 年 8 月 5 日創立，總部位於加拿大史密斯福爾斯。

info.description: Calamos Global Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund primarily invests in equities, convertible bonds, and high yield corporate bonds. It employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against MSCI World Index. Calamos Global Total Return Fund was formed on March 30, 2004 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Global Total Return Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封闭式平衡共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。该基金投资于全球公共股权和固定收益市场。它寻求投资于多元化行业运营的公司的证券。该基金主要投资于股票、可转换债券和高收益公司债券。它采用基本面分析和定量分析来创建其投资组合。该基金将其投资组合的表现与 MSCI 世界指数进行比较。 Calamos Global Total Return Fund成立于2004年3月30日，注册地为美国。

info.description: Compass Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of proprietary antibody therapeutics. Its platform includes common light chain-focused antibody discovery, human display for antibody tuning, stitchmabs, and highly modular and manufacturable bispecific candidates. The company was founded by Thomas J. Schuetz in 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Compass Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事專有抗體療法的開發。其平台包括常見的以輕鏈為中心的抗體發現、用於抗體調整的人體展示、縫合抗體以及高度模組化和可製造的雙特異性候選物。該公司由 Thomas J. Schuetz 於 2014 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Cohu, Inc. engages in the provision of back-end semiconductor equipment and services. It offers test and handling capital equipment, interface products, and related services to the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cohu, Inc. 從事提供後端半導體設備和服務。它為半導體和電子製造業提供測試和處理資本設備、介面產品以及相關服務。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. engages in the development of connectivity solutions and products for the data infrastructure market. Its products include integrated circuits, active electrical cables, and SerDes chiplets. The company was founded by Chi Fung Cheng and Yat Tung Lam on 2008 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. 致力於為資料基礎設施市場開發連接解決方案和產品。其產品包括積體電路、主動電纜和 SerDes 小晶片。該公司由 Chi Fung Cheng 和 Yat Tung Lam 於 2008 年創立，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Lionheart Holdings operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or other similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 21, 2024 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Lionheart Holdings 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: CuriosityStream, Inc. is a media and entertainment company. It offers video and audio programming across the principal categories of factual entertainment, including science, history, society, nature, lifestyle, and technology. The company was founded by John S. Hendricks on June 06, 2008 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, MD.
info.description_zh: CuriosityStream, Inc. 是一家媒體和娛樂公司。它提供橫跨事實娛樂主要類別的視訊和音訊節目，包括科學、歷史、社會、自然、生活方式和技術。該公司由 John S. Hendricks 於 2008 年 6 月 6 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州銀泉。

info.description: Commvault Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of data protection, information management software applications, and related services. The firm offers platform, solution packages, use cases, and workloads. It operates through the United States and Other geographical segments. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tinton Falls, NJ.
info.description_zh: Commvault Systems, Inc. 從事提供資料保護、資訊管理軟體應用程式和相關服務。該公司提供平台、解決方案包、用例和工作負載。它透過美國和其他地區的部門運作。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於新澤西州廷頓福爾斯。

info.description: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long DELL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Dell Technologies Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long DELL Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為戴爾科技公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The investment strategy combines quantitative screening through a proprietary alpha model with fundamental research to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies across all market capitalizations positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該投資策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型進行定量篩選與基礎研究相結合，建立一個多元化的投資組合，針對所有市值的公司，這些公司定位於可持續盈利增長，並以有吸引力的估值進行積極的盈利修正。

info.description: enCore Energy Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of resource properties. Its projects portfolio includes the Kingsville Dome, Rosita, Vasquez, Butler Ranch in Texas, Crownpoint & Hosta Butte, Nose Rock, Cebolleta, Juan Tafoya, West Largo, Ambrosia Lake-Treeline, Marquez, Checkerboard Mineral Rights in New Mexico, Moonshine Springs in Arizona, and White Canyon District in Utah. The company was founded on October 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Corpus Christi, TX.
info.description_zh: enCore Energy Corp. 從事資源資產的收購和勘探。其項目組合包括德克薩斯州的 Kingsville Dome、Rosita、Vasquez、Butler Ranch、Crownpoint & Hosta Butte、Nose Rock、Cebolleta、Juan Tafoya、West Largo、Ambrosia Lake-Treeline、Marquez、新墨西哥州的 Checkerboard Mineral Rights、亞利桑那州的 White Districtshine Springs 和猶他州的 White Canyon。該公司成立於2009年10月30日，總部位於德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂。

info.description: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM, NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM and NASDAQ US 700 Small Cap Index TM that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求與納斯達克 AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克美國 500 大型股指數 TM、納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM 和納斯達克美國 700 小型股指數 TM 中選擇成長型股票，這些股票相對於傳統指數可能產生正的阿爾法或風險調整回報。

info.description: First Trust Asia Pacific Ex-Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 亞太地區（日本除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 亞太地區（日本除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克亞太（日本除外）指數中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Nomura Transformational Technologies ETF is an actively managed fund targeting capital growth by investing in global technology companies at the forefront of secular shifts and disruptive innovations. The strategy emphasizes a bottom-up stock selection process to identify businesses across any market capitalization that demonstrate high barriers to entry and the potential for rapid earnings growth relative to the broader economy.
info.description_zh: 野村轉型技術 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資處於長期變革和顛覆性創新前沿的全球科技公司來實現資本成長。該策略強調自下而上的選股流程，以識別任何市值的企業，這些企業表現出較高的進入障礙以及相對於更廣泛的經濟而言具有快速盈利增長潛力的企業。

info.description: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF seeks current income; capital appreciation is a secondary objective. The fund will pursue its objectives by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Standard & Poor's 500 Index (the "index"). The call options written by the fund will be a laddered portfolio of call options with expirations of less than one year, written at-the-money to slightly out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求當前收益；資本增值是次要目標。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股票證券並利用「選擇權策略」來實現其目標，該策略包括賣出（出售）標準普爾 500 指數（「指數」）的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金賣出的買權將是到期日不到一年的階梯式買權投資組合，賣出選擇權為平價至輕微虛值。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond to the price and yield of an index called the Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs that the index determines offer the greatest potential to outperform the other First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF 尋求與名為 Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 5 個 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的有針對性的投資，該指數認為這些 ETF 具有超越其他 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII is a blank check company. The firm was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII 是一家空白支票公司。該公司的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cove。

info.description: Hingham Institution for Savings provides community banking services. It is involved in the business of commercial and residential real estate mortgage lending, funded by retail deposits, wholesale deposits and borrowings. The company was founded in 1834 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: 辛厄姆儲蓄機構提供社區銀行服務。它從事商業和住宅房地產抵押貸款業務，資金來源包括零售存款、批發存款和借款。該公司成立於 1834 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: Immuneering Corp. operates as a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in developing medicines for cancer patients. Its pipeline of drug candidates focuses on treating aspects of disease that have eluded conventional approaches, including cancer cachexia and metastasis. The company was founded by Robert J. Carpenter and Benjamin J. Zeskind in 2008 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Immuneering Corp. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於為癌症患者開發藥物。其候選藥物的研發重點是治療傳統方法無法解決的疾病，包括癌症惡病質和轉移。該公司由 Robert J. Carpenter 和 Benjamin J. Zeskind 於 2008 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Immunic, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which develops a pipeline of selective oral immunology therapies aimed at treating chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, and psoriasis. The firm's products include IMU-838, IMU-935, and IMU-856. The company was founded in May 2003 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Immunic, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，開發一系列旨在治療慢性發炎和自體免疫疾病的選擇性口服免疫療法。它的重點是潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症、復發緩解型多發性硬化症和牛皮癬。該公司的產品包括 IMU-838、IMU-935 和 IMU-856。該公司成立於2003年5月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which includes a pipeline of novel biologic therapeutic candidates, developed using proprietary modular protein engineering platforms. Its clinical pipeline of therapeutic candidates includes INBRX-109 and INBRX-106, both of which utilize multivalent formats where the precise valency can be optimized in a target-centric way to mediate what is believed to be the most appropriate agonist function. The company was founded by Brendan P. Eckelman on January 8, 2024 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，擁有一系列採用專有模組化蛋白質工程平台開發的新型生物治療候選藥物。其治療候選藥物的臨床管道包括INBRX-109和INBRX-106，這兩種藥物都採用多價形式，可以以標靶為中心的方式優化精確的效價，以介導被認為是最合適的激動劑功能。該公司由 Brendan P. Eckelman 於 2024 年 1 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long IONQ Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of IonQ, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x 多頭 IONQ 每日 ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 IonQ, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long IONQ ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ). The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 IONQ ETF 尋求 IonQ, Inc.（NYSE：IONQ）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: LightPath Technologies, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and distribution of optical and infrared components. Its products include molded glass and assemblies, infrared molded lenses, diamond turned, conventional ground and polished ground lenses and assemblies, and collimator assemblies, which are used in applications involving light detection and ranging technology. The firm supports a range of customers in the field of industrial, laser, defense, medical, telecommunications, and instrumentation. The company was founded in1985 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LightPath Technologies, Inc. 從事光學和紅外線元件的設計、開發、製造和分銷。其產品包括模製玻璃和組件、紅外線模製透鏡、鑽石車削、傳統磨削和拋光磨削透鏡和組件以及準直器組件，這些產品用於涉及光探測和測距技術的應用。該公司為工業、雷射、國防、醫療、電信和儀器儀表領域的眾多客戶提供支援。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Maris-Tech Ltd. engages in the business of developing, designing, and manufacturing digital video and audio products and solutions for the professional, civilian, and home security markets. The firm is also involved in the provision of video transmission technology with artificial intelligence and acceleration for edge platforms using digital video, audio, and wireless communication technologies. The company was founded by Israel Bar in May 2008 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Maris-Tech Ltd. 從事為專業、民用和家庭安全市場開發、設計和製造數位視訊和音訊產品及解決方案的業務。該公司還致力於為使用數位視訊、音訊和無線通訊技術的邊緣平台提供具有人工智慧和加速功能的視訊傳輸技術。該公司由 Israel Bar 於 2008 年 5 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: NextCure, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering and developing immunomedicines to treat cancer and other immune-related diseases. Its novel FIND-IO discovery technology identifies targets based on immunomodulatory function and on which the company is building a proprietary pipeline of immunomedicines. The company was founded by Michael S. Richman and Lie Ping Chen in September 2015 and is headquartered in Beltsville, MD.
info.description_zh: NextCure, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療癌症和其他免疫相關疾病的免疫藥物。其新穎的 FIND-IO 發現技術根據免疫調節功能來識別靶點，並在此基礎上該公司正在建立專有的免疫藥物管道。該公司由 Michael S. Richman 和 Lie Ping Chen 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝爾茨維爾。

info.description: Peace Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 24, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Peace Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Photronics, Inc. engages in the provision of photomasks, which are quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits for use in the fabrication of integrated circuits and flat-panel displays. The company was founded by Constantine S. Macricostas in 1969 and is headquartered in Brookfield, CT.
info.description_zh: Photronics, Inc. 從事提供光掩模業務，光掩模是包含電子電路顯微圖像的石英或玻璃板，用於製造積體電路和平板顯示器。該公司由 Constantine S. Macricostas 於 1969 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州布魯克菲爾德。

info.description: Alpha Architect U.S. Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect美國量化動量ETF尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: Quantinuum Inc. is a quantum computing platform that offers solutions like hardware platforms, developer tools, application libraries and solution-targeted intellectual property ("IP"). The company was founded on January 20, 2026 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantinuum Inc. 是一個量子運算平台，提供硬體平台、開發人員工具、應用程式庫和針對解決方​​案的智慧財產權（「IP」）等解決方案。該公司成立於2026年1月20日，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF seeks total return through current income and long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by: (1) investing in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities designed to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the NASDAQ-100 Index or U.S.-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that seek to track the performance of the index, or both, and (2) utilizing an options-based income strategy implemented through equity-linked notes (ELNs) with exposure to either the index or ETFs tracking the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF 透過當前收入和資本的長期成長尋求總回報。該基金力求透過以下方式實現其投資目標：(1) 投資於旨在追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數或旨在追蹤該指數表現的美國上市交易所交易基金 (ETF) 或兩者的表現（未計費用和開支）的美國股票證券投資組合，以及 (2) 利用透過股票掛鉤的票據 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的基於期權的貨幣策略，並投資於該指數或該指數 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的期權或該指數 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite Index is a benchmark index that measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ-100 Index, and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money NASDAQ-100 Index covered call options. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 備兌買權 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和支出之前，通常與 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現密切對應的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於相關指數的證券。 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite 指數是衡量理論投資組合表現的基準指數，該理論投資組合持有 NASDAQ-100 指數中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或賣出）一系列 1 個月平價 NASDAQ-100 指數擔保看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ 100 Index (the "reference index"), and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money covered call options on the reference index. It generally will use a replication strategy. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF 力求提供與 Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數衡量理論投資組合的表現，該理論投資組合持有納斯達克 100 指數（「參考指數」）中包含的股票投資組合，並「寫入」（或出售）參考指數的一系列一個月平值備兌買權。它通常會使用複製策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. The fund utilizes a proprietary model to identify "Retail Kings"-companies that are favorites or trending leaders in online investor communities-while further vetting them for fundamental resilience and competitive moats.
info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Schmid Group NV provides industrial equipment and services. It operates through following Technical equipment and processes; and Spare parts and services segments. The Technical equipment and processes segment includes mainly the sale of machines including installation and extended warranties. The Spare parts and services segment includes the sale of spare parts as well as services including repairs, modifications of machines and inspections. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Freudenstadt, Germany.
info.description_zh: Schmid Group NV 提供工業設備和服務。它透過以下技術設備和流程運作；備件和服務部門。技術設備和工藝部門主要包括機器銷售，包括安裝和延長保固。備件和服務部門包括備件銷售以及維修、機器改裝和檢查等服務。該公司成立於1864年，總部位於德國弗羅伊登施塔特。

info.description: Super League Enterprise, Inc. creates innovative and immersive entertainment experiences, platform and audience monetization and dynamic content feeding channels across the world's top gaming platforms. Fueled by an insatiable desire to stay on the forefront of this ever-evolving meta landscape, Super League pioneer's proprietary digital solutions provide unparalleled access to the global gaming audience. It also creates vibrant in-game communities through the development of innovative experiences and custom content, delivering powerful opportunities for brands and advertisers to achieve impactful insights, and marketing outcomes with audiences of all ages. The company was founded by John C. Miller, David Steigelfest, and Brett Morris on October 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Super League Enterprise, Inc. 在全球頂級遊戲平台上創造創新和沈浸式娛樂體驗、平台和受眾貨幣化以及動態內容供給管道。在不斷發展的元景觀中保持領先地位的永不滿足的願望的推動下，超級聯賽先鋒的專有數位解決方案為全球遊戲觀眾提供了無與倫比的訪問機會。它還透過開發創新體驗和客製化內容來創建充滿活力的遊戲內社區，為品牌和廣告商提供強大的機會，以獲得有影響力的見解，並為所有年齡段的受眾帶來行銷成果。該公司由 John C. Miller、David Steigelfest 和 Brett Morris 於 2014 年 10 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long SMCI Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Super Micro Computer Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long SMCI Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Super Micro Computer Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SMCI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Super Micro Computer, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMCI"). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by entering into swap agreements on the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SMCI ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，獲得 Super Micro Computer, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI”）股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖通過簽訂基礎證券掉期百分比來實現平均證券掉期百分比的兩倍 (20%)。

info.description: Smart Sand, Inc. engages in supplying frac sand and related services. The firm offers complete mine to wellsite proppant supply and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Sand and SmartSystems. The Sand segment includes both frac sand sales and IPS sales. The SmartSystems segment focuses on the rental of patented SmartSystems equipment and related services provided to customers. The company was founded by Charles E. Young on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Yardley, PA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Smart Sand, Inc. 從事供應壓裂砂及相關服務。該公司提供完整的礦山到井場支撐劑供應和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Sand 部門和 SmartSystems 部門。砂子部門包括壓裂砂銷售和 IPS 銷售。 SmartSystems 部門專注於向客戶提供專利的 SmartSystems 設備的租賃和相關服務。該公司由 Charles E. Young 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州亞德利。

info.description: Scholar Rock Holding Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines for the treatment of serious diseases in which signaling by protein growth factors plays a fundamental role. The company was founded by Timothy A. Springer and Leonard I. Zon in October 2012 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: 學者石控股公司是一家生物製藥公司。該公司從事發現、開發和提供用於治療嚴重疾病的創新藥物的業務，其中蛋白質生長因子的信號傳導發揮基礎作用。該公司由 Timothy A. Springer 和 Leonard I. Zon 於 2012 年 10 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies that modulate the activity of G protein-coupled receptors (GPCR). It develops a proprietary technology platform called GEODe to enable the discovery and development of GPCR-targeted biologic medicines. The company was founded by Timothy A. Springer and Andrew Kruse in November 2015 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發調節 G 蛋白偶聯受體 (GPCR) 活性的治療性蛋白質和抗體。它開發了一個名為 GEODe 的專有技術平台，以實現 GPCR 標靶生物藥物的發現和開發。該公司由 Timothy A. Springer 和 Andrew Kruse 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Entrada Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which provides of a class of medicines that engages in intracellular targets. Its Endosomal Escape Vehicle (EEV) therapeutics are designed to enable the efficient intracellular delivery of a wide range of therapeutics into a variety of organs and tissues, resulting in an improved therapeutic index. The company was founded by Dehua Pei in 2016 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Entrada Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，提供一類涉及細胞內標靶的藥物。其內體逃脫載體（EEV）療法旨在實現多種療法在細胞內有效遞送至各種器官和組織，從而提高治療指數。該公司由裴德華於2016年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Wahed Dow Jones Islamic World ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to invests in equity securities of global companies (excluding U.S. domiciled companies) the characteristics of which meet the requirements of Shariah and are consistent with Islamic principles as interpreted by subject-matter experts (each, a "Shariah Compliant Company"). The adviser seeks to invest the fund's assets in securities similar to the components of, and to achieve returns similar to those of, the Dow Jones Islamic Market International Titans 100 Index (the "Index"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wahed Dow Jones Islam World ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在投資於全球公司（不包括美國註冊公司）的股本證券，這些公司的特徵符合伊斯蘭教法的要求，並符合主題專家解釋的伊斯蘭原則（每個公司都是「符合伊斯蘭教法的公司」）。該顧問尋求將基金資產投資於與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）成分類似的證券，並獲得與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）類似的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: XBiotech, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutic antibodies. Its product pipeline includes oncology, infectious diseases, dermatology and inflammatory disorders. The company was founded by John Simard on March 22, 2005 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: XBiotech, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事治療性抗體的開發和商業化。其產品線包括腫瘤學、傳染病學、皮膚病學和發炎性疾病。該公司由 John Simard 於 2005 年 3 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing products across a range of therapies. Its products include Gvoke, Keveyis, and Recorlev. Gvoke is a ready-to-use liquid glucagon for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia. Keveyis is the therapy approved in the United States to treat hyperkalemic, hypokalemic, and related variants of primary periodic paralysis (PPP). Recorlev is a cortisol synthesis inhibitor approved for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia in adult patients with Cushing's syndrome. The company was founded by Steven Prestrelski in 2005 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化一系列療法的產品。其產品包括 Gvoke、Keveyis 和 Recorlev。 Gvoke 是一種即用型液體胰高血糖素，用於治療嚴重低血糖。 Keveyis 是美國核准用於治療高血鉀、低血鉀和原發性週期性麻痺 (PPP) 相關變異的療法。 Recorlev 是一種皮質醇合成抑制劑，被批准用於治療患有庫欣氏症候群的成人患者的內源性高皮質醇血症。該公司由 Steven Prestrelski 於 2005 年創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 5, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Zymeworks, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of novel, multifunctional biotherapeutics. Its product includes Zanidatamab, which is a novel bispecific antibody that targets two distinct domains of the human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2). Zanidatamab's unique binding properties result in multiple mechanisms of action that may enable it to address unmet need in patient populations with HER2-expressing cancers. The company was founded on September 8, 2003 and is headquartered in Middletown, DE.
info.description_zh: Zymeworks, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於新型多功能生物治療藥物的發現、開發和商業化。其產品包括 Zanidatamab，這是一種新型雙特異性抗體，針對人類表皮生長因子受體 2 (HER2) 的兩個不同結構域。 Zanidatamab 獨特的結合特性產生多種作用機制，可能使其能夠解決表達 HER2 的癌症患者群體中未滿足的需求。該公司成立於2003年9月8日，總部位於德拉瓦州米德爾敦。

info.description: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. engages in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing semiconductors and modules. The firm is involved in the provision of products for telecommunications (Telecom), industrial and defense (I&D), and data center industries. The company was founded on March 25, 2009 and is headquartered in Lowell, MA.
info.description_zh: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. 從事設計、開發、製造和行銷半導體和模組。該公司為電信 (Telecom)、工業和國防 (I&D) 以及資料中心產業提供產品。該公司成立於2009年3月25日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州洛威爾。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company. It is focused on the development and commercialization of Hydronidone (F351) for the treatment of Metabolic Dysfunction Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH-associated liver fibrosis). The firm operates through the BC and Gyre segments. The company was founded on March 7, 1997 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司。它專注於 Hydronidone (F351) 的開發和商業化，用於治療代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝炎（MASH 相關肝纖維化）。該公司透過 BC 和 Gyre 部門運營。該公司成立於1997年3月7日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Insmed, Inc. is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for patients with rare diseases. Its focuses on Brensocatib, and Treprostinil Palmitil Inhalation Powder (TPIP) pipeline. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Insmed, Inc.是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者療法的開發和商業化。其重點關注 Brensocatib 和曲前列素棕櫚油吸入粉劑 (TPIP) 管道。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: FlexShares Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Northern Trust US Corporate Bond IndexSM. The underlying index is designed to reflect the performance of a diversified universe of intermediate maturity, U.S.-dollar denominated bonds of companies with investment grade credit quality, favorable valuations, and enhanced short-term and long-term solvency. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of its index.
info.description_zh: FlexShares 信用評分美國公司債指數基金尋求與 Northern Trust 美國公司債指數 SM 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在反映具有投資等級信用品質、良好估值以及增強的短期和長期償付能力的公司的多元化中期債券的表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少80%投資於其指數的證券。

info.description: Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in common and preferred stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, convertible securities, and high yield corporate bonds with an average credit rating of BB as rated by S&P. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a combination of bottom-up and top-down security picking approaches to create its portfolio. Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund was formed on December 31, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 策略總回報基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於美國的公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的普通股和優先股、可轉換證券以及標準普爾平均信用評級為BB的高收益公司債券。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，並結合自下而上和自上而下的證券選擇方法來創建投資組合。 Calamos 策略總回報基金成立於 2003 年 12 月 31 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Roundhill Glp-1 & Weight Loss ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Roundhill Glp-1 和減肥 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Float Adjusted Composite Index that measures the investment return of investment-grade U.S. bonds and investment-grade non-U.S. dollar-denominated bonds. The fund is a fund of funds and employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which is a custom, USD-hedged index designed to track the market capitalized weights of the global investment-grade bond market and is comprised of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index and the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF 旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合流通量調整後綜合指數的表現，該指數衡量投資等級美國債券和投資等級非美元計價債券的投資回報。該基金是基金中的基金，採用指數化投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該指數是定制的美元對沖指數，旨在追蹤全球投資等級債券市場的市值權重，由彭博美國綜合浮動調整指數和彭博全球綜合浮動調整後 RIC 上限指數組成。

info.description: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg USD Emerging Markets Government RIC Capped Index that measures the investment return of U.S. dollar-denominated bonds issued by governments and government-related issuers in emerging market countries. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and under normal circumstances at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美元新興市場政府 RIC 上限指數的表現，該指數衡量新興市場國家政府和政府相關發行人發行的美元計價債券的投資回報。管理人採用旨在追蹤指數表現的指數投資方法。基金的所有投資都會透過抽樣過程進行篩選，一般情況下基金資產的至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, as well as in higher yield corporate bonds, government bonds, convertibles, and alternative investments such as arbitrage and call writes. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis, focusing on such factors as source, sustainability, and risk of investment opportunities to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index and Merrill Lynch Global Broad Markets Index. The fund was formerly known as Calamos Global Diversified Income & Opportunities Fund. Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund was formed on April 10, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 全球動態收入基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於全球公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的成長型股票，以及較高收益的公司債、政府公債、可轉換債券以及套利和買權等另類投資。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點在於投資機會的來源、永續性和風險等因素來創建投資組合。它將其投資組合的表現與摩根士丹利資本國際世界指數和美林全球廣泛市場指數進行比較。該基金以前稱為卡拉莫斯全球多元化收入和機會基金。 Calamos 全球動態收入基金成立於 2007 年 4 月 10 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: OFS Credit Company (NASDAQ: OCCI) is a non-diversified, publicly traded, closed-end management company that is registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940. Its objective is to generate current income, with a secondary objective of generating capital appreciation primarily through investment in collateralized loan obligation (CLO) equity and debt securities
info.description_zh: OFS Credit Company（納斯達克股票代碼：OCCI）是一家非多元化、公開交易、封閉式管理公司，根據 1940 年《投資公司法》註冊。其目標是產生經常收入，次要目標是主要透過投資抵押貸款債券 (CLO) 股權和債務證券來產生資本增值

info.description: Value Line, Inc. engages in the provision of investment research. It produces investment periodicals based on underlying research and making available copyright data, including certain proprietary ranking system and other proprietary information, to third parties under written agreements for use in third-party managed and marketed investment products and for other purposes. The company was founded by Arnold Bernhard in 1931 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Value Line, Inc. 從事提供投資研究。它根據基礎研究製作投資期刊，並根據書面協議向第三方提供版權數據，包括某些專有排名系統和其他專有信息，以用於第三方管理和營銷的投資產品以及其他目的。該公司由阿諾德伯恩哈德 (Arnold Bernhard) 於 1931 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。
