info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Local Currency Bond ETF seeks maximum total return and current income. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in bonds, notes and bills issued or guaranteed by entities incorporated or domiciled in emerging market countries (collectively, "Bonds") that are denominated in the local currency of the issuer. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 新興市場本幣債券 ETF 尋求最大的總回報和當期收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於由在新興市場國家註冊或註冊的實體發行或擔保的以發行人當地貨幣計價的債券、票據和票據（統稱「債券」）來實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of space launch vehicles. The company was founded by Thomas E. Markusic, Mark Watt, and Max Polyakov in January 2017 and is headquartered in Leander, TX.
info.description_zh: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. 從事航太運載火箭的設計與製造。該公司由 Thomas E. Markusic、Mark Watt 和 Max Polyakov 於 2017 年 1 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州利安德。

info.description: iShares International Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE World Government Bond Index - Developed Markets Capped Select Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of fixed-rate, local currency, investment-grade, sovereign bonds from certain developed markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 國際公債 ETF 旨在追蹤富時世界政府公債指數 - 已開發市場上限精選指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。相關指數衡量某些已開發市場的固定利率、本國貨幣、投資等級、主權債券的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Estee Lauder Companies, Inc. engages in the manufacture of skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. It sells products under Estee Lauder, Clinique, Origins, MAC, Bobbi Brown, La Mer, Jo Malone London, Aveda and Too Faced. The company was founded by Estee Lauder and Joseph Lauder in 1946 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 雅詩蘭黛公司從事護膚、化妝品、香水和護髮產品的製造。該公司銷售雅詩蘭黛、倩碧、Origins、MAC、Bobbi Brown、La Mer、Jo Malone London、Aveda 和 Too Faced 品牌的產品。該公司由雅詩蘭黛和約瑟夫蘭黛於 1946 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tempus AI, Inc. is a healthcare technology company, which engages in bringing artificial intelligence and machine learning to healthcare. It focuses on building platforms for oncology, neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease, and radiology. The company was founded by Eric Paul Lefkofsky in August 2015 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Tempus AI, Inc.是一家醫療保健技術公司，致力於將人工智慧和機器學習引入醫療保健領域。它專注於建立腫瘤學、神經精神病學、心臟病學、傳染病學和放射學的平台。該公司由 Eric Paul Lefkofsky 於 2015 年 8 月創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Texas ETF is an actively managed equity fund focused on long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in stocks of companies operating in the oil, gas & consumable fuels industry and the energy equipment & services sectors, across a diversified range of market capitalizations. The investment strategy combines fundamental, value-oriented research with selective growth opportunities to identify companies expected to benefit directly or indirectly from expanding economic opportunities within the State of Texas. The fund targets businesses positioned to capitalize on Texas-specific advantages, including energy sector strength, favorable regulatory conditions, and sustained demographic and economic growth.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Texas ETF 是一檔專注於長期資本增值的主動管理股票基金。該基金主要投資於石油、天然氣和消耗性燃料產業以及能源設備和服務業的公司股票，其市值範圍多元化。該投資策略將基礎性的、以價值為導向的研究與選擇性成長機會相結合，以確定預計將直接或間接受益於德州不斷擴大的經濟機會的公司。該基金的目標是那些能夠利用德州特有優勢的企業，包括能源產業的實力、有利的監管條件以及持續的人口和經濟成長。

info.description: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of biomedical technologies to patients through risk-reward-sharing partnerships with medical device companies. The company was founded by David P. Hochman on May 25, 2020 and is headquartered in New Hope, PA.
info.description_zh: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. 透過與醫療器材公司建立風險回報共享合作夥伴關係，為病患提供生物醫學技術。該公司由 David P. Hochman 於 2020 年 5 月 25 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐霍普。

info.description: McGrath RentCorp engages in the provision of business-to-business rental services. It operates through the following segments: Mobile Modular, Portable Storage, TRS-RenTelco, and Enviroplex. The Mobile Modular segment focuses on modular building and portable storage. The Portable Storage segment includes rental inventory consisting of steel containers used to provide a temporary storage solution that is delivered to the customer's location and addresses the need for secure, temporary storage with immediate access to the unit. The TRS-RenTelco segment includes operations for its electronic test equipment. The Enviroplex segment is involved in the classroom manufacturing business selling modular buildings used primarily as classrooms in California. The company was founded by Robert P. McGrath in 1979 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: McGrath RentCorp 從事提供企業對企業租賃服務。它透過以下部門運作：行動模組化、便攜式儲存、TRS-RenTelco 和 Enviroplex。行動模組化部門專注於模組化建築和便攜式儲存。便攜式儲存部門包括由鋼製容器組成的租賃庫存，用於提供臨時儲存解決方案，將其交付到客戶所在地，並滿足安全、臨時儲存和立即存取設備的需求。 TRS-RenTelco 部門包括其電子測試設備業務。 Enviroplex 部門從事教室製造業務，銷售主要用作加州教室的模組化建築。該公司由 Robert P. McGrath 於 1979 年創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: SiTime Corp.is a micro-electromechanical system-based silicon timing solution. The company is transforming the timing industry with configurable solutions that replace legacy quartz devices and enable customers to differentiate their products with performance, smaller size, lower power, and reliability. The company was founded by Markus Lutz and Aaron Partridge on December 3, 2003 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SiTime Corp.是一家基於微機電系統的矽計時解決方案。該公司正在透過可配置的解決方案來改變計時行業，這些解決方案取代了傳統的石英裝置，並使客戶能夠憑藉性能、更小的尺寸、更低的功耗和可靠性來區分他們的產品。該公司由 Markus Lutz 和 Aaron Partridge 於 2003 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Navan, Inc. engages in offering a cloud-based technology platform for travelers. Its products include business travel and expense management. The company was founded by Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig in February 2015 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Navan, Inc. 致力於為旅客提供基於雲端的技術平台。其產品包括商務旅行和費用管理。該公司由 Ariel Cohen 和 Ilan Twig 於 2015 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Immix Biopharma, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that engages in the development of therapies for cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Ilya Rachman, Sean Senn, and Vladimir Torchilin in 2012 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Immix Biopharma, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症和發炎性疾病療法的開發。該公司由 Ilya Rachman、Sean Senn 和 Vladimir Torchilin 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: iShares MSCI Qatar ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All Qatar Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the equity market in Qatar. The underlying index uses a capping methodology that limits the weight of any single "group entity" to a maximum of 25% of the underlying index weight. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 卡達 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 全卡達上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整市值加權指數，旨在衡量卡達股市。標的指數使用上限方法，將任何單一「集團實體」的權重限制為標的指數權重的最大 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PRA Group, Inc. engages in the purchase, collection and management of portfolios of nonperforming loans. The firm purchase portfolios of nonperforming loans at a discount in two broad categories: Core and Insolvency. It also provides fee-based services on class action claims recoveries and by servicing consumer bankruptcy accounts in the United States. The company was founded by Steven D. Fredrickson and Kevin P. Stevenson on March 20, 1996 and is headquartered in Norfolk, VA.
info.description_zh: PRA Group, Inc. 從事不良貸款組合的購買、催收和管理業務。該公司以折扣價購買兩大類不良貸款組合：核心貸款和破產貸款。它還提供集體訴訟索賠追償的收費服務，並為美國的消費者破產帳戶提供服務。該公司由 Steven D. Fredrickson 和 Kevin P. Stevenson 於 1996 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州諾福克。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: QuinStreet, Inc. engages in performance marketplaces and technologies for the financial and home services industries. Its approach to proprietary performance marketing technologies allows clients to engage high-intent digital media or traffic from a wide range of device types, in multiple formats or types of media, and in a wide range of cost-per-action. The company was founded by Douglas Valenti on April 16, 1999 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: QuinStreet, Inc. 致力於金融和家庭服務業的績效市場和技術。其專有的績效行銷技術方法使客戶能夠以多種格式或類型的媒體以及各種每次操作成本來吸引來自各種設備類型的高意圖數位媒體或流量。該公司由 Douglas Valenti 於 1999 年 4 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Aquestive Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the identifying, developing, and commercializing differentiated products to address unmet medical needs and to solve patients' therapeutic problems. Its product pipeline include Libervant, AQST-108, AQST-305, Suboxone and Zuplenz. The company was founded in January 2004 and is headquartered in Warren, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aquestive Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於識別、開發和商業化差異化產品，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求並解決患者的治療問題。其產品線包括 Libervant、AQST-108、AQST-305、Suboxone 和 Zuplenz。該公司成立於 2004 年 1 月，總部位於新澤西州沃倫。

info.description: Starling Oncology, Inc. provides cancer care treatment services. It operates through the following business segments: Dispensary, Patient Care, and Clinical Trials and Other. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Cerritos, CA.
info.description_zh: Starling Oncology, Inc. 提供癌症護理治療服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：藥房、病患照護、臨床試驗及其他。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於加州塞里托斯。

info.description: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical stage immuno-oncology company pioneering the development and commercialization of genetically engineered allogeneic T cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. The firm develops a pipeline of off-the-shelf T cell product candidates that are designed to target and kill cancer cells. Its engineered T cells are allogeneic, which are derived from healthy donors for intended use in any patient. The company was founded by Arie S. Belldegrun, David D. Chang, David M. Tanen, and Joshua A. Kazam in November 2017 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家临床阶段免疫肿瘤学公司，率先开发和商业化用于治疗癌症的基因工程同种异体 T 细胞疗法。該公司開發了一系列現成的 T 細胞候選產品，旨在靶向和殺死癌細胞。其工程化 T 細胞是同種異體的，源自於健康捐贈者，可用於任何患者。该公司由 Arie S. Belldegrun、David D. Chang、David M. Tanen 和 Joshua A. Kazam 于 2017 年 11 月创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州南旧金山。

info.description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. owns and operates retail outlets in the United States. It engages in the distribution and retailing of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories in the U.S., serving both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers. It provides new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, including alternators, starters, fuel pumps, water pumps, brake system components, batteries, belts, hoses, temperature controls, chassis parts and engine parts, maintenance items consisting of oil, antifreeze products, fluids, filters, lighting products, engine additives, and appearance products, and accessories, such as floor mats, seat covers, and truck accessories. Its stores offer auto body paint and related materials, automotive tools, and professional service provider service equipment. The firm stores also offer enhanced services and programs consisting of used oil, oil filter and battery recycling, battery, wiper, and bulb replacement, battery diagnostic testing, electrical and module testing, check engine light code extraction, a loaner tool program, drum and rotor resurfacing, custom hydraulic hoses, professional paint shop mixing and related materials, and machine shops. O'Reilly Automotive stores provide do-it-yourself and professional service provider customers a selection of brand name, house brands, and private label products for domestic and imported automobiles, vans, and trucks. The company was founded by Charles F. O'Reilly and Charles H. O'Reilly in November 1957 and is headquartered in Springfield, MO.
info.description_zh: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. 在美國擁有並經營零售店。該公司在美國從事汽車售後零件、工具、用品、設備和配件的分銷和零售，為專業安裝人員和自助客戶提供服務。它提供全新和再製造的汽車硬零件，包括交流發電機、起動機、燃油泵、水泵、煞車系統組件、電池、皮帶、軟管、溫控器、底盤零件和引擎零件，維護項目包括機油、防凍產品、液體、過濾器、照明產品、引擎添加劑和外觀產品，以及配件，例如腳踏墊、座椅套和卡車配件。其商店提供車身油漆及相關材料、汽車工具以及專業服務提供者的服務設備。公司商店還提供增強的服務和計劃，包括廢油、機油濾清器和電池回收、電池、雨刮器和燈泡更換、電池診斷測試、電氣和模組測試、檢查發動機燈代碼提取、借用工具計劃、鼓和轉子表面重修、定制液壓軟管、專業噴漆車間混合和相關材料以及機械車間。 O'Reilly Automotive 商店為自助和專業服務供應商客戶提供一系列國產和進口汽車、貨車和卡車的品牌、自有品牌和自有品牌產品。該公司由 Charles F. O'Reilly 和 Charles H. O'Reilly 於 1957 年 11 月創立，總部位於密蘇裡州斯普林菲爾德。

info.description: Willdan Group, Inc. engages in the provision of technical and consulting services. It operates through the Energy and Engineering & Consulting segments. The Energy segment offers energy and sustainability consulting services to utilities, public agencies, and private industries. The Engineering and Consulting segment manages civil engineering-related construction management, building and safety, city engineering office management, city planning, civil design, geotechnical, material testing and other engineering consulting services. The company was founded by Dan W. Heil and William Stookey in May 1964 and is headquartered in Anaheim, CA.
info.description_zh: Willdan Group, Inc. 從事提供技術和諮詢服務。它透過能源和工程與諮詢部門運作。能源部門為公用事業、公共機構和私營企業提供能源和永續發展諮詢服務。工程與顧問部門管理土木工程相關的施工管理、建築與安全、城市工程辦公室管理、城市規劃、土木設計、岩土、材料測試和其他工程諮詢服務。該公司由 Dan W. Heil 和 William Stookey 於 1964 年 5 月創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州阿納海姆。

info.description: Prospect Capital Corp., a traded business development company invests in middle market companies located in the United States. The fund targets companies operating across a broad range of sectors. It provides debt and equity financing for buyout, growth, development, and recapitalization. It acts as a co-investor and takes controlling interest. The company was founded on April 13, 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Prospect Capital Corp. 是一家上市業務開發公司，投資於位於美國的中間市場公司。該基金的目標投資對象涉及多個行業的公司。它為收購、成長、發展和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。它作為共同投資者並擁有控股權。該公司成立於2004年4月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: iShares MSCI China Multisector Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI China Technology Sub-Industries Select Capped Index composed of Chinese equities in technology and technology-related industries. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 中國多板塊科技 ETF 旨在追蹤由中國科技及科技相關產業股票組成的 MSCI 中國科技次產業精選上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: BTQ Technologies Corp. engages in the business of post-quantum encryption. Its products include: QCIM, QSSN, OSS, QPoW, QRiNG. The company was founded by Nicolas Roussy Newton on Novemeber 23, 1983 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: BTQ Technologies Corp. 從事後量子加密業務。其產品包括：QCIM、QSSN、OSS、QPoW、QRiNG。該公司由 Nicolas Roussy Newton 於 1983 年 11 月 23 日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Rezolve AI Plc operates in the mobile commerce industry with its cutting-edge engagement platform powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning. It develops AI-based mobile commerce and engagement solutions, simplifying the purchasing process by providing relevant information and facilitating seamless transactions with a single tap. The firm enables retailers, brands, and manufacturers to create dynamic connections with consumers across mobile and desktop devices. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Rezolve AI Plc 憑藉其由人工智慧和機器學習提供支援的尖端參與平台，在行動商務產業開展業務。它開發基於人工智慧的行動商務和參與解決方案，透過提供相關資訊並透過點擊促進無縫交易來簡化購買流程。該公司使零售商、品牌和製造商能夠透過行動和桌面設備與消費者建立動態聯繫。該公司成立於2016年，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Guardant Health, Inc. is a precision oncology company, which engages in the provision of treatment of cancer through the use of proprietary blood-based tests, vast data sets, and advanced analytics. Its solutions include treatment selection, recurrence detection, and early detection. The company was founded by Helmy Eltoukhy, AmirAli H. Talasaz, and Michael Joseph Wiley in December 2011 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Guardant Health, Inc. 是一家精準腫瘤學公司，透過使用專有的血液檢查、大量數據集和高級分析來提供癌症治療。其解決方案包括治療選擇、復發檢測和早期檢測。該公司由 Helmy Eltoukhy、AmirAli H. Talasaz 和 Michael Joseph Wiley 於 2011 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Data Storage Corp. engages in the provision of business continuity services. These services include disaster recovery, infrastructure as a service, and cyber security. Its other services and solutions include data protection services, data center and security, voice and data solutions, and email archival solutions. The company was founded by Charles M. Piluso in June 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Data Storage Corp. 從事提供業務連續性服務。這些服務包括災難復原、基礎設施即服務和網路安全。其其他服務和解決方案包括資料保護服務、資料中心和安全性、語音和資料解決方案以及電子郵件存檔解決方案。該公司由 Charles M. Piluso 於 2001 年 6 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: DuPont de Nemours, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of specialty materials and technology-based products. It operates through the Healthcare & Water Technologies and Diversified Industrials segments. The Healthcare & Water Technologies segment includes packaging, parts, and components for medical device and biopharma markets and water filtration and purification technologies primarily for industrial wastewater and energy, municipal drinking water and desalination, and life sciences and specialty markets. The Diversified Industrials segment builds technologies, with a portfolio serving new-build, repair, and remodel applications across non-residential and residential construction markets, and industrial technologies, which include a portfolio of adhesive, wear and friction, and packaging solutions serving aerospace, automotive, printing, and packaging markets. The company was founded in 1802 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: 杜邦德內穆爾公司從事特殊材料和技術產品的開發和製造。它透過醫療保健和水技術以及多元化工業部門運作。醫療保健和水技術部門包括用於醫療器材和生物製藥市場的包裝、零件和組件，以及主要用於工業廢水和能源、市政飲用水和海水淡化以及生命科學和專業市場的水過濾和淨化技術。多元化工業部門建構技術，提供服務於非住宅和住宅建築市場的新建、維修和改造應用的產品組合，以及工業技術，其中包括服務於航空航太、汽車、印刷和包裝市場的黏合劑、磨損和摩擦以及包裝解決方案的產品組合。該公司成立於 1802 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Onfolio Holdings, Inc. engages in the acquisition, management, and optimization of digital companies. It operates through the following business segments: Business to Business (B2B) and Business to Consumer (B2C). The B2B segment refers to Eastern Standard, RevenueZen, DDS Rank, SEO Butler, Contentellect, Pace Generative, and DealPipe. The B2C segment includes Proofread Anywhere, Mighty Deals, and Vital Reaction. The company was founded by Dominic Wells on July 20, 2020 and is headquartered in Wilmington. DE.
info.description_zh: Onfolio Holdings, Inc. 從事數位公司的收購、管理和優化。它透過以下業務部門運作：企業對企業（B2B）和企業對消費者（B2C）。 B2B 細分市場包括 Eastern Standard、RevenueZen、DDS Rank、SEO Butler、Contentellect、Pace Generative 和 DealPipe。 B2C 細分市場包括 Proofread Anywhere、Mighty Deals 和 Vital Reaction。該公司由多明尼克威爾斯於2020年7月20日創立，總部位於威爾明頓。德。

info.description: Albemarle Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of chemicals for consumer electronics, petroleum refining, utilities, packaging, construction, transportation, pharmaceuticals, crop production, food-safety, and custom chemistry services. It operates through the following segments: Energy Storage, Specialties, and Ketjen. The Energy Storage segment develops and manufactures a broad range of basic lithium compounds, including lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, and lithium chloride. The Specialties segment focuses on optimizing a portfolio of bromine and specialized lithium solutions. The Ketjen segment consists of clean fuels technologies, fluidized catalytic cracking catalysts and additives, and performance catalyst solutions, which is primarily composed of organometallics and curatives. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Albemarle Corp. 從事消費性電子、石油精煉、公用事業、包裝、建築、運輸、製藥、農作物生產、食品安全和客製化化學服務的化學品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：能源儲存部門、專業部門和科琴部門。儲能部門開發和製造各種基本鋰化合物，包括碳酸鋰、氫氧化鋰和氯化鋰。特種產品部門專注於優化溴和特種鋰解決方案的產品組合。 Ketjen 部門包括清潔燃料技術、流化催化裂解催化劑和添加劑以及主要由有機金屬和固化劑組成的高性能催化劑解決方案。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corp. is a commercial-stage surgical robotics company, which engages in the development of transformative solutions in urology. It manufactures and sells the AquaBeam Robotic System, an image-guided, surgical robotic system for use in minimally invasive urologic surgery, with an initial focus on treating BPH. The firm's proprietary AquaBeam Robotic System employs a single-use disposable handpiece to deliver its Aquablation therapy, which combines real-time, multidimensional imaging, personalized treatment planning, automated robotics and heat-free waterjet ablation for targeted and rapid removal of prostate tissue. The company was founded by Nikolai Aljuri and Rodney C. Perkins in 2007 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corp. 是一家商業階段的手術機器人公司，致力於泌尿外科變革性解決方案的開發。該公司生產和銷售 AquaBeam 機器人系統，這是一種影像引導的手術機器人系統，用於微創泌尿外科手術，最初的重點是治療 BPH。該公司專有的 AquaBeam 機器人系統採用一次性手機進行 Aquablation 治療，該治療結合了即時、多維成像、個人化治療計劃、自動化機器人技術和無熱水射流消融，可針對性地快速去除前列腺組織。該公司由 Nikolai Aljuri 和 Rodney C. Perkins 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Carvana Co. is a holding company and an eCommerce platform, which engages in the buying and selling of used cars. The company was founded by Ernest Garcia, III, Benjamin Huston and Ryan Keeton in 2012 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Carvana Co.是一家控股公司和電子商務平台，從事二手車買賣。該公司由 Ernest Garcia, III、Benjamin Huston 和 Ryan Keeton 於 2012 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: U.S. Gold Corp. engages in the exploration of gold properties. It has properties in CK Gold Project, Wyoming, Challis Gold Project, Idaho, and Keystone, Nevada. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Elko, NV.
info.description_zh: 美国黄金公司从事黄金矿产勘探。該公司在懷俄明州 CK Gold 項目、愛達荷州 Challis Gold 項目和內華達州 Keystone 擁有資產。該公司成立於 1967 年，總部位於內華達州埃爾科。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of AVGO and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 AVGO 證券和掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 AVGO 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: XPEL, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of automotive products. It offers paint protection, automotive, flat glass window films, and plotters. The company was founded on October 14, 2003 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: XPEL, Inc. 從事汽車產品的製造和分銷。它提供油漆保護、汽車、平板玻璃窗膜和繪圖儀。該公司成立於2003年10月14日，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Medical segments. The Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products. The Medical segment manufactures, sources and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和醫療部門運作。製藥部門分銷品牌藥品和仿製藥、特殊藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。醫療部門生產、採購和分銷康德樂品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Cognyte Software Ltd. engages in the development and provision of security analytics software. The firm offers its solutions to governments and enterprises. Its solutions include decision, network, operational, and threat intelligence analytics. The company was founded on May 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Herzliya Pituach, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cognyte Software Ltd. 從事安全分析軟體的開發和提供。該公司為政府和企業提供解決方案。其解決方案包括決策、網路、營運和威脅情報分析。該公司成立於2020年5月21日，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞皮圖阿赫。

info.description: NerdWallet, Inc. engages in building online tools that provide information, insights, and consumer-driven advice about personal finance. It provides consumer-driven advice about personal finance through its platform by connecting individuals and small and mid-sized businesses with providers of financial products. The company was founded by Tim Chen and Jacob Gibson in 2009 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: NerdWallet, Inc. 致力於建立線上工具，提供有關個人理財的資訊、見解和消費者驅動的建議。它透過其平台將個人和中小型企業與金融產品提供者聯繫起來，提供有關個人理財的消費者驅動的建議。該公司由 Tim Chen 和 Jacob Gibson 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Broadcom Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Broadcom Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Netflix, Inc. engages in providing entertainment services. It also offers activities for leisure time, entertainment video, video gaming, and other sources of entertainment. It operates through the United States and International geographic segments. The company was founded by Marc Randolph and Wilmot Reed Hastings on August 29, 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Netflix, Inc. 從事提供娛樂服務。它還提供休閒活動、娛樂影片、視頻遊戲和其他娛樂來源。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Marc Randolph 和 Wilmot Reed Hastings 於 1997 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: ADMA Biologics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics. The firm operates through the following business segments: ADMA BioManufacturing and Plasma Collection Center. The ADMA BioManufacturing segment consists of immune globulin manufacturing and development operations. The Plasma Collection Center consists of source plasma collection facilities. The company was founded by Adam S. Grossman and Jerrold B. Grossman on June 24, 2004 and is headquartered in Ramsey, NJ.
info.description_zh: ADMA Biologics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事製造、行銷和開發特種血漿衍生生物製劑。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：ADMA 生物製造和血漿採集中心。 ADMA 生物製造部門包括免疫球蛋白製造和開發業務。血漿採集中心由源頭血漿採集設施組成。該公司由 Adam S. Grossman 和 Jerrold B. Grossman 於 2004 年 6 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州拉姆齊。

info.description: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in the Rockies, Mid-Continent, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在落基山脈、中大陸、德克薩斯州南部和德克薩斯州西部開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. is a clinical-stage oncology therapeutics company, which focuses on the research, development, and commercialization of diffusing alpha-emitters radiation therapy for the treatment of cancer. The firm is involved in the clinical trials at cancer centers with indications that include skin cancer, oral cavity cancer, breast cancer, and pancreatic cancer. The company was founded by Uzi Sofer, Yona Keisari, and Itzhak Kelson in November 2015 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤治療公司，專注於用於癌症治療的擴散 α 發射體放射療法的研究、開發和商業化。該公司參與癌症中心的臨床試驗，適應症包括皮膚癌、口腔癌、乳癌和胰臟癌。該公司由 Uzi Sofer、Yona Keisari 和 Itzhak Kelson 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: Global Self Storage, Inc. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the ownership, operation, management, acquisition, and re-development of self-storage properties. It offers personal, outdoor parking, climate controlled, wine, and business storage facilities. The company was founded on September 1, 1983 and is headquartered in Millbrook, NY.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Global Self Storage, Inc.是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事自助倉儲物業的所有權、營運、管理、收購和再開發業務。飯店提供個人室外停車場、氣候控制、葡萄酒和商務儲存設施。該公司成立於1983年9月1日，總部位於紐約州米爾布魯克。

info.description: 36Kr Holdings, Inc. operates as an online media publisher company. It offers business services, including online advertising services, enterprise value-added services and subscription services. The company was founded by Cheng Cheng Liu on December 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 36氪控股有限公司是一家線上媒體出版公司。它提供商業服務，包括線上廣告服務、企業增值服務和訂閱服務。該公司由劉程程於2018年12月3日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。該公司專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: The Home Depot, Inc. engages in the sale of building materials and home improvement products. Its products include building materials, home improvement products, lawn and garden products and decor products. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Canada and Mexico. It offers home improvement installation services, and tool and rental equipment. The company was founded by Bernard Marcus, Arthur M. Blank, Kenneth Gerald Langone and Pat Farrah on June 29, 1978 and is headquartered at Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: The Home Depot, Inc. 從事建築材料和家居裝修產品的銷售。其產品包括建築材料、家居裝修產品、草坪和花園產品以及裝飾產品。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、加拿大和墨西哥。它提供家居裝修安裝服務以及工具和租賃設備。該公司由 Bernard Marcus、Arthur M. Blank、Kenneth Gerald Langone 和 Pat Farrah 於 1978 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Maplebear, Inc. engages in the design and development of an online application that offers grocery delivery and pick-up services. The firm offers Instacart which enables users to connect with personal shoppers in the area who pick up and deliver groceries from local stores. The company was founded by Apoorva Mehta, Brandon Leonardo, and Max Mullen in 2012 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Maplebear, Inc. 從事設計和開發提供雜貨配送和提貨服務的線上應用程式。該公司提供 Instacart，使用戶能夠與該地區從當地商店提貨和送貨的個人購物者聯繫。該公司由 Apoorva Mehta、Brandon Leonardo 和 Max Mullen 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: American Battery Technology Co. is a technology company, which engages in the development and marketing of lithium-ion batteries. Its projects include recycling plant, United States Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC), and Tonopah flats. The company was founded on October 6, 2011 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: 美國電池科技有限公司是一家從事鋰離子電池研發和行銷的科技公司。其項目包括回收廠、美國先進電池聯盟 (USABC) 和托諾帕公寓。該公司成立於2011年10月6日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Kopin Corp. engages in the development, manufacture and sale of wearable technologies which include components and systems. Its portfolio includes AMLCD, LCOS displays, OLED displays, ASIC, backlights, and optical lenses. The firm uses semiconductor material technology to design, manufacture and market its component products for use in military, enterprise and consumer electronic applications, training and simulation equipment and 3D metrology equipment. The company was founded by John C.C. Fan on April 23, 1984 and is headquartered in Westborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Kopin Corp. 從事穿戴式技術（包括組件和系統）的開發、製造和銷售。其產品組合包括 AMLCD、LCOS 顯示器、OLED 顯示器、ASIC、背光和光學鏡頭。該公司利用半導體材料技術設計、製造和銷售其組件產品，用於軍事、企業和消費性電子應用、培訓和模擬設備以及 3D 計量設備。該公司由 John C.C. 創立。 Fan 於 1984 年 4 月 23 日成立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州韋斯特伯勒。

info.description: Blink Charging Co. engages in the operation and provision of electric vehicles, charging equipment, and networked EV charging services. Its product line and services include the Blink EV charging network, charging equipment, also known as electric vehicle supply equipment, and EV charging services. The company was founded by Michael D. Farkas on October 3, 2006 and is headquartered in Bowie, MD.
info.description_zh: Blink Charging Co.從事電動車、充電設備和連網電動車充電服務的營運和提供。其產品線和服務包括Blink EV充電網路、充電設備（也稱為電動車供電設備）和EV充電服務。該公司由 Michael D. Farkas 於 2006 年 10 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州鮑伊。

info.description: Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage company, which focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing antiviral therapeutics. Its product pipelines include Coronaviridae, Flaviviridae, and Paramyxovirdae. The company was founded by Jean-Pierre Sommadossi and David Chu in July 2012 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段公司，專注於發現、開發和商業化抗病毒療法。其產品線包括冠狀病毒科、黃病毒科和副黏病毒科。該公司由 Jean-Pierre Sommadossi 和 David Chu 於 2012 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Geron Corp. operates as a biotechnology company. It develops a telomerase inhibitor, Imetelstat, in hematologic myeloid malignancies. The firm develops therapeutic products for oncology. The company was founded by Michael D. West on November 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Geron Corp. 作为一家生物技术公司运营。它開發了一種用於治療血液骨髓惡性腫瘤的端粒酶抑制劑 Imetelstat。該公司開發腫瘤治療產品。該公司由 Michael D. West 於 1990 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特市。

info.description: Braze, Inc. operates a customer relationship management platform for mobile applications. Its application combines messaging, audience segmentation, analytics and user support in a single integrated solution. The firm offers push notifications, email, in-app messages, and news feed services. The company was founded by Mark Ghermezian, William Magnuson, and Jonathan Hyman on March 28, 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Braze, Inc. 經營行動應用程式的客戶關係管理平台。其應用程式將訊息傳遞、受眾細分、分析和用戶支援結合在一個整合解決方案中。該公司提供推播通知、電子郵件、應用程式內訊息和新聞源服務。該公司由 Mark Ghermezian、William Magnuson 和 Jonathan Hyman 於 2011 年 3 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Wise Group Plc operates as a global payment solutions. It offers cross-border payment services to banks and customers. The company was founded on June 17, 2025 and is headquartered in St. Helier, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Wise Group Plc 是一家全球支付解決方案提供商。它為銀行和客戶提供跨境支付服務。該公司成立於2025年6月17日，總部位於英國聖赫利爾。

info.description: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in research, development, and commercializing therapeutics for cancer and obesity. Its pipeline includes CRB-701, an antibody drug conjugate (ADC) that targets the expression of Nectin-4 on cancer cells to release a cytotoxic payload, CRB-601, an anti-integrin monoclonal antibody that blocks the activation of TGFß expressed on cancer cells, and CRB-913, a highly peripherally restricted cannabinoid type-1 (CB1) receptor inverse agonist for the treatment of obesity. The company was founded in April 2009 and is headquartered in Norwood, MA.
info.description_zh: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.是一家腫瘤學公司，從事癌症和肥胖療法的研究、開發和商業化。其產品線包括CRB-701，一種抗體藥物偶聯物（ADC），靶向癌細胞上Nectin-4的表達，釋放細胞毒性有效負載；CRB-601，一種抗整合素單克隆抗體，阻斷癌細胞上表達的TGFβ的激活；以及CRB-913，一種高度外周限制的大麻素反向激動劑（CB1）受體反向激動劑。該公司成立於 2009 年 4 月，總部位於馬薩諸塞州諾伍德。

info.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. engages in the development, publishing, and marketing of interactive software games. Its products are designed for console systems, handheld gaming systems, and personal computers, including smart phones and tablets, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The company was founded by Ryan A. Brant in 1993 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. 從事互動軟體遊戲的開發、發行和行銷。其產品專為遊戲機系統、手持遊戲系統和個人電腦（包括智慧型手機和平板電腦）而設計，並透過實體零售、數位下載、線上平台和雲端串流服務提供。該公司由 Ryan A. Brant 於 1993 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Globe Life, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of individual life and supplemental health insurance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Investments Insurance. The Life Insurance segment offers products marketed by Globe Life include traditional whole life and term life insurance. The Health Insurance segment is involved in the renewable and includes Medicare Supplement, cancer, critical illness, accident, and other limited-benefit supplemental hospital and surgical products. The Investments Insurance segment refers to the management of capital resources, including investments, and the management of liquidity. The company was founded on November 19, 1979, and is headquartered in McKinney, TX.
info.description_zh: Globe Life, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，從事提供個人人壽和補充健康保險產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：人壽保險、健康保險和投資保險。人壽保險部門提供 Globe Life 行銷的產品，包括傳統的終身人壽保險和定期人壽保險。健康保險部門涉及再生保險，包括醫療保險補充、癌症、重大疾病、事故和其他有限福利補充醫院和手術產品。投資保險部門是指資本資源的管理，包括投資和流動性的管理。該公司成立於1979年11月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州麥金尼。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BBAI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of BBAI. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BBAI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BBAI 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 BBAI 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BBAI 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ALB Daily ETF seeks to provide two times (200%) the daily performance of the common stock of Albemarle Corporation (ALB), before fees and expenses. The fund is designed for sophisticated investors to gain amplified exposure to the price movements of a leading global lithium producer through the use of derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ALB 每日 ETF 旨在提供雅寶公司 (ALB) 普通股每日表現的兩倍 (200%)（未扣除費用和開支）。該基金專為經驗豐富的投資者而設計，透過使用衍生性工具，擴大對全球領先鋰生產商價格變動的曝險。

info.description: Sidus Space, Inc. is a space-as-a-service company. The firm focuses on commercial satellite design, manufacture, launch planning, mission operations and in-orbit support, and data collection with a vision to demonstrate space operations for new technologies, and deliver data and predictive analytics to both domestic and global customers. The company was founded by Carol M. Craig on July 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Merritt Island, FL.
info.description_zh: Sidus Space, Inc. 是一家空間即服務公司。該公司專注於商業衛星設計、製造、發射規劃、任務操作和在軌支援以及數據收集，旨在展示新技術的空間操作，並向國內和全球客戶提供數據和預測分析。該公司由 Carol M. Craig 於 2012 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州梅里特島。

info.description: AGM Group Holdings, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It focuses on the research and development of blockchain-oriented ASIC chip, production of encryption mining machines, and financial technology software services. Its products and services include technology hardware research and development, and assembling and sales of technology hardware. The company was founded by Zhen Tao Jiang and Wen Jie Tang on April 27, 2015 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: AGM Group Holdings, Inc.是一家提供金融解決方案的科技公司。專注於面向區塊鏈的ASIC晶片研發、加密礦機生產、金融科技軟體服務。其產品和服務包括技術硬體研發、技術硬體組裝和銷售。該公司由姜振濤和唐文傑於2015年4月27日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Frontdoor, Inc. engages in the provision of home service plans. Its home service plans cover the repair or replacement of major home's systems and appliances. The firm's service focuses on water heaters, garbage disposals, doorbells, smoke detectors, ceiling fans, central vacuums, refrigerators, dishwashers and trash compactors. Its brands include American Home Shield, HSA, OneGuard and Landmark. The company was founded on January 2, 2018, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Frontdoor, Inc. 從事提供居家服務計畫。其家庭服務計劃涵蓋主要家庭系統和電器的維修或更換。該公司的服務重點是熱水器、垃圾處理器、門鈴、煙霧偵測器、吊扇、中央吸塵器、冰箱、洗碗機和垃圾壓實機。其品牌包括American Home Shield、HSA、OneGuard和Landmark。該公司成立於2018年1月2日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, acquisition, and development of small molecules and biologics to treat and prevent human disease and alleviate suffering. Its portfolio includes TNX-102 SL, TNX-601, TNX-801, and TNX-1800. The company was founded by Seth Lederman and Donald W. Landry on November 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Berkeley Heights, NJ.
info.description_zh: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於發現、收購和開發小分子和生物製劑，以治療和預防人類疾病並減輕痛苦。其產品組合包括 TNX-102 SL、TNX-601、TNX-801 和 TNX-1800。該公司由 Seth Lederman 和 Donald W. Landry 於 2007 年 11 月 16 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Berkeley Heights。

info.description: Cargurus, Inc. is an online automotive platform, which engages in buying and selling vehicles that is building upon its listings marketplace with digital retail solutions and the CarOffer digital wholesale platform. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Marketplace, Digital Wholesale, and Other. The U.S. Marketplace segment offers marketplace services from customers. The Digital Wholesale segment consists of dealer-to-dealer and IMCO services and products which are sold on the CarOffer platform. The company was founded by Langley Steinert on November 10, 2005 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Cargurus, Inc. 是一個線上汽車平台，致力於購買和銷售車輛，該平台基於其列表市場，提供數位零售解決方案和 CarOffer 數位批發平台。它透過以下部門運作：美國市場、數位批發和其他部門。美國市場部門為客戶提供市場服務。數位批發部門包括經銷商對經銷商以及在 CarOffer 平台上銷售的 IMCO 服務和產品。該公司由 Langley Steinert 於 2005 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AVGO. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AVGO 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 AVGO 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Broadcom Inc. (Nasdaq: AVGO) (the "Underlying Security" or "AVGO"). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by entering into swap agreements on the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Broadcom Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVGO）（「基礎證券」或「AVGO」）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過簽訂基礎證券掉期協議來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. is a diversified holding company, that seeks to build long-term shareholder value by acquiring, managing, and growing businesses with strong fundamentals and market opportunities. Its current structure consists of four divisions: Building Solutions, Business Services, Energy Services, and Investments. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Old Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Star Equity Holdings, Inc.是一家多元化控股公司，致力於透過收購、管理和發展具有強勁基本面和市場機會的業務來建立長期股東價值。其目前的結構由四個部門組成：建築解決方案、商業服務、能源服務和投資。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於康乃狄克州老格林威治。

info.description: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on December 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Cornelius, NC.
info.description_zh: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。該公司成立於2024年12月13日，總部位於北卡羅來納州科尼利厄斯。

info.description: Century Aluminum Co. is a producer of aluminum and operates aluminum reduction facilities, or smelters, in the United States and Iceland. Its products include standard ingots, T-ingot, extrusion billet, horizontal direct chill ingot, molten, slab, and sow. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Century Aluminium Co. 是一家鋁生產商，在美國和冰島經營鋁還原設施或冶煉廠。其產品包括標準鋼錠、T型鋼錠、擠壓鋼坯、水平直冷鋼錠、熔煉鋼錠、板坯和母材。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: OFS Capital Corp. is a business development company, which invests in middle market companies located in the United States. It provides financing for recapitalizations and refinancing, MBOs, LBOs, acquisition financing, shareholder liquidity events, growth capital investments, and ESOPs with an investment of million. The company was founded on March 20, 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: OFS Capital Corp. 是一家業務開發公司，投資位於美國的中間市場公司。它為資本重組和再融資、管理層收購、槓桿收購、收購融資、股東流動性事件、成長資本投資和員工持股計劃提供融資，投資額達數百萬美元。該公司成立於2001年3月20日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 30, 2024 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。公司成立於2024年1月30日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. engages in recycling waste polypropylene into virgin polymer. Its process includes two steps: Feed Pre-Processing and the use of the Technology for purification. The company was founded by John Scott in September 2015 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. 致力於將廢棄聚丙烯回收成原始聚合物。其製程包括兩個步驟：飼料預處理和利用此技術進行純化。該公司由 John Scott 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Largo Inc. is a natural resource and battery energy storage system company. It is engaged in the exploration and production of vanadium at the Maracas Menchen Mine located in Brazil. The firm mines and sells vanadium pentoxide flakes, high purity vanadium pentoxide flakes, and high purity vanadium pentoxide powder. It also focuses on the advancement of renewable energy storage solutions through its vanadium redox flow battery technology. The company was founded on April 18, 1988 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Largo Inc.是一家自然資源和電池儲能係統公司。它在位於巴西的Maracas Menchen礦從事釩的勘探和生產。該公司開採並銷售片狀五氧化二釩、片狀五氧化二釩和粉狀五氧化二釩。它還專注於透過釩氧化還原液流電池技術推進再生能源儲存解決方案。該公司成立於1988年4月18日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Remitly Global, Inc. engages in the provision of digital financial services for immigrants and their families. The company was founded by Matthew B. Oppenheimer and Joshua Hug on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LULU Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LULU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LULU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LULU 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LULU 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LULU 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BitVentures Ltd. is a technology company that develops early-stage technology businesses. The company is actively developing technology ventures across verticals including e-commerce, digital assets, and other areas of consumer and enterprise technology. It also provides client referral services to external financial product partners and offers a range of insurance products, including life insurance products such as individual whole life, term life, health insurance, and universal life insurance; annuity insurance products; and critical illness insurance products, including personal accident insurance products. The company was founded by Hongwei Han in July 19, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BitVentures Ltd. 是一家開發早期技術業務的技術公司。該公司正在積極開發跨垂直行業的技術企業，包括電子商務、數位資產以及消費者和企業技術的其他領域。它還為外部金融產品合作夥伴提供客戶推薦服務，並提供一系列保險產品，包括個人終身壽險、定期壽險、健康險、萬能壽險等壽險產品；年金保險產品；重大疾病保險產品，包括人身意外傷害保險產品。該公司由韓宏偉於2019年7月19日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long UBER Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: UBER). The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long UBER Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Uber Technologies, Inc.（NYSE：UBER）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。基金將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: X4 Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases and those with limited treatment options. It is focused on mavorixafor which is being marketed in the U.S. under the trade name xolremdi. The company was founded by Henri A. Termeer, Keith T. Flaherty, Renato T. Skerlj, Richard Peters and Paula Ragan in 2010 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: X4 Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和發現治療罕見疾病和治療選擇有限的疾病的新型療法。它的重點是 mavorixafor，該藥物在美國以商品名 xolremdi 銷售。該公司由 Henri A. Termeer、Keith T. Flaherty、Renato T. Skerlj、Richard Peters 和 Paula Ragan 於 2010 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Sprout Social, Inc. engages in the provision of online social media management tools for businesses. It offers communication tools, contact management, lead generation, and analytics services. The firm also offers solutions for enterprises, agencies, small businesses, customer service, social media marketing, and employee advocacy sectors. The company was founded by Justyn Howard, Aaron Rankin, Gilbert Lara, and Peter Soung on April 21, 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Sprout Social, Inc. 致力於為企業提供線上社群媒體管理工具。它提供通訊工具、聯絡人管理、潛在客戶開發和分析服務。該公司也為企業、機構、小型企業、客戶服務、社群媒體行銷和員工倡導領域提供解決方案。該公司由 Justyn Howard、Aaron Rankin、Gilbert Lara 和 Peter Soung 於 2010 年 4 月 21 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: SoundHound AI, Inc. engages in the development, owning, and commercialization of voice, sound, and natural language artificial intelligence technologies and related activities. The company was founded by Keyvan Mohajer, Majid Seyed Emami and James M. Hom on September 2, 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SoundHound AI, Inc. 從事語音、聲音和自然語言人工智慧技術及相關活動的開發、擁有和商業化。該公司由 Keyvan Mohajer、Majid Seyed Emami 和 James M. Hom 於 2005 年 9 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of innovative, small molecule therapeutics targeting age-related degenerative diseases and disorders of the central nervous system, or CNS, and retina. It offers the CT1812 which aims to restore the damaged cellular processes that drive diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, dry age-related macular degeneration, geographic atrophy and other conditions. The company was founded by Franz F. Hefti, Gilbert M. Rishton, and Susan M. Catalano on August 21, 2007 and is headquartered in Purchase, NY.
info.description_zh: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發與年齡相關的退化性疾病以及中樞神經系統（CNS）和視網膜疾病的創新小分子療法。它提供的 CT1812 旨在恢復導致阿茲海默症、乾性老年黃斑部病變、地圖樣萎縮和其他疾病等疾病的受損細胞過程。該公司由 Franz F. Hefti、Gilbert M. Rishton 和 Susan M. Catalano 於 2007 年 8 月 21 日創立，總部位於紐約州普切斯。

info.description: Winmark Corp. engages in operating a franchise retail store which includes children's and women's apparel, sporting goods, and musical instruments. The firm's franchise brands include Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore, and Music Go Round. It operates through the Franchising and Other segments. The Franchising segment is involved in value-oriented retail store concepts that buy, sell, trade, and consign merchandise, and provides strategic consulting services related to franchising. The Other segment includes the middle-market equipment leasing and small-ticket franchising businesses conducted through Winmark Capital Corp. and Wirth Business Credit, Inc. The company was founded on July 20, 1988 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Winmark Corp. 從事特許經營零售店的經營，其中包括兒童和女性服裝、體育用品和樂器。該公司的特許經營品牌包括 Plato's Closet、Once Upon A Child、Play It Again Sports、Style Encore 和 Music Go Round。它透過特許經營和其他部門運作。特許經營部門涉及以價值為導向的零售商店概念，購買、銷售、交易和寄售商品，並提供與特許經營相關的策略諮詢服務。其他部門包括透過 Winmark Capital Corp. 和 Wirth Business Credit, Inc. 進行的中階市場設備租賃和小額特許經營業務。該公司成立於 1988 年 7 月 20 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Energous Corp. engages in the development of wireless charging technology. It focuses on the product, WattUp, a wireless power technology consisting of proprietary semiconductor chipsets, software controls, hardware designs, and antennas, that enables radio frequency based charging for electronic devices. The company was founded by Michael Aaron Leabman in 2012 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Energous Corp.從事無線充電技術的開發。它專注於產品 WattUp，這是一種無線充電技術，由專有的半導體晶片組、軟體控制、硬體設計和天線組成，可為電子設備提供基於射頻的充電。該公司由 Michael Aaron Leabman 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: HighPeak Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development and production of oil, natural gas and NGL reserves. The company's assets are primarily located in the Howard County area of the Midland Basin. The company was founded on October 29, 2019 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: HighPeak Energy, Inc.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事石油、天然氣和液化天然氣儲量的收購、開發和生產。該公司的資產主要位於米德蘭盆地的霍華德縣地區。該公司成立於2019年10月29日，總部位於德克薩斯州沃斯堡。

info.description: Outdoor Holding Co. engages in the design and manufacture of products for law enforcement, military, sport shooting, and self-defense. It operates through the following segments: Ammunition, Martketplace, and Corporate and Other. The Ammunition segment consists of the manufacturing business. The Marketplace segment includes GunBroker.com. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Outdoor Holding Co. 從事執法、軍事、運動射擊和自衛產品的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：彈藥部門、市場部門、企業及其他部門。彈藥部門由製造業務組成。市場部分包括 GunBroker.com。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Microbot Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the research, design, and development of robotic endoluminal surgery devices targeting the minimally invasive surgery space. It carries out its operations through the ViRob and TipCat platforms. The ViRob platform technology is an autonomous crawling micro-robot that can be controlled remotely or within the body. It makes use of the Self-Cleaning Shunt, a robotic system designed as the ventricular catheter portion of a Cerebrospinal Fluid shunt system and is mainly used for the treatment of hydrocephalus and Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus. The TipCat platform, a self-propelling, flexible, and semi-disposable endoscope, provides see-and-treat capabilities within tubular lumens in the human body such as the colon, blood vessels, and the urinary tract. The company was founded by Harel Gadot, Moshe Shoham, and Yosseph Bornstein on August 2, 1988 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Microbot Medical, Inc.是一家醫療器材公司，從事針對微創手術領域的機器人腔內手術設備的研究、設計和開發。它透過 ViRob 和 TipCat 平台開展業務。 ViRob平台技術是一種自主爬行微型機器人，可遠端控製或在體內控制。它利用自清潔分流器，這是一種機器人系統，設計為腦脊髓液分流系統的腦室導管部分，主要用於治療腦積水和正常壓力腦積水。 TipCat 平台是一種自推進式、靈活的半一次性內視鏡，可在人體管狀腔內（如結腸、血管和泌尿道）提供檢視和治療功能。該公司由 Harel Gadot、Moshe Shoham 和 Yosseph Bornstein 於 1988 年 8 月 2 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and provision of products and services for the renewable energy, residential, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Infrastructure, and Agtech. The Residential segment includes roof and foundation ventilation products, rain dispersion products and roofing accessories, centralized mail systems, and electronic package solutions. The Infrastructure segment provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways, and airfields including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems. The Agtech segment offers growing and processing solutions including designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction, and maintenance and support of greenhouses, indoor growing operations, and botanical extraction systems. The company was founded on September 1, 1972 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. 從事為再生能源、住宅和基礎設施市場製造和提供產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、基礎設施部門和農業科技部門。住宅部門包括屋頂和地基通風產品、雨水分散產品和屋頂配件、集中式郵件系統和電子成套解決方案。基礎設施部門為橋樑、高速公路和機場提供工程解決方案，包括結構軸承、伸縮縫、路面密封、彈性混凝土和橋樑電纜保護系統。農業科技部門提供種植和加工解決方案，包括溫室、室內種植作業和植物提取系統的設計、工程、製造、全方位建設以及維護和支援。該公司成立於1972年9月1日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, franchising, licensing, and operation of quick-service restaurants under the name El Pollo Loco. It specializes in fire-grilling fresh citrus-marinated chicken with a variety of offerings including Chicken Avocado Burrito, Pollo Fit entrees, chicken tostada salads, and Pollo Bowls. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. 從事 El Pollo Loco 名稱下快餐店的開發、特許經營、許可和營運業務。它專門提供火烤新鮮柑橘醃製雞肉，提供各種菜餚，包括雞肉酪梨捲餅、Pollo Fit 主菜、雞肉托斯塔達沙拉和 Pollo Bowls。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Viant Technology, Inc. is an advertising technology company, which develops and manages an enterprise software platform. The firm also offers Adelphic, an omnichannel demand-side platform which enables marketers to execute programmatic advertising campaigns. Its solutions include ViantAI, Demand Side Platform, Connected TV Advertising, Omnichannel marketing, and Data Platform. The company was founded by Timothy C. Vanderhook, Christopher John Vanderhook, and Russell T. Vanderhook in 1999 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Viant Technology, Inc. 是一家廣告科技公司，開發和管理企業軟體平台。該公司還提供 Adelphic，這是一個全通路需求方平台，使行銷人員能夠執行程式化廣告活動。其解決方案包括ViantAI、需求方平台、連網電視廣告、全通路行銷和數據平台。該公司由 Timothy C. Vanderhook、Christopher John Vanderhook 和 Russell T. Vanderhook 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Nutex Health, Inc. engages in the management and operation of healthcare facilities. It operates through the following segments: Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real State Division. The Hospital Division is involved in developing and operating a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments (HOPDs). The Population Health Division establishes and operates provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs). The Real State Division owns land and hospital buildings which are leased to hospital entities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nutex Health, Inc. 從事醫療保健設施的管理和營運。它透過以下部門運作：醫院部門、人口健康管理部門和房地產部門。醫院部門參與開發和營運微型醫院、專科醫院和醫院門診部 (HOPD) 網路。人口健康部門建立並運作獨立醫師協會 (IPA) 等提供者網路。房地產部門擁有出租給醫院實體的土地和醫院建築。該公司成立於 2011 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Atlanticus Holdings Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial technology and related services. It operates through the Credit as a Service (CaaS) and Auto Finance segments. The CaaS segment includes private label credit and general purpose credit cards originated by lenders through multiple channels, including retail and healthcare, direct mail solicitation, digital marketing and partnerships with third parties. The Auto Finance segment services loans secured by independent automotive dealers and automotive finance companies in the buy-here, pay-here used car business. The company was founded by David G. Hanna in August 1996 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlanticus Holdings Corp.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融科技及相關服務。它透過信貸即服務（CaaS）和汽車金融部門運作。 CaaS 部分包括貸款人透過多種管道發起的自有品牌信用卡和通用信用卡，包括零售和醫療保健、直郵招攬、數位行銷以及與第三方的合作。汽車金融部門為獨立汽車經銷商和汽車金融公司在「在這裡購買、在這裡付款」的二手車業務中提供擔保的貸款服務。該公司由 David G. Hanna 於 1996 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online exam preparation services and related technology solutions, and production of online training course materials. It operates through the Online Education Cloud Service (B2B2C) and Online Training Service (B2C). The B2B2C segment comprises online education platforms to institutions, such as universities, training institutions, and online course development service companies. The B2C segment provides online training and examination preparation services directly to students for a fee. The company was founded on July 23, 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 華富教育集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上考試準備服務和相關技術解決方案以及製作線上培訓課程材料。它透過線上教育雲端服務（B2B2C）和線上培訓服務（B2C）運作。 B2B2C 領域包括大學、培訓機構和線上課程開發服務公司等機構的線上教育平台。 B2C 部門直接向學生提供收費的線上培訓和考試準備服務。公司成立於2012年7月23日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: First Advantage Corp. is a provider of employment background screening, identity, and verification solutions. It operates through the following segments: First Advantage Americas, First Advantage International, and Sterling. The First Advantage Americas segment performs a variety of background check and compliance services across all phases of the workforce lifecycle, from pre-onboarding to post-onboarding and ongoing monitoring, covering employees, contractors, contingent workers, tenants, and drivers. The First Advantage International segment involves regions such as Europe, India, and Asia Pacific. The Sterling segment refers to Sterling Check Corp., which provides services globally. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: First Advantage Corp. 是一家就業背景篩選、身分和驗證解決方案提供者。它透過以下部門運作：First Advantage Americas、First Advantage International 和 Sterling。 First Advantage Americas 部門在勞動力生命週期的各個階段提供各種背景調查和合規服務，從入職前到入職後以及持續監控，涵蓋員工、承包商、臨時工、租戶和司機。第一優諮詢國際部門涉及歐洲、印度和亞太地區等地區。 Sterling 部門是指在全球範圍內提供服務的 Sterling Check Corp.。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: WW International, Inc. engages in the provision of weight management services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other. The company was founded by Jean Nidetch in 1963 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WW International, Inc. 從事提供體重管理服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他地區。該公司由 Jean Nidetch 於 1963 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: OPAL Fuels, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of low-carbon intensity renewable natural gas. It operates as a vertical waste-to-energy model that combines the upstream production and downstream marketing and distribution of RNG. The company operates under the following segments: RNG Fuel, Fuel Station Services, Renewable Power, and Corporate. The RNG Fuel segment relates to all RNG supply and dispensing activities directly related to the generation and sale of brown gas. The Fuel Station Services provides construction and maintenance services to third-party owners of vehicle fueling stations. The Renewable Power segment generates renewable power which is then sold to public utilities. The Corporate segment consists of activities managed and maintained at the company corporate level. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in White Plains, NY.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的燃氣
info.description_zh: OPAL Fuels, Inc. 從事低碳強度可再生天然氣的生產和分銷。它以垂直垃圾發電模式運作，結合了RNG的上游生產和下游行銷和分銷。該公司經營以下業務部門：RNG 燃料部門、加油站服務部門、再生能源部門和企業部門。 RNG 燃料部門涉及與棕色氣體的產生和銷售直接相關的所有 RNG 供應和分配活動。加油站服務為車輛加油站的第三方所有者提供建造和維護服務。再生能源部門生產再生電力，然後出售給公用事業公司。公司部門由公司層級管理和維護的活動組成。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於紐約州懷特普萊恩斯。

info.description: Jiayin Group, Inc. engages in the operation of an online individual finance marketplace in China, which connects individual investors and individual borrowers. The company was founded by Dinggui Yan in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 嘉銀集團在中國從事線上個人金融市場的運營，該市場連接個人投資者和個人借款人。該公司由嚴鼎貴於2011年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: i3 Verticals, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solutions to public sector solutions. It delivers end-to-end digital transformation, streamlining complex government operations, and citizen engagement. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: i3 Verticals, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於為公共部門解決方案提供企業軟體解決方案。它提供端到端的數位轉型，簡化複雜的政府運作和公民參與。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: CVRx, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, and commercializing neuromodulation solutions for patients with cardiovascular diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Robert S. Kieval and Tyler P. Lipschultz in August 2001 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: CVRx, Inc. 致力於為心血管疾病患者開發、製造和商業化神經調節解決方案。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他國家。該公司由 Robert S. Kieval 和 Tyler P. Lipschultz 於 2001 年 8 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: TEN Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of event planning, production, and broadcasting services. The firm produces virtual, hybrid, and physical events such as live streaming and video recording. It also offers the Xyvid Pro Platform, which supports virtual and hybrid event planning, as well as production, broadcasting, and continuing education services. The company was founded on December 5, 2011 and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: TEN Holdings, Inc. 從事提供活動規劃、製作和廣播服務。該公司製作虛擬、混合和實體活動，例如直播和錄影。它還提供 Xyvid Pro 平台，支援虛擬和混合活動策劃以及製作、廣播和繼續教育服務。該公司成立於2011年12月5日，總部位於賓州蘭霍恩。

info.description: All In FutureTech Alliance, Inc. operates as an experiential entertainment company, which engages in the creation of esports venues and live events for both video games and poker. It operates through following segments: E-Sports, Casual Mobile Gaming, and Live Concert Promotion and Events Organizing. The E-Sports segment includes video game events and tournaments through Allied Esports. The Casual Mobile Gaming segment is provided through Z-Tech. The Live Concert Promotion and Events Organizing segment is provided through Skyline. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: All In FutureTech Alliance, Inc. 是一家體驗式娛樂公司，致力於為電玩遊戲和撲克創建電競場地和現場活動。它透過以下部門運作：電子競技、休閒行動遊戲、現場音樂會推廣和活動組織。電競部分包括透過 Allied Esports 舉辦的電玩賽事和錦標賽。休閒行動遊戲部分由 Z-Tech 提供。現場音樂會推廣和活動組織部分透過 Skyline 提供。該公司成立於2017年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of land-based aquaculture services. It includes farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, shellfish, crustaceans, and aquatic plants. The firm focuses on a salmon product, a bioengineered Atlantic salmon that can grow to market size faster than conventional farmed Atlantic salmon. The company was founded by Elliot Z. Entis and Garth L. Fletcher on December 17, 1991 and is headquartered in Harvard, MA.
info.description_zh: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. 從事提供陸基水產養殖服務。它包括魚類、貝類、甲殼類和水生植物等水生生物的養殖。該公司專注於鮭魚產品，這是一種生物工程大西洋鮭魚，它可以比傳統養殖的大西洋鮭魚更快長到上市尺寸。該公司由 Elliot Z. Entis 和 Garth L. Fletcher 於 1991 年 12 月 17 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州哈佛大學。

info.description: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of light emitting diode lighting systems, wireless Internet of Things enabled control, commercial and industrial electric vehicle charging infrastructure solutions, and lighting and electrical maintenance services. It operates through the following segments: Lighting, Maintenance, Electric Vehicle Charging (EV), and Corporate and Other. The Lighting segment is involved in the development and sale of lighting products and provides construction and engineering services for commercial lighting and energy management systems. The Maintenance segment focuses on retailers, distributors, and other businesses with maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components. The EV segment offers electric vehicle charging expertise and provides EV turnkey installation solutions with ongoing support to all commercial verticals. The Corporate and Other segment includes operating expenses. The company was founded by Neal R. Verfuerth and Patrick J. Trotter in April 1996 and is headquartered in Manitowoc, WI.
info.description_zh: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. 從事提供發光二極管照明系統、無線物聯網控制、商業和工業電動車充電基礎設施解決方案以及照明和電氣維護服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：照明部門、維修部門、電動車充電部門（EV）以及企業及其他部門。照明部門從事照明產品的開發和銷售，並為商業照明和能源管理系統提供建築和工程服務。維修部門專注於為照明及相關電氣元件提供維護、維修和更換服務的零售商、經銷商和其他企業。電動車部門提供電動車充電專業知識，並提供電動車交鑰匙安裝解決方案，並為所有商業垂直領域提供持續支援。公司及其他部門包括營運費用。該公司由 Neal R. Verfuerth 和 Patrick J. Trotter 於 1996 年 4 月創立，總部位於威斯康辛州馬尼托瓦克。

info.description: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. engages in the vehicle rental business through Hertz, Dollar, and Thrifty brands. It operates through the following business segments: Americas Rental Car (RAC) and International Rental Car (RAC). The Americas RAC segment focuses on operations in the United States, Canada, Latin America, and the Caribbean. The International RAC segment includes the provision of rental and sales of vehicles and value-added services in other locations. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Estero, FL.
info.description_zh: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. 透過 Hertz、Dollar 和 Thrifty 品牌從事汽車租賃業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：美洲租車（RAC）和國際租車（RAC）。美洲 RAC 部門專注於美國、加拿大、拉丁美洲和加勒比地區的業務。國際RAC部門包括在其他地點提供車輛租賃和銷售以及增值服務。該公司成立於 1918 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州埃斯特羅。

info.description: Organigram Global, Inc. engages in the provision of high-quality, indoor-grown cannabis for patients and adult recreational consumers and developing international business partnerships to extend the company's global footprint. Its brands include Edison, Big Bag O' Buds, SHRED, Monjour, and Trailblazer. The company was founded on July 5, 2010 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Organigram Global, Inc. 致力於為患者和成人娛樂消費者提供高品質的室內種植大麻，並發展國際業務合作夥伴關係以擴大公司的全球足跡。其品牌包括 Edison、Big Bag O' Buds、SHRED、Monjour 和 Trailblazer。該公司成立於2010年7月5日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Mako Mining Corp. engages in the development and exploration of gold. It also focuses on San Albino gold project located in Nueva Segovia, Nicaragua. The company was founded on April 1, 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Mako Mining Corp. 從事黃金的開發和勘探。它還專注於位於尼加拉瓜新塞哥維亞的San Albino金礦計畫。該公司成立於2004年4月1日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Aura Minerals, Inc. engages in the development and operation of gold, copper, and base metal projects in the Americas. It operates through the following segments: Minosa Mine, Apoena Mine, the Aranzazu Mine, Almas Mine, and Borborema Project. The company was founded on July 12, 1946 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aura Minerals, Inc. 在美洲從事金、銅和賤金屬專案的開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：Minosa 礦、Apoena 礦、Aranzazu 礦、Almas 礦和 Borborema 計畫。该公司成立于 1946 年 7 月 12 日，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: NextNav, Inc. engages in development of positioning, navigation, and timing solutions. Its products include NextNav Pinnacle, NextNav 3D, and NextNav TerraPoiNT. The company was founded by Ganesh Pattabiraman and Arun Raghupathy in May 2021 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: NextNav, Inc. 從事定位、導航和授時解決方案的開發。其產品包括 NextNav Pinnacle、NextNav 3D 和 NextNav TerraPoiNT。該公司由 Ganesh Pattabiraman 和 Arun Raghupathy 於 2021 年 5 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: electroCore, Inc. engages in the provision of non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation (nVNS) therapy. It develops a platform bioelectronic medical therapy that modulates neurotransmitters and immune function through its effects on both the peripheral and central nervous systems. The company was founded by Joseph P. Errico, Steven M. Mendez, Peter S. Staats and Thomas J. Errico in September 2005 and is headquartered in Rockaway, NJ.
info.description_zh: electroCore, Inc. 從事提供非侵入性迷走神經刺激 (nVNS) 治療。它開發了一個生物電子醫學療法平台，透過其對週邊和中樞神經系統的影響來調節神經傳導物質和免疫功能。該公司由 Joseph P. Errico、Steven M. Mendez、Peter S. Staats 和 Thomas J. Errico 於 2005 年 9 月創立，總部位於新澤西州洛克威。
