info.description: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and commercializing novel products. It operates through the Rx and Consumer Health segments. The RX segment consists of various prescription pharmaceutical products sold through third parties. The Consumer Health segment includes various consumer health products sold directly to consumers. Its products include Adzenys ER, Adzenys XR-ODT, Cotempla XR-ODT, Karbinal ER, Poly-Vi-Flor, Tri-Vi-Flor, Generic Tussionex, Tuzistra XR, and ZolpiMist. The company was founded on August 9, 2002 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和商業化新產品。它透過處方藥和消費者健康部門運作。 RX 部門由透過第三方銷售的各種處方藥品組成。消費者健康部門包括直接銷售給消費者的各種消費者健康產品。其產品包括 Adzenys ER、Adzenys XR-ODT、Cotempla XR-ODT、Karbinal ER、Poly-Vi-Flor、Tri-Vi-Flor、Generic Tussionex、Tuzistra XR 和 ZolpiMist。該公司成立於2002年8月9日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: BHAV Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Piscataway, NJ.
info.description_zh: BHAV Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，致力於與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於新澤西州皮斯卡塔韋。

info.description: Boxlight Corp. is a technological company, which engages in development, sale, and servicing of interactive solutions for the global education market. It also designs, manufactures, and distributes interactive projectors, flat-panel displays, touch projectors, touch boards, and MimioTeach through the Boxlight Group and Genesis brands. The company was founded by Herbert Myers and Sloan Myers in 1985 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Boxlight Corp. 是一家科技公司，致力於為全球教育市場提供互動式解決方案的開發、銷售和服務。它還透過 Boxlight Group 和 Genesis 品牌設計、製造和分銷互動式投影機、平板顯示器、觸控投影機、觸控板和 MimioTeach。該公司由 Herbert Myers 和 Sloan Myers 於 1985 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2030 (collectively, "2030 Bonds"). It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2030 年債券」）。它不購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。

info.description: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of artificial intelligence solutions in neuroscience and immuno-oncology. It also focuses on utilizing technology and research to develop therapeutics solutions. The company was founded by Vimal D. Mehta on March 29, 2017 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事神經科學和免疫腫瘤學領域人工智慧解決方案的開發。它還專注於利用技術和研究來開發治療解決方案。該公司由 Vimal D. Mehta 於 2017 年 3 月 29 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRWV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of CRWV. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRWV, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRWV 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRWV 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 CRWV 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dogness (International) Corp. engages in the provision of design and manufacture of pet products, including leashes, and smart products. Its products include leashes, lanyards, ribbon, collars, harnesses ornaments, and specialty products for cats and dogs. The firm produces the products in Classic, Elegance, Luxury, LED, Holiday, Special Function, and Cat series. The company was founded by Shilong Chen in 2003 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
info.description_zh: 多尼斯（國際）有限公司從事寵物產品的設計和製造，包括牽引繩和智慧產品。其產品包括皮帶、掛繩、緞帶、項圈、挽具裝飾品以及貓狗專用產品。本公司生產的產品有經典系列、優雅系列、豪華系列、LED系列、假日系列、特殊功能係列、貓咪系列等。該公司由陳世龍於2003年創立，總部位於中國東莞。

info.description: Evotec SE is a life science company, which engages in the discovery and development of new drugs for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. It operates through the Shared R&D and Just-Evotec Biologics segments. The Shared R&D segment includes drug discovery and development services and solutions. The Just-Evotec Biologics segment provides services related to designing, discovering, developing, and manufacturing of modern biotherapeutics. The company was founded by Manfred Eigen, Karsten Henco, Ulrich Aldag, Freimut Leidenberger, Heinrich Maria Schulte, Rudolf Rigler, Charles Weissmann, and Nobel Laureate on December 8, 1993 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Evotec SE 是一家生命科學公司，致力於為製藥和生物技術公司發現和開發新藥。它透過共享研發部門和 Just-Evotec Biologics 部門運作。共享研發部門包括藥物發現及開發服務及解決方案。 Just-Evotec Biologics 部門提供與現代生物治療藥物的設計、發現、開發和製造相關的服務。該公司由Manfred Eigen、Karsten Henco、Ulrich Aldag、Freimut Leidenberger、Heinrich Maria Schulte、Rudolf Rigler、Charles Weissmann和諾貝爾獎得主於1993年12月8日創立，總部位於德國漢堡。

info.description: FiEE, Inc. is a digital service provider focused on integrating artificial intelligence and data analytics into content creation and brand management. It offers a range of services designed to support creators, artists, and businesses in developing, managing, and optimizing their digital presence across global platforms, including customized graphic and posts, short videos, and editorial calendars aligned with brand goals. The company was founded by Frank Blase Manning and Peter Robin Kramer in May 1977 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: FiEE, Inc. 是一家數位服務供應商，專注於將人工智慧和數據分析整合到內容創建和品牌管理中。它提供一系列服務，旨在支持創作者、藝術家和企業在全球平台上開發、管理和優化他們的數位形象，包括與品牌目標一致的定製圖形和貼文、短影片和編輯日曆。該公司由 Frank Blase Manning 和 Peter Robin Kramer 於 1977 年 5 月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: GigaMedia Ltd. is engaged in the provision of digital entertainment services. Through its subsidiary, FunTown, it manages mobile and browse-based casual games. Its portfolio includes MahJong, online card games, and multi-player role-playing online games. The company was founded in October 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: GigaMedia Ltd. 從事提供數位娛樂服務。它透過其子公司 FunTown 管理行動和基於瀏覽的休閒遊戲。其產品包括麻將、線上紙牌遊戲和多人角色扮演線上遊戲。公司成立於1998年10月，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: GrowGeneration Corp. engages in the development, marketing, retail, and distribution of hydroponic products and services. It operates through the following segments: Cultivating and Gardening, Storage Solutions, and Corporate. The Cultivating and Gardening segment includes hydroponic and organic gardening business. The Storage Solutions segment involves benching and racking. The company was founded by Darren Lampert and Michael S. Salaman on March 6, 2014 and is headquartered in Greenwood Village, CO.
info.description_zh: GrowGeneration Corp. 從事水耕產品和服務的開發、行銷、零售和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：栽培和園藝部門、儲存解決方案部門和企業部門。栽培和園藝部門包括水耕和有機園藝業務。儲存解決方案部分涉及桌上型和機架。該公司由 Darren Lampert 和 Michael S. Salaman 於 2014 年 3 月 6 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州格林伍德村。

info.description: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture of drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and electric vehicles, as well as electric industrial vehicles. Its products include the GEF-series electric forklifts, a series of lithium-powered forklifts with three models ranging in size from 1.8 tons to 3.5 tons, and GEL-1800, a 1.8 ton rated load lithium-powered electric wheeled front loader and GEX-8000, an all-electric 8.0 ton rated load lithium-powered wheeled excavator. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, NJ.
info.description_zh: 格陵蘭科技控股公司從事物料搬運機械和電動汽車以及電動工業車輛傳動系統的製造。產品包括GEF系列電動堆高機、1.8噸至3.5噸三種型號的鋰動力堆高機、1.8噸額定載重鋰動力電動輪式裝載機GEL-1800及8.0噸額定載重全電動鋰動力輪式挖土機GEX-8000。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於新澤西州東溫莎。

info.description: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. operates as a tanker pool company. It is engaged primarily in the commercial management and chartering of crude oil and refined petroleum product tankers. The company was founded on May 7, 2024 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece.
info.description_zh: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. 是一家油輪聯營公司。它主要從事原油和成品油油輪的商業管理和租賃。該公司成立於2024年5月7日，總部位於希臘比雷埃夫斯。

info.description: HeartFlow, Inc. operates as a cardiovascular company which engages in diagnosing coronary artery diseases. The firm provides a patient-specific analysis of coronary blood flow utilizing coronary CT scans and proprietary computer algorithms based on computational fluid dynamics. The company was founded by Charles A. Taylor, Nathan M. Wilson, and Christopher K. Zarins in July 2007 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: HeartFlow, Inc. 是一家從事冠狀動脈疾病診斷的心血管公司。該公司利用冠狀動脈 CT 掃描和基於計算流體動力學的專有電腦演算法，提供針對患者的冠狀動脈血流分析。該公司由 Charles A. Taylor、Nathan M. Wilson 和 Christopher K. Zarins 於 2007 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Intelligent Bio Solutions, Inc. is a medical technology company, which engages in delivering testing solutions. It operates through the Intelligent Fingerprinting Products (IFPG) and Saliva Glucose Biosensor Platform (SGBP) segments. It offers biochemistry, immunology, tumor markers, hormones, and nucleic acid diagnostic modalities. The company was founded on December 5, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Intelligence Bio Solutions, Inc.是一家醫療技術公司，致力於提供測試解決方案。它透過智慧指紋產品（IFPG）和唾液葡萄糖生物感測器平台（SGBP）部門運作。它提供生物化學、免疫學、腫瘤標記、荷爾蒙和核酸診斷方式。該公司成立於2016年12月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: JFB Construction Holdings is a commercial and residential real estate construction and development company, which engages in delivering services to commercial and residential markets. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Construction, Residential Construction, and Real Estate Development. The Commercial Construction segment includes all activities related to the construction of commercial properties. The Residential Construction segment focuses on the construction of residential properties including single-family homes and multi-family units. The Real Estate Development segment refers to the acquisition, development, and sale of real estate properties. The company was founded by Joseph F. Basille III on April 9, 2024 and is headquartered in Lantana, FL.
info.description_zh: JFB Construction Holdings 是一家商業和住宅房地產建設和開發公司，致力於為商業和住宅市場提供服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業建築、住宅建築和房地產開發。商業建築部門包括與商業房地產建設相關的所有活動。住宅建築部門專注於住宅物業的建設，包括單戶住宅和多戶住宅。房地產開發部門是指房地產的收購、開發和銷售。該公司由 Joseph F. Basille III 於 2024 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州蘭塔納。

info.description: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. The company was founded by Edward King and Dan Fetters on July 2, 2024 and is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。該公司由 Edward King 和 Dan Fetters 於 2024 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州曼哈頓海灘。

info.description: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 6, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2026年1月6日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。

info.description: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions through MainStreet Bank. It offers products and services such as checking, deposits, loans, credit cards, mortgages, and savings. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Real Estate Commercial, Construction, Commercial, and Consumer. The company was founded on March 28, 2003 and is headquartered in Fairfax, VA.
info.description_zh: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過 MainStreet Bank 提供銀行解決方案。它提供支票、存款、貸款、信用卡、抵押貸款和儲蓄等產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、房地產商業部門、建築部門、商業部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於2003年3月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州費爾法克斯。

info.description: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. engages in providing supply chain management solutions through its subsidiaries. The company focuses on the sourcing, distribution, and consulting of food and non-alcoholic beverages and has expanded its supply chain management offerings to include e-waste reverse supply chain services. The company was founded on February 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. 透過其子公司提供供應鏈管理解決方案。該公司專注於食品和非酒精飲料的採購、分銷和諮詢，並將其供應鏈管理產品擴展到包括電子垃圾逆向供應鏈服務。該公司成立於2024年2月27日，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Neonode, Inc. engages in the provision of advanced optical sensing solutions for contactless touch, touch, and gesture sensing. It offers software solutions for scene analysis that feature advanced machine learning algorithms to detect and track persons and objects in video streams for cameras and other types of imagers. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, South Korea, China, Germany, Switzerland, and Other. The company was founded by Thomas Eriksson Bjorn on September 4, 1997 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
info.description_zh: Neonode, Inc. 致力於為非接觸式觸控、觸控和手勢感測提供先進的光學感測解決方案。它提供用於場景分析的軟體解決方案，具有先進的機器學習演算法，可以檢測和追蹤攝影機和其他類型成像器視訊串流中的人員和物體。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、韓國、中國、德國、瑞士等。該公司由 Thomas Eriksson Bjorn 於 1997 年 9 月 4 日創立，總部位於瑞典斯德哥爾摩。

info.description: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. engages in uranium exploration and development with proprietary small modular reactor (SMR) technology to address structural supply challenges in the U.S. nuclear sector. It offers Uranium Resources and Proprietary Small Modular Reactor (SMR) Technology. The company was founded on September 19, 2025 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. 利用專有的小型模組化反應器 (SMR) 技術從事鈾勘探和開發，以解決美國核能產業的結構性供應挑戰。它提供鈾資源和專有的小型模組化反應器（SMR）技術。該公司成立於2025年9月19日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: CL Workshop Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in forest management, harvesting, and down-stream wood processing and distribution of logs, decking, flooring, and sawn timber products. Its products include wood decking, wood flooring, sawn timber, log, and charcoal. It operates through the Direct Purchase and Original Design Manufacturer (ODM), and Manufacturing Segments. The Direct Purchase and ODM segment represent sourcing of live wood and owning designed design on wood products for sale to end customers. The Manufacturing segment includes manufacturing decking, flooring, and sawn timbers. The company was founded on September 22, 2011 and is headquartered in Macau, China.
info.description_zh: CL Workshop Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事森林管理、採伐和下游木材加工以及原木、地板、地板和鋸材產品的分銷。其產品包括木地板、木地板、鋸材、原木和木炭。它透過直接採​​購和原始設計製造商 (ODM) 以及製造部門運作。直接採購和 ODM 部門代表採購活木材並擁有木製品的設計設計以銷售給最終客戶。製造部門包括製造裝飾板、地板和鋸材。該公司成立於2011年9月22日，總部位於中國澳門。

info.description: Orion Digital Corp. operates as a financial technology company. Its products and services include MogoMoney, MogoProtect, MogoCard, MogoMortgage, MogoCrypto and Moka services. The company was founded by David Feller and Gregory Feller on January 14, 1972 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Orion Digital Corp. 是一家金融科技公司。其產品和服務包括MogoMoney、MogoProtect、MogoCard、MogoMortgage、MogoCrypto 和Moka 服務。該公司由 David Feller 和 Gregory Feller 於 1972 年 1 月 14 日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq International Patent Leaders Index. The index is a rules-based full market capitalization-weighted index that consists of companies from the Nasdaq Global Ex United States Large Mid Cap Index with the most valuable patent portfolios. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克國際專利領導者指數（未計費用和開支）的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的完整市值加權指數，由納斯達克全球（美國除外）大中型股指數中擁有最有價值專利組合的公司組成。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in the development of novel precision cancer medicines. It also focuses on the design and development of small molecule agents for cancer medicines. The company was founded by Krishna Vaddi in 2016 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段腫瘤公司，致力於開發新型精準癌症藥物。它還專注於癌症藥物小分子藥物的設計和開發。該公司由 Krishna Vaddi 於 2016 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc. operates as an international franchiser of chocolate and confection stores. Its products include milk chocolate, dark chocolate, boxed chocolate, truffles, caramels, and gourmet caramel apples. The firm operates through the following segments: Franchising, Manufacturing, Retail Stores, and Unallocated. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Durango, CO.
info.description_zh: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc. 是一家國際巧克力和糖果店特許經營商。其產品包括牛奶巧克力、黑巧克力、盒裝巧克力、松露、焦糖和美味焦糖蘋果。該公司透過以下部門運作：特許經營、製造、零售店和未分配部門。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於科羅拉多州杜蘭戈。

info.description: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 28, 2026 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2026 年 2 月 28 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: RUM Group, Inc. engages in operating an online neutral video platform. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Canada, and Other. The company was founded in October 2013 by Chris Pavlovski and is headquartered in Longboat Key, FL.
info.description_zh: RUM Group, Inc. 從事營運線上中立視訊平台。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、加拿大和其他地區。該公司由 Chris Pavlovski 於 2013 年 10 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朗博特島。

info.description: Solarius Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on April 1, 2025 and is headquartered in Darien, CT.
info.description_zh: Solarius Capital Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司營運。該公司成立於2025年4月1日，總部位於康乃狄克州達里恩。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: WEBs Materials XLB Defined Volatility ETF is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the U.S. large-cap materials sector while employing a systematic, rules-based strategy to target a specific annual volatility rate. The fund dynamically adjusts its market exposure between 0% and 200% based on recent realized volatility, increasing exposure through derivatives when market fluctuations are low and reducing exposure to cash when volatility exceeds the target.
info.description_zh: WEBs Materials XLB 定義波動率 ETF 是一款被動管理基金，提供對美國大盤材料行業的投資，同時採用系統化的、基於規則的策略來瞄準特定的年度波動率。該基金根據近期實現的波動率在0%至200%之間動態調整其市場敞口，當市場波動較低時透過衍生性商品增加敞口，當波動率超過目標時減少現金敞口。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2030. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index (the "underlying index"). It may also invest in short-term paper, cash and cash equivalents, including shares of money market funds advised by BFA or its affiliates. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2030 and December 15, 2030, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2030 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數（「基礎指數」）標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。它還可以投資短期票據、現金和現金等價物，包括 BFA 或其附屬機構建議的貨幣市場基金股票。標的指數由計劃於 2030 年 1 月 1 日至 2030 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 17, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年10月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: American Century Securitized Credit ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund seeking high current income and total return by investing primarily in investment-grade U.S. securitized debt across non-traditional asset-backed categories, such as aircraft leases, equipment leases, consumer loans, cell towers, and digital infrastructure. The strategy applies fundamental credit analysis and proprietary quantitative risk modeling to identify high-quality, lower-duration opportunities within underrepresented structured credit markets.
info.description_zh: American Century Securitized Credit ETF 是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，主要投資於飛機租賃、設備租賃、消費貸款、手機訊號塔和數位基礎設施等非傳統資產支援類別的投資等級美國證券化債務，尋求高當期收入和總回報。此策略應用基本信用分析和專有的定量風險模型來識別代表性不足的結構性信貸市場中的高品質、期限較短的機會。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2031. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2031 and December 15, 2031, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2031 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2031 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: Longview Advantage Fixed Income ETF is an actively managed fund of funds that primarily invests in unaffiliated ETFs to capture term and credit premiums across the U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade fixed income market. The strategy employs a proprietary analytical framework to rotate between underlying funds based on yield curve positioning and uses a tactical ex-dividend rotation technique to minimize distribution-related performance lags and trading frictions.
info.description_zh: Longview Advantage 固定收益 ETF 是一種主動管理的基金中的基金，主要投資於非附屬 ETF，以獲取以美元計價的投資等級固定收益市場的期限和信用溢價。此策略採用專有的分析框架，根據殖利率曲線定位在基礎基金之間進行輪換，並使用戰術性除息輪換技術來最大限度地減少與分配相關的績效滯後和交易摩擦。

info.description: U.S. GoldMining, Inc. operates as a gold and copper exploration company. It focuses on unlocking the substantial value of the Whistler gold-copper project. The company was founded on June 30, 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: U.S. GoldMining, Inc. 是一家黃金和銅勘探公司。它的重點是釋放惠斯勒金銅計畫的實質價值。公司成立於2015年6月30日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: PhenixFIN Corp. is an internally-managed non-diversified closed-end management investment company. Its investment objective is to generate current income and capital appreciation. The company was founded on April 23, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: PhenixFIN Corp. 是一家內部管理的非多元化封閉式管理投資公司。其投資目標是產生當期收入和資本增值。該公司成立於2010年4月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 5, 2024, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. II 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月5日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Bowman Consulting Group Ltd. operates as a professional services firm delivering innovative engineering solutions to customers who own, develop, and maintain the built environment. It provides planning, engineering, construction management, commissioning, environmental consulting, survey, land procurement and technical services. The company was founded by Gary P. Bowman in 1995 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: Bowman Consulting Group Ltd. 是一家專業服務公司，為擁有、開發和維護建築環境的客戶提供創新的工程解決方案。它提供規劃、工程、施工管理、調試、環境諮詢、勘察、土地採購和技術服務。該公司由 Gary P. Bowman 於 1995 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: China Natural Resources, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of exploration and mining in the People's Republic of China (PRC). It focuses on the exploration for lead, silver, and other metals, and copper trading in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the PRC. The company was founded on December 14, 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 中國自然資源股份有限公司是一家投資控股公司，在中華人民共和國（中國）從事勘探和採礦業務。其專注於中國內蒙古自治區的鉛、銀及其他金屬勘探及銅貿易。公司成立於1993年12月14日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Chemomab Therapeutics Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotech company, which engages in the provision of therapeutics for conditions with unmet need that involve Inflammation and fibrosis. The company was founded by Adi Mor on September 22, 2011 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Chemomab Therapeutics Ltd. 是一家临床阶段的生物技术公司，致力于为炎症和纤维化等未满足需求的疾病提供治疗药物。該公司由Adi Mor於2011年9月22日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月3日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Valneva SE is a specialty vaccine company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs. It currently provides three proprietary travel vaccines: IXIARO, DUKORAL, and IXCHIQ. The IXIARO is an inactivated Vero cell culture-derived Japanese encephalitis vaccine indicated for active immunization against Japanese encephalitis in adults, adolescents, children, and infants aged two months and older. The DUKORAL is a drinkable vaccine that helps prevent diarrhea caused by heat-labile toxin-producing ETEC, as well as cholera. The IXCHIQ is a single-dose, live-attenuated vaccine for the prevention of disease caused by chikungunya virus. The company also offers additional vaccines, including VLA1553, VLA15, VLA160, VLA200, VLA1601 and others. Valneva was founded on May 28, 2013 and is headquartered in Saint-Herblain, France.
info.description_zh: Valneva SE 是一家特種疫苗公司，致力於開發、生產和商業化傳染病預防性疫苗，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。目前，該公司提供三種專有旅行疫苗：IXIARO、DUKORAL 和 IXCHIQ。 IXIARO 是一種滅活的 Vero 細胞培養衍生的日本腦炎疫苗，適用於成人、青少年、兒童和兩個月及以上嬰兒的日本腦炎主動免疫。 DUKORAL 是一種飲用疫苗，有助於預防不耐熱毒素產生的 ETEC 引起的腹瀉以及霍亂。 IXCHIQ 是一種單劑量減毒活疫苗，用於預防基孔肯雅病毒引起的疾病。該公司還提供其他疫苗，包括 VLA1553、VLA15、VLA160、VLA200、VLA1601 等。 Valneva成立於2013年5月28日，總部位於法國聖埃爾布蘭。

info.description: Virginia National Bankshares Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and related financial services. It operates through the following segments: Bank, VNB Trust and Estate Services, and Masonry Capital. The Bank segment includes making loans, taking deposits, and offering related services to individuals, businesses, and charitable organizations. The VNB Trust and Estate Services segment consists of corporate trustee services, trust and estate administration, IRA administration and custody services, and in-house investment management services. The Masonry Capital segment refers to the investment management services for separately managed accounts and a private investment fund. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Charlottesville, VA.
info.description_zh: Virginia National Bankshares Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供銀行及相關金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、VNB 信託和房地產服務部門以及 Masonry Capital 部門。銀行部門包括向個人、企業和慈善組織提供貸款、吸收存款以及提供相關服務。 VNB 信託和遺產服務部門包括企業受託人服務、信託和遺產管理、IRA 管理和託管服務以及內部投資管理服務。 Masonry Capital部門指為獨立管理帳戶和私募投資基金提供投資管理服務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州夏洛茨維爾。

info.description: Veru, Inc. is a late clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel medicines and treatment of cardiometabolic and inflammatory diseases. Its drug development program consists of two late-stage new chemical entities, enobosarm and sabizabulin. The company was founded by William R. Gargiulo, Jr. and O. B. Parrish in 1971 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Veru, Inc. 是一家處於後期臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發新藥以及治療心臟代謝和發炎疾病。其藥物開發計劃包括兩種後期新化學實體：enobosarm 和 sabizabulin。該公司由 William R. Gargiulo, Jr. 和 O. B. Parrish 於 1971 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: STKD Bitcoin & Gold ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing via U.S.-listed futures contracts as well as pooled investment vehicles, such as exchange-traded products, in two complementary asset classes, a modern digital asset class and a traditional asset class. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STKD 比特幣和黃金 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在美國上市的期貨合約以及交易所交易產品等集合投資工具投資於兩種互補的資產類別（現代數位資產類別和傳統資產類別）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc. is a closed-end management investment company. It engages in the business of investing in loans and securities that are rated below investment grade by rating agencies or that may be rated below investment grade if they were so rated. The company was founded on December 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc.是一家封閉式管理投資公司。它從事投資於評級機構評級低於投資級別或如果評級機構評級可能低於投資級別的貸款和證券的業務。該公司成立於2011年12月28日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: DXP Enterprises, Inc. engages in the business of distributing maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to customers serving a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Service Centers (SC), Supply Chain Services (SCS), Innovative Pumping Solutions (IPS), and Corporate. The SC segment provides MRO products, equipment, and services including technical expertise and logistics capabilities to customers serving varied end markets with the ability to provide same day delivery. The SCS segment focuses on managing customers' supply chains including procurement and inventory management. The IPS segment includes integrated, custom pump skid packages, pump remanufacturing, and manufactures branded private label pumps to meet the capital equipment needs of the global customer base. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: DXP Enterprises, Inc. 從事向服務各種終端市場的客戶分銷維護、維修和營運 (MRO) 產品和服務的業務。它透過以下部門運作：服務中心 (SC)、供應鏈服務 (SCS)、創新泵送解決方案 (IPS) 和企業部門。 SC 部門向服務不同終端市場的客戶提供 MRO 產品、設備和服務，包括技術專業知識和物流能力，並能夠提供當日交付。 SCS部門專注於管理客戶的供應鏈，包括採購和庫存管理。 IPS 部門包括整合、客製化泵橇套件、泵浦再製造以及製造品牌自有品牌泵，以滿足全球客戶群的資本設備需求。該公司成立於 1908 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Katapult Holdings, Inc. is an e-commerce focused financial technology company. The firm is engaged in the provision of e-commerce point-of-sale lease-purchase options for nonprime U.S. consumers. It offers its customers a lease purchase transaction processing system with no long-term obligation and options for ownership. The company was founded in August 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Katapult Holdings, Inc. 是一家專注於電子商務的金融科技公司。該公司致力於為美國非優質消費者提供電子商務銷售點租賃購買選擇。它為客戶提供租賃購買交易處理系統，沒有長期義務和所有權選擇。該公司成立於 2019 年 8 月，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: WisdomTree China ex-State-Owned Enterprises Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree China ex-State-Owned Enterprises Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a modified float-adjusted market cap weighted index that consists of common stocks in China, excluding common stocks of "state-owned enterprises." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree中國前國營企業基金旨在追蹤WisdomTree中國前國營企業指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金總資產（不包括證券借貸抵押品）的至少80%將投資於該指數的組成證券以及與該組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的投資。該指數是修正後的流通市值加權指數，由中國普通股組成，不包括「國營企業」的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Palvella Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing and commercializing novel therapies to treat patients suffering from serious, rare genetic skin diseases for which there are no FDA-approved therapies. It develops a pipeline of treatments for rare genetic skin diseases using its patented QTORIN platform. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Wayne, PA.
info.description_zh: Palvella Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發和商業化新型療法，以治療患有嚴重、罕見遺傳性皮膚病的患者，而這些疾病尚無 FDA 批准的療法。該公司利用其專利的 QTORIN 平台開發了一系列治療罕見遺傳性皮膚病的藥物。該公司成立於 2015 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋恩。

info.description: Nano Dimension Ltd. engages in the provision of intelligent machines for the fabrication of additively manufactured electronics. Its products include DragonFly IV, AME Materials, Fabrica 2.0, Fabrica Micro-AM Materials, Essemtec SMT Equipment, and Global Inkjet System. The company was founded by Amit Dror and Simon Anthony-Fried in 2012 and headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nano Dimension Ltd. 致力於為積層製造電子產品的製造提供智慧機器。其產品包括 DragonFly IV、AME Materials、Fabrica 2.0、Fabrica Micro-AM Materials、Essemtec SMT 裝置和 Global Inkjet System。該公司由 Amit Dror 和 Simon Anthony-Fried 於 2012 年創立，總部位於以色列 Ness Ziona。

info.description: Collective Mining Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in South America. It holds interests in San Antonio and Guayabales projects. The company was founded on February 21, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Collective Mining Ltd. 從事南美洲礦產的收購、勘探和開發業務。它擁有聖安東尼奧和瓜亞巴萊斯項目的權益。該公司成立於2018年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Rocket Lab Corp. engages in the development of rocket launch and control systems for the space and defense industries. It operates through the Launch Services and Space Systems segments. The Launch Services segment provides launch services to customers on a dedicated mission or ride-share basis. The Space Systems segment consists of spacecraft engineering and design services, spacecraft components, spacecraft manufacturing, and on-orbit mission operations. The company was founded by Peter Beck in 2006 and is headquartered in Long Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Rocket Lab Corp. 致力於為航太和國防工業開發火箭發射和控制系統。它透過發射服務和太空系統部門運作。發射服務部門為客戶提供專門任務或共乘服務的發射服務。太空系統部門包括太空船工程和設計服務、太空船零件、太空船製造和在軌任務運作。該公司由 Peter Beck 於 2006 年創立，總部位於加州長灘。

info.description: TMC the metals co., Inc. is a deep-sea minerals exploration company focused on the collection and processing of polymetallic nodules found on the seafloor in international waters of the Clarion Clipperton Zone in the Pacific Ocean (CCZ). These nodules contain high grades of four metals (nickel, copper, cobalt, manganese) which can be used as (i) feedstock for battery cathode precursors (nickel, cobalt and manganese sulfates, or intermediate nickel-copper-cobalt matte) for electric vehicles (EV) and renewable energy storage markets, (ii) copper cathode for EV wiring, energy transmission and other applications and (iii) manganese silicate for manganese alloy production required for steel production. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: TMC the Metals Co., Inc. 是一家深海礦物勘探公司，專注於太平洋克拉里昂克利珀頓區 (CCZ) 國際水域海底發現的多金屬結核的收集和加工。這些結核含有高品位的四種金屬（鎳、銅、鈷、錳），可用作（i）電動車（EV）和可再生能源儲存市場的電池陰極前驅物（鎳、鈷和硫酸錳，或中間鎳銅鈷冰銅）的原料，（ii）用於電動車佈線、能量傳輸和其他應用的銅製陰極，以及用於鋼（iiiiii）用於鋼鐵的生產酸合金的生產。該公司成立於2021年，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. engages in the development and operation of seawater desalination plants and water distribution systems. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Bulk, Services, Manufacturing, and Corporate. The Retail segment operates the water utility for the Seven Mile Beach and West Bay areas of Grand Cayman Islands. The Bulk segment supplies potable water to government utilities in Grand Cayman and the Bahamas. The Services segment designs, constructs, and sells water infrastructure, and provides management and operating services to third parties. The Manufacturing segment focuses on the manufacture and service of custom and specialized water-related products applicable to commercial, municipal and industrial water production, supply, and treatment. The Corporate segment consists of various expenses of general and administrative nature to the firm. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.從事海水淡化廠和配水系統的開發和營運。它透過以下部門運作：零售部門、散貨部門、服務部門、製造部門和企業部門。零售部門經營大開曼群島七英里海灘和西灣地區的自來水公司。散裝部門向大開曼島和巴哈馬的政府公用事業供應飲用水。服務部門設計、建造和銷售水基礎設施，並向第三方提供管理和營運服務。製造部門專注於適用於商業、市政和工業水生產、供應和處理的客製化和專業水相關產品的製造和服務。公司部門包括公司的各種一般性和行政性費用。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: National Energy Services Reunited Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of oilfield services. It operates through the Production Services and Drilling and Evaluation Services. The Production Services segment includes coiled tubing, cementing, stimulation and pumping, nitrogen services, filtration services, completions, pipelines, laboratory services, and artificial lift services. The Drilling and Evaluation Services segment offers well testing services, drilling services and rental, fishing and remediation, drilling and workover rigs, wireline logging services, turbines drilling, directional drilling, slickline services, and drilling fluids. The company was founded on January 23, 2017 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: National Energy Services Reunited Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供油田服務。它透過生產服務以及鑽井和評估服務來運作。生產服務部門包括連續油管、固井、增產和泵送、氮氣服務、過濾服務、完井、管道、實驗室服務和人工舉升服務。鑽井和評估服務部門提供試井服務、鑽井服務和租賃、捕魚和修復、鑽井和修井機、電纜測井服務、渦輪機鑽井、定向鑽井、鋼絲服務和鑽井液。該公司成立於2017年1月23日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Check-Cap Ltd. is a clinical stage medical diagnostics company, which engages in the development of ingestible imaging capsule systems for colorectal cancer screening. Its patented technology, C-Scan, is a patient-friendly preparation-free test designed to detect polyps before they may transform into cancer. The company was founded by Yoav Kimchy in 2005 and is headquartered in Isfiya, Israel.
info.description_zh: Check-Cap Ltd.是一家臨床階段醫療診斷公司，致力於開發用於結直腸癌篩檢的可攝入成像膠囊系統。其專利技術 C-Scan 是一種患者友好的免準備測試，旨在在息肉轉變為癌症之前檢測出息肉。該公司由 Yoav Kimchy 於 2005 年創立，總部位於以色列伊斯菲亞。

info.description: Mammoth Energy Services, Inc. engages in the exploration and development of North American onshore unconventional oil and natural gas reserves. It operates through the following segments: Well Completion, Infrastructure, Sand, Drilling, and All Other. The Well Completion segment focuses on hydraulic fracturing and water transfer services primarily in the Utica Shale of Eastern Ohio, Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania, and the mid-continent region. The Infrastructure segment offers electric utility infrastructure services to government-funded utilities, private utilities, public investor-owned utilities and co-operative utilities in the northeastern, southwestern, midwestern, and western portions of the United States. The Sand segment is involved in mining, processing, and sale of sand for use in hydraulic fracturing. The Drilling segment includes contract land and directional drilling services primarily in the Permian Basin and mid-continent region. The company was founded on June 3, 2016 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK.
info.description_zh: Mammoth Energy Services, Inc.從事北美陸上非常規石油和天然氣儲量的勘探和開發。它透過以下部門運作：完井部門、基礎設施部門、砂石部門、鑽井部門和所有其他部門。完井部門主要專注於俄亥俄州東部的尤蒂卡頁岩、賓州的馬塞勒斯頁岩和中部大陸地區的水力壓裂和輸水服務。基礎設施部門為美國東北部、西南部、中西部和西部地區的政府資助公用事業、私人公用事業、公共投資者擁有的公用事業和合作公用事業提供電力基礎設施服務。沙子部門從事水力壓裂用沙的開採、加工和銷售。鑽井部門包括主要在二疊紀盆地和中部大陸地區的合約土地和定向鑽井服務。該公司成立於2016年6月3日，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州俄克拉荷馬市。

info.description: Acacia Research Corp. focuses on acquiring and operating businesses across the industrial, energy, and mature technology sectors where it believes it can leverage its expertise, significant capital base, and deep industry relationships to drive value. It operates through the following business segments: Intellectual Property Operations, Industrial Operations and Energy Operations. The Intellectual Property Operations segment invests in IP and related absolute return assets and engages in the licensing and enforcement of patented technologies. The Industrial Operations segment generates operating income by designing and manufacturing printers and consumable products for various industrial printing applications. The Energy Operations segment engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas resources located in Roberts and Hemphill Counties in Texas. The company was founded by Robert Bruce Stewart on January 25, 1993 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Acacia Research Corp. 專注於收購和經營工業、能源和成熟技術領域的業務，它相信可以利用其專業知識、重要的資本基礎和深厚的行業關係來推動價值。它透過以下業務部門運作：知識產權運營、工業運營和能源運營。智慧財產權營運部門投資於智慧財產權和相關絕對回報資產，並從事專利技術的授權和執行。工業營運部門透過為各種工業列印應用設計和製造印表機和耗材產品來產生營業收入。能源營運部門從事位於德克薩斯州羅伯茨縣和亨普希爾縣的石油和天然氣資源的收購、勘探、開發和生產。該公司由 Robert Bruce Stewart 於 1993 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Park Dental Partners, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive business support services including clinical team members, administrative personnel, facilities and equipment. The company was founded by Gregory T. Swenson and Brian Murn in 1972 and is headquartered in Roseville, MN.
info.description_zh: Park Dental Partners, Inc. 從事提供全面的業務支援服務，包括臨床團隊成員、行政人員、設施和設備。該公司由 Gregory T. Swenson 和 Brian Murn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州羅斯維爾。

info.description: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. engages in the provision of conversational artificial intelligence assistants with the purpose of transforming engagement and analytics for businesses through security-focused, multimodal communication and human-like artificial intelligence assistants. The firm is also involved in delivering highly personalized, multi-modal artificial intelligence engagement with a focus on industries where there is a massive workforce gap and an opportunity to transform how consumers engage with networks, providers, and brands. The company is founded by Tyler J. Luck, Michael Lucas, Patrick Nunally & Hanseok Ko on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. 致力於提供對話式人工智慧助手，旨在透過以安全為中心的多模式通訊和類人人工智慧助理來改變企業的參與和分析。該公司也致力於提供高度個人化、多模式的人工智慧參與，重點關注勞動力缺口巨大的產業，並有機會改變消費者與網路、供應商和品牌的互動方式。該公司由 Tyler J. Luck、Michael Lucas、Patrick Nunally 和 Hanseok Ko 於 2024 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Odyssey Marine Exploration, Inc. is a deep-ocean exploration pioneer that provides access to critical mineral resources. The company uses innovative methods and cutting-edge technology to discover, validate and develop subsea mineral deposits in an environmentally and socially responsible manner. Its projects include US Critical Minerals Program, Lihir Gold projects and Cook Island Nodule Exploration. The company was founded by Gregory P. Stemm and John C. Morris in 1994 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: 奧德賽海洋勘探公司是深海勘探先驅，提供關鍵礦產資源的取得。該公司採用創新方法和尖端技術，以對環境和社會負責的方式發現、驗證和開發海底礦藏。其項目包括美國關鍵礦產計劃、利希爾金礦項目和庫克島結核勘探項目。該公司由 Gregory P. Stemm 和 John C. Morris 於 1994 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Darkiris, Inc. provides software development, internet sales, wholesale and retail of cultural products. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Darkiris, Inc. 提供軟體開發、網路銷售、文化產品批發和零售。公司成立於2017年，總部位於香港。

info.description: USA Rare Earth, Inc. is a domestic supplier of rare earth magnets and heavy rare earth elements. It develops a vertically integrated domestic supply chain for rare earth element magnet production, with a facility in Stillwater and mining rights to the Round Top heavy rare earth and critical minerals deposit in West Texas. The company was founded in May 2019 and is headquartered in Stillwater, OK.
info.description_zh: 美國稀土公司是國內稀土磁體和重稀土元素供應商。該公司開發了一條垂直一體化的國內稀土元素磁體生產供應鏈，在斯蒂爾沃特設有工廠，並擁有西德克薩斯州圓頂重稀土和關鍵礦床的採礦權。該公司成立於 2019 年 5 月，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州斯蒂爾沃特。

info.description: International Flavors & Fragrances, Inc. engages in the manufacture and supply of flavors and fragrances used in the food, beverage, personal care, and household products industries. It operates through the following segments: Nourish, Health & Biosciences, Scent and Pharma Solutions. The Nourish segment consists of legacy Taste segment combined with N&B's Food & Beverage division and the food protection business of N&B's Health & Biosciences division. The Health & Biosciences business consists of a biotechnology-driven portfolio of enzymes, food cultures, probiotics and specialty ingredients for food, home and personal care, and health and wellness applications. The Scent business creates fragrance compounds, fragrance ingredients and cosmetic ingredients that are integral elements in the world's finest perfumes and best-known household and personal care products. The Pharma Solutions business produces a vast portfolio including cellulosics and seaweed-based pharma excipients, used to improve the functionality and delivery of active pharmaceutical ingredients, including controlled or modified drug release formulations, and enabling. The company was founded in 1833 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: International Flavors & Fragrances, Inc. 從事食品、飲料、個人護理和家居用品行業使用的香精香料的製造和供應。它透過以下部門運作：滋養部門、健康與生物科學部門、香味部門和製藥解決方案部門。營養部門由傳統口味部門、N&B 食品和飲料部門以及 N&B 健康與生物科學部門的食品保護業務組成。健康與生物科學業務包括生物技術驅動的酵素、食品培養物、益生菌和食品、家庭和個人護理以及健康和保健應用的特殊成分組合。香精業務生產香精化合物、香精成分和化妝品成分，這些是世界上最好的香水和最著名的家庭和個人護理產品中不可或缺的元素。製藥解決方案業務生產廣泛的產品組合，包括纖維素和海藻基藥用輔料，用於改善活性藥物成分的功能和遞送，包括受控或改良的藥物釋放配方，並實現。該公司成立於 1833 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a global healthcare leader in the development and production of stabilized hypochlorous acid (HOCl) products. Its products are used for a wide range of applications, including wound care, eye care, nasal care, oral care, dermatological conditions, podiatry, animal health care, and non-toxic disinfectants. The company was founded by Hojabr Alimi and Linda Alimi in April 1999 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是開發和生產穩定次氯酸 (HOCl) 產品的全球醫療保健領導者。其產品用途廣泛，包括傷口護理、眼部護理、鼻部護理、口腔護理、皮膚病、足病、動物保健和無毒消毒劑。該公司由 Hojabr Alimi 和 Linda Alimi 於 1999 年 4 月創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Massimo Group engages in the manufacture and distribution of powersports vehicles and recreational watercraft. It offers farm and ranch tested utility terrain vehicles, recreational all-terrain vehicles, and Americana style mini-bikes, and pontoon boats. The company was founded by David Shan and Rod N. Santomassimo on October 10, 2022 and is headquartered in Garland, TX.
info.description_zh: Massimo 集團從事動力運動車輛和休閒船隻的製造和分銷。它提供經過農場和牧場測試的多功能越野車、休閒全地形車、美式迷你自行車和浮橋船。該公司由 David Shan 和 Rod N. Santomassimo 於 2022 年 10 月 10 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州加蘭。

info.description: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. operates as a software development company. It operates through the following business units: the customer experience management platform and the digital transformation. The customer experience management platform includes marketing, sales, service, and a content management system. The digital transformation business provides customers with robotic process automation, process mining, and task mining. The company was founded on May 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. 是一家軟體開發公司。它透過以下業務部門運作：客戶體驗管理平台和數位轉型。客戶體驗管理平台包括行銷、銷售、服務和內容管理系統。數位轉型業務為客戶提供機器人流程自動化、流程挖掘、任務挖掘。該公司成立於2021年5月18日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Digital Turbine, Inc. is a mobile growth platform that offers solutions for advertisers, publishers, carriers, and device original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The firm operates through the On Device Solutions (ODS) and App Growth Platform (AGP) segments. The ODS segment generates revenue from the delivery of mobile application media or content to end users with solutions for all participants in the mobile application ecosystem that want to connect with end users and consumers who hold the device. This includes mobile carriers and device OEMs that participate in the app economy, app publishers and developers, and brands and advertising agencies. The AGP segment provides platforms that allow mobile app publishers and developers to monetize their monthly active users via display, native, and video advertising. The company was founded on November 6, 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Digital Turbine, Inc. 是一個行動成長平台，為廣告主、出版商、營運商和裝置原始裝置製造商 (OEM) 提供解決方案。該公司透過設備上解決方案（ODS）和應用程式成長平台（AGP）部門進行營運。 ODS 部門透過向最終用戶交付行動應用程式媒體或內容來產生收入，並為行動應用程式生態系統中希望與最終用戶和持有設備的消費者建立聯繫的所有參與者提供解決方案。這包括參與應用經濟的行動營運商和設備 OEM、應用程式發行商和開發人員以及品牌和廣告代理商。 AGP 部門提供的平台允許行動應用程式發行商和開發人員透過展示廣告、原生廣告和影片廣告從其每月活躍用戶中獲利。該公司成立於1998年11月6日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: CarParts.com, Inc. operates as an online provider of aftermarket auto parts and accessories in the United States and the Philippines. Its products include Collision Parts, Engine Parts, Performance Parts and Accessories. The firm also sells auto parts to collision repair shops, markets Kool-Vue products to auto parts wholesale distributors, and aftermarket catalytic converters under the Evan Fischer brand. Its flagship Websites include www.carparts.com, www.jcwhitney.com, www.autopartswarehouse.com and www.usautoparts.com. The company was founded by Sol Khazani and Mehran Nia in 1995 and is headquartered in Long Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: CarParts.com, Inc. 在美國和菲律賓作為售後汽車零件和配件的線上提供者運作。其產品包括碰撞部件、引擎部件、性能部件和配件。該公司還向碰撞維修店銷售汽車零件，向汽車零件批發經銷商銷售 Kool-Vue 產品，並以 Evan Fischer 品牌銷售售後觸媒轉換器。其旗艦網站包括 www.carparts.com、www.jcwhitney.com、www.autopartswarehouse.com 和 www.usautoparts.com。該公司由 Sol Khazani 和 Mehran Nia 於 1995 年創立，總部位於加州長灘。

info.description: Lightbridge Corp. engages in the development and commercialization of next generation nuclear fuel technology. It offers Lightbridge Fuel, a proprietary next generation of nuclear fuel technology for current and future reactors. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: Lightbridge Corp. 從事下一代核燃料技術的開發和商業化。它提供 Lightbridge Fuel，這是一種適用於當前和未來反應器的下一代專有核燃料技術。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: iPower, Inc. engages in the online retail and supply of consumer home, garden, in-home farming, pet, and wellbeing products. It sells its brands such as Simple Deluxe, YSSOA, Zenhydro, Flourish, iPOWER, iFarm, FluffyDream, ScratchMe, and HealSmart through zenhydro.com, simpledeluxe.com, and various third-party online platforms. The company offers grow light systems, advanced heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, water pumps, heaters, chillers and filters, nutrient and fertilizer delivery systems, and various growing media typically made from soil, rock wool or coconut fiber. It also provides home goods supplies including commercial fans, floor and wall fans, storage and shelving units, and chairs. The company was founded by Chenlong Tan and Allan Huang on April 11, 2018 and is headquartered in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.
info.description_zh: iPower, Inc. 從事消費者家居、園藝、家庭農業、寵物和保健產品的線上零售和供應。它透過zenHydro.com、simpledeluxe.com和各種第三方線上平台銷售Simple Deluxe、YSSOA、ZenHydro、Flourish、iPOWER、iFarm、FluffyDream、ScratchMe和HealSmart等品牌。該公司提供生長燈系統、先進的暖氣、通風和空調 (HVAC) 系統、水泵、加熱器、冷卻器和過濾器、養分和肥料輸送系統以及通常由土壤、岩棉或椰子纖維製成的各種生長介質。它還提供家居用品，包括商用風扇、落地扇和壁扇、儲物櫃和層架以及椅子。該公司由 Chenlong Tan 和 Allan Huang 於 2018 年 4 月 11 日創立，總部位於加州庫卡蒙加牧場。

info.description: Tenon Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the development of a minimally invasive approach to the sacroiliac joint (SI joint) using a single titanium implant for treatment of the most common types of SI Joint disorders. The company was founded by Richard Ferrari and Richard Ginn on June 19, 2012 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tenon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於開發骶髂關節（SI 關節）微創方法，使用單一鈦植入物來治療最常見的 SI 關節疾病。該公司由 Richard Ferrari 和 Richard Ginn 於 2012 年 6 月 19 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Dominari Holdings, Inc. engages in wealth management, investment banking, sales and trading, and asset management through its subsidiaries. It operates through the Dominari Financial and Legacy AIkido business segments. The Dominari Financial segment represents the company's broker-dealer business, which is composed of mostly underwriting and transactional service activities. The Legacy AIkido segment includes Aikido Labs, which manages the investments holdings of the legacy entity. The company was founded by Gilbert V. Levin and M. Karen Levin in 1967 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Dominari Holdings, Inc.透過其子公司從事財富管理、投資銀行、銷售和交易以及資產管理業務。它透過 Dominari Financial 和 Legacy AIkido 業務部門運作。 Dominari Financial 部門代表該公司的經紀自營商業務，主要由承銷和交易服務活動組成。傳統合氣道部門包括合氣道實驗室，該實驗室管理傳統實體的投資控股。該公司由 Gilbert V. Levin 和 M. Karen Levin 於 1967 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc. engages in investment activities. It includes buying real estate investment trusts and investing real estate securities. The company was founded by Charles Evans Patterson on January 25, 2012 and is headquartered in Orinda, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc.從事投資活動。它包括購買房地產投資信託和投資房地產證券。該公司由 Charles Evans Patterson 於 2012 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於加州奧林達。

info.description: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. engages in the development, publishing, marketing, and distribution of games. It operates through the following segments: Console Game, Hardware, and Accessories, Game Publishing, Advertising Service, and Other. The company was founded on October 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 協鑫環球控股有限公司從事遊戲開發、發行、行銷和發行。它透過以下部門運作：主機遊戲、硬體和配件、遊戲出版、廣告服務和其他。該公司成立於2023年10月12日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GRAB Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of GRAB. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GRAB, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 GRAB 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 GRAB ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 GRAB 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mingteng International Corp., Inc. is a holding company, which engages in mold production, repair, and machining activities through its subsidiaries. It provides casting molds for turbocharger systems, braking systems, steering and differential system, and other automotive system parts. The company was founded by Ying Kai Xu on September 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: 明騰國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事模俱生產、維修和機械加工活動。為渦輪增壓系統、煞車系統、轉向及差速系統等汽車系統零件提供鑄造模具。該公司由徐應凱於2021年9月20日創立，總部位於中國無錫。

info.description: Rapid7, Inc. engages in the provision of cyber security analytics and automation services. Its products include Metasploit, Nexpose, AppSpider, tCell by Rapid7, as well as insight platforms such as InsightDR, InsightIVM, InsightAppSec, InsightConnect, and InsightOps. The firm also offers security and product consulting services. The company was founded by Alan P. Matthews, Tas Giakouminakis, and Chad Loder in July 2000 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rapid7, Inc. 從事提供網路安全分析和自動化服務。其產品包括Metasploit、Nexpose、AppSpider、Rapid7的tCell，以及InsightDR、InsightIVM、InsightAppSec、InsightConnect和InsightOps等洞察平台。該公司還提供安全和產品諮詢服務。該公司由 Alan P. Matthews、Tas Giakouminakis 和 Chad Loder 於 2000 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Aligos Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the provision of therapeutics for chronic liver diseases and viral infections. The firm is focused on the discovery and development of targeted antiviral therapies for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and coronaviruses, as well as leveraging its expertise in liver diseases to create targeted therapeutics for nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH). The company was founded by Lucinda Quan and Lawrence M. Blatt on February 5, 2018 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Aligos Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於提供慢性肝病和病毒感染的治療藥物。该公司专注于发现和开发针对慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）和冠状病毒的靶向抗病毒疗法，并利用其在肝脏疾病方面的专业知识来创建针对非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的靶向疗法。該公司由 Lucinda Quan 和 Lawrence M. Blatt 於 2018 年 2 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Playboy, Inc. operates as a media and lifestyle company. It connects consumers around the world with products, services, and experiences to help them look good, feel good, and have fun. The firm serves consumers in the following categories: Sexual Wellness, Style & Apparel, Gaming & Lifestyle, and Beauty & Grooming. Its flagship consumer brand, Playboy, publishes a magazine for men that focus primarily on photography, entertainment, humor, and cartoons as well as articles on current issues and trends. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Playboy, Inc. 是一家媒體和生活風格公司。它將世界各地的消費者與產品、服務和體驗聯繫起來，幫助他們看起來漂亮、感覺良好並享受樂趣。該公司為以下類別的消費者提供服務：性健康、時尚與服裝、遊戲與生活方式以及美容與美容。其旗艦消費品牌花花公子出版了一本男性雜誌，主要關注攝影、娛樂、幽默和卡通，以及有關當前問題和趨勢的文章。該公司成立於 1953 年，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Critical Metals Corp. engages in the mining, exploration, and development of lithium metals. It owns Wolfsberg Project and Tanbreez Project. The company was founded on October 24, 2022 and is headquartered in British Virgin Islands.
info.description_zh: Critical Metals Corp. 從事鋰金屬的開採、勘探和開發。它擁有Wolfsberg項目和Tanbreez項目。該公司成立於2022年10月24日，總部位於英屬維京群島。

info.description: Huadi International Group Co. Ltd. engages in the provision of industrial stainless steel piping products and production services. It also manufactures certain steel products, such as automotive 304L and 347H stainless steel pipes, which are widely used in hydraulic mechanisms, automotive applications such as brake systems, steering columns and axles, and various other industrial applications. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, USA, India, Singapore, Australia, and Other Foreign Countries. The company was founded on September 27, 2018 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 華迪國際集團有限公司從事提供工業不鏽鋼管道產品及生產服務。它還生產某些鋼材產品，例如汽車304L和347H不銹鋼管，廣泛應用於液壓機構、煞車系統、轉向柱和車軸等汽車應用以及各種其他工業應用。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、美國、印度、新加坡、澳洲和其他國家。公司成立於2018年9月27日，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: P3 Health Partners, Inc. is a population health care management company, which engages in the provision of professional support services to doctors and clinicians. The firm offers capital care model, data and technology, physician leadership, and community outreach tools to create patient outcomes and experiences. The company was founded by Sherif Abdou and Amir Bacchus on August 20, 2020 and is headquartered in Henderson, NV.
info.description_zh: P3 Health Partners, Inc.是一家人口醫療保健管理公司，致力於為醫生和臨床醫生提供專業支援服務。該公司提供資本護理模型、數據和技術、醫生領導力和社區外展工具，以創造患者的治療結果和體驗。該公司由 Sherif Abdou 和 Amir Bacchus 於 2020 年 8 月 20 日創立，總部位於內華達州亨德森。

info.description: Jupiter Neurosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company engaged in treating neuroinflammation with a current focus on CNS disorders and rare diseases. The firm offers JOTROL, an enhanced orally administered resveratrol formulation, designed to deliver therapeutically relevant, safe levels of resveratrol. The company was founded by Christer Rosen, Alexander Rosen, Claes Wahlestedt, Marshall Hayward, and Shaun P. Brothers in January 2016 and is headquartered in Jupiter, FL.
info.description_zh: Jupiter Neurosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的製藥公司，致力於治療神經炎症，目前專注於中樞神經系統疾病和罕見疾病。該公司提供 JOTROL，一種增強型口服白藜蘆醇配方，旨在提供治療相關的、安全水平的白藜蘆醇。該公司由 Christer Rosen、Alexander Rosen、Claes Wahlestedt、Marshall Hayward 和 Shaun P. Brothers 於 2016 年 1 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朱庇特。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long USAR Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying company involved in the critical minerals supply chain.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 USAR 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標是 USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品為參與關鍵礦產供應鏈的基礎公司提供放大的每日風險敞口。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Futu Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of FUTU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of FUTU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund manager will pay the premium for each call option contract bought and receive the premium for each put option sold. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股份2倍長富途每日ETF尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未扣除費用和開支）為FUTU普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具組合起來可提供 FUTU 價格 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。基金經理人將為買入的每份看漲期權合約支付權利金，並為賣出的每份看跌期權合約收取權利金。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of ceramics tiles. Its products operates through the Hengda, the Hengdeli or HDL brand, TOERTO, WULIQIAO, and Pottery Capital of Tang Dynasty brands. It offers porcelain, glazed, glazed porcelain, rustic, and polished glazed tiles. The company was founded by Jia Dong Huan on September 30, 1993 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.description_zh: 羚羊企業控股有限公司從事瓷磚的製造及銷售。其產品透過恆達、亨得利或HDL品牌、TOERTO、五里橋、唐朝陶都品牌運作。它提供瓷器、釉面、釉面瓷、仿古和拋光釉面磚。該公司由賈東歡於1993年9月30日創立，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: GDEV, Inc. operates as a gaming and entertainment holding company, which oversees a diverse portfolio of studios focused on developing and publishing live-service games across multiple platforms and genres. Its portfolio includes studios specializing in mobile, browser, and PC games, as well as captivating intellectual properties spanning various genres. The company's franchises include hero wars, island hoppers, pixel gun 3D, and others. The company was founded by Andrey Fadeev and Boris Gertsovsky in 2010 and is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
info.description_zh: GDEV, Inc. 是一家遊戲和娛樂控股公司，負責監管多元化的工作室組合，專注於跨多個平台和類型開發和發布即時服務遊戲。其產品組合包括專門從事行動、瀏覽器和電腦遊戲的工作室，以及涵蓋各種類型的迷人智慧財產權。該公司的特許經營遊戲包括《英雄戰爭》、《島嶼跳躍者》、《像素槍 3D》等。該公司由 Andrey Fadeev 和 Boris Gertsovsky 於 2010 年創立，總部位於塞浦路斯利馬索爾。

info.description: Abits Group, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet media marketing services in China and bitcoin mining and related services in the United States. It is the operator of the Games Channel of the Xinhua App, an application developed and operated by Xinhua New China News Agency. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Abits Group, Inc.在中國提供網路媒體行銷服務，在美國提供比特幣挖礦及相關服務。它是新華社開發和運營的應用程式“新華社”遊戲頻道的運營商。公司成立於2013年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: YSX Tech. Co. Ltd. engages in providing comprehensive business solutions to enterprise customers, mainly insurance companies and brokerages in China. Its service includes electronic engineering, PCB fabrication, SMT and PCB assembly, components sourcing, prototyping, box build, turn-key solution and other value-added services for a broad range of companies with regard to telecommunication, consumptive electronics, industrial test and control, medical equipment, power supply, security, vehicle and more. It operates through the following segments: Auto Insurance Aftermarket Value-added Services, Other Scenario-based Customized Service, and Software Development and Information Technology Services. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 永興科技.有限公司致力於為企業客戶（主要是中國的保險公司和經紀公司）提供全面的業務解決方案。其服務包括電子工程、PCB製造、SMT和PCB組裝、元件採購、原型設計、整機組裝、交鑰匙解決方案和其他加值服務，為電信、消費性電子、工業測試和控制、醫療設備、電源、安全、車輛等領域的廣泛公司提供服務。其業務板塊包括：車險後市場加值服務、其他場景客製化服務、軟體開發與資訊科技服務。公司成立於2004年，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Masonglory Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of wet trades and other related ancillary works. It offers plastering on floors, ceilings and walls, tile laying on internal and external walls and floors, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Masonglory Ltd.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供濕貨貿易及其他相關配套工程業務。它提供地板、天花板和牆壁的抹灰、內外牆和地板的瓷磚鋪設、磚砌、地板找平和大理石工程。公司成立於2018年，總部位於香港。

info.description: TryHard Holdings Ltd. is a lifestyle entertainment company that operates in Japan offering a diverse range of services across the entertainment and hospitality sectors. It operates through the following business segments: Consultancy and management, Event curation, Sub-leasing and Restaurants. The Consultancy and management segment provides expert services to clubs, including operations, event management, and strategic support to enhance performance and engagement. The Event curation segment organize and produce own events, also provides a full suite of services, including event planning, construction, entertainment booking, event operation, and ticket sales. The Sub-Leasing segment acts as an intermediary between landlords and clubs. The Restaurants segment operates several restaurants. The company was founded on October 16, 2013 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
info.description_zh: TryHard Holdings Ltd. 是一家在日本營運的生活風格娛樂公司，在娛樂和酒店業提供多種服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：諮詢和管理、活動策劃、分租和餐廳。諮詢和管理部門為俱樂部提供專家服務，包括營運、活動管理和策略支持，以提高績效和參與。活動策展部門組織和製作自己的活動，並提供全套服務，包括活動策劃、施工、娛樂預訂、活動運營和門票銷售。轉租部門充當房東和俱樂部之間的中介。餐廳部門經營多家餐廳。公司成立於2013年10月16日，總部位於日本大阪。

info.description: Alpha Technology Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of cloud-based IT solution service. The company was founded by Leung Tsz Him on October 5, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 阿爾法科技集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供基於雲端的IT解決方案服務。該公司由梁子謙於2022年10月5日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOUN ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoundHound AI, Inc. The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. A "single day" means the period "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOUN ETF 尋求 SoundHound AI, Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過利用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是在一天內實現這一每日百分比變化，而不是在任何其他時期。 「單日」指「由交易日常規交易收盤至下一交易日收盤止」的期間。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Auddia, Inc. engages in the development of audio content ecosystem technology and products. The firm operates an interactive radio platform called Auddia, which is a subscription based commercial free AM and FM software application. It also offers Vodacast, an interactive podcasting platform and application, which enables listeners to see video and other digital content in a digital feed that correlates with the podcast audio. The company was founded by Jeffrey J. Thramann in 2011 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Auddia, Inc. 從事音訊內容生態系統技術和產品的開發。該公司經營一個名為 Auddia 的互動廣播平台，這是一個基於訂閱的商業免費 AM 和 FM 軟體應用程式。它還提供 Vodacast，這是一個互動式播客平台和應用程序，使聽眾能夠在與播客音訊相關的數位來源中觀看影片和其他數位內容。該公司由 Jeffrey J. Thramann 於 2011 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: SurgePays, Inc. operates as a technology-driven company, which focuses on building a supply chain software platform as an alternative to traditional wholesale supply chain distribution models. It offers goods and services direct to convenience stores, bodegas, minimarts, tiendas and other corner stores, providing goods and services primarily to the underbanked community. The company was founded on August 18, 2006 and is headquartered in Bartlett, TN.
info.description_zh: SurgePays, Inc. 是一家技術驅動型公司，專注於建立供應鏈軟體平台，作為傳統批發供應鏈分銷模式的替代方案。它直接向便利商店、酒窖、迷你超市、tiendas 和其他街角商店提供商品和服務，主要向銀行服務不足的社區提供商品和服務。該公司成立於2006年8月18日，總部位於田納西州巴特利特。

info.description: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of information and communication technology services. Its solutions include ICT solution services, technical services, and project management services. The company was founded by Yat Lung Lee on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. 從事提供資訊和通訊技術服務。其解決方案包括ICT解決方案服務、技術服務和專案管理服務。該公司由李逸龍於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops novel molecular technology that provides enhanced targeted delivery of technologies for treating central nervous system diseases. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Calabasas, CA.
info.description_zh: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它開發新穎的分子技術，提供增強的標靶治療中樞神經系統疾病的技術。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於加州卡拉巴薩斯。

info.description: Steakholder Foods Ltd. is an international deep-tech food company, which engages in the provision of production technology and associated supplies needed to commercially produce structured alternative protein products. The firm is also involved in developing and selling two types of 3D-printing production machines and developing plant-based products that aim to replicate the complex textures of traditional meats such as beef steaks, white fish, shrimp, and eel. The company was founded by Arik Kaufman, Yaron Kaiser, Sharon Fima, and Omri Schanin on July 22, 1992 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Steakholder Foods Ltd.是一家國際高科技食品公司，致力於提供商業化生產結構化替代蛋白質產品所需的生產技術和相關供應品。該公司還參與開發和銷售兩種類型的 3D 列印生產機器，並開發植物性產品，旨在複製傳統肉類（如牛排、白魚、蝦和鰻魚）的複雜質地。該公司由 Arik Kaufman、Yaron Kaiser、Sharon Fima 和 Omri Schanin 於 1992 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: TNL Mediagene engages in digital advertising, integrated marketing, marketing survey, artificial intelligence technology, data analysis, content service platform, and production of audio-visual programs. It operates media, technology, and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan and Taiwan. The company was founded on May 25, 2023 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: TNL Mediagene 從事數位廣告、整合行銷、行銷調查、人工智慧技術、數據分析、內容服務平台和視聽節目製作。該公司主要在日本和台灣經營媒體、科技和數位工作室業務。該公司成立於2023年5月25日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: TELA Bio, Inc. is a commercial stage medical technology company, which focuses on the design, development, and market of tissue reinforcement materials. The company was founded by Antony Koblish and Maarten Persenaire on April 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Malvern, PA.
